/sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes/ /rab tu dwangs shing dbang po dul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / bye brag tu/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes/ /cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rab tu 'dzin/ /dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba thob pa/ bsnyen pa las su rung zhing / de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang / sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes pa/ sngon chad las kyi cho ga mthong ba/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ slob ma mtshan nyid mi ldan pa bsten na rang gzhan gnyis ka nyams par 'gyur bas/ zab mo'i snod du rung ba la slob ma'ang brtag dgos te/ slob ma gang gis sems can kun la mnar sems pa'i snying rje med pa/ khros pa'i 'og tu sems 'dud par 'dzin pa'i gdug pa/ nga rgyal bdun gyis khengs shing rang gi phun sum tshogs pa la dga' ba'i sems 'dzin pas chags pa/ nyon mongs pa las sems mi bsrung zhing bag med cing / lus kyi spyod lam ma bsdams pa/ bya ba thams cad bdag gi don du byed pas na spyom pa dang bcas pa ste/ ji skad du/ blo ldan bla mas slob ma ni/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i slob ma la zab mo'i chos rnams mi ston/ de bas na dpon slob kyi 'brel brtag pa shin tu gces so/ /ji skad du/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams 'gyur bas/ /dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i 'brel pa brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /'o na bsten par bya ba'i slob ma gang zhe na/ blo brtan zhing / spyod lam dul ba/ snying rje che ba/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa/ bzod sran che la ser sna chung zhing bslab bya la mos pa/

bla ma dang yi dam la mos pa dang / bye brag tu dbang skur ba don du gnyer zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa zhig bsten dgos pa yin te/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan pa gzung / /zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga man chad kha yar ba zhig nges par dgos pa yin te/ spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni/ spyi rgyud las/ nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang / /ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /zhes gsungs la/ zla ba so so'i yang yar ngo'i tshes grangs gnyis dang / bzhi dang / drug dang / dgu dang / bcu gnyis te lnga po ma gtogs pa'i nyi ma bcu ni mchog tu bsngags shing / phur bu dang ni zla ba dang / /pa ba sangs dang nyi ma bzang / /zhes dang / rgyal dang skag dang sa ga dang / /me bzhi nag pa tha skar dang / /snron sogs gsum dang de dag ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu rab tu bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gza' dang / skar ma dang / sbyor ba dang / byed pa bzang po rnams 'dzoms pa'i yar ngo'am/ de rnams lhag par 'dzoms na mar ngo la yang nyes pa med de/ mar gyi ngo yi dus mtshams la'ang / /zhes gsungs shing / yang rab gnas kyi rgyud las kyang / dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas nyid/ /yar gyi ngo la rtag par bya/ /gza' dang skar ma 'dzoms gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pa yin/ de dag ma brtag par ngan pa la las byas pa'i nyes pa yang / spyi rgyud las/ tshes grangs dang ni dus min dang / /gnas min cho ga mi ldan par/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mi bri 'o/ /bris na dogs pa med par 'chi/ /zhes bshad la/

nges par brtag dgos pa'ang de nyid las/ de lta bas na yud tsam dang / /tshes grangs rgyu skar byed pa dang / /rmi lam bzang po brtag pa dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ tshes grangs sogs bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin bya bar bshad pa yin/ gang du bskur ba'i gnas la/ spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ /bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i/ /gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa zhig dgos la/ khyad par du spyi rgyud las/ mchod rten chen po nyams dga' dang / /dben pa yi ni gnas dag tu/ /ri yi rtse mo rgya chen du/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes dang / yang rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rang ngam bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing / snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben zhing / bkra shis pa'i gnas shig tu bya dgos par bshad pa yin/ tshul ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa'i tshul gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya ba/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma btang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ bdag bsgrub cing bzlas pa bya ba rnams dgos pa yin na'ang / de sngon du legs par grub zin pa yin/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ rgyud las/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ de nas bla na med pa'i byang chub ni/

rnam snang gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de thob pa'i slob ma dbang gis rgyud yongs su smin par byed pa la/ slob ma sta gon dang dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la khyab bdag rnam snang chen po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa dang mnyam pa gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa rgya chen por blos sprul nas phul bar mos nas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes sogs gsungs nas thog mar sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rgyas shing mtha' chod pa dang bcas byin rlabs kyi zil dang ldan pa stsal nas/ 'o de rnams kyi sgo nas sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i brtag pa dang po'i dngos bstan yo ga stod lugs kyi phyag len gyi rjes su 'brangs nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par gsan pa yin pas/ de'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shradha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ ti shri kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/

kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje btsun chos dbang phyug de'i drung du nged kyis thob pa de khyed rnams la phul ba yin pas/ 'dis rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gnang ba'i nangs par de/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi sta gon gnang ba de'i nyi ma phyi ma nas bzung / dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams rim pa bzhin stsal ba'i nyi ma rjes ma'i nyin/ 'o de rnams kyis sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams legs par gsan pa yin pas/ de'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swa ti pha la/ sgra gcan zin/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra hi ta/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ kha che dharma pha la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ bsnyal pa nyi she/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ bshes gnyen rdo rje seṅge/ rgya ba sar pa/ 'bro ji ri pa/ snye med pa bsod nams dpal/ bsnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ bla chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ kha char pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ de'i drung du nged kyis thob pa de khyed rnams la phul ba yin pas/ 'dis rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams gnang ba'i bar dang / de'i rjes su yang zhag grangs mang po zhig gi ring la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan mtha' yas la/ rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung rab tshad ldan rnams kyis brgyan pa'i bshad pa zhib tu gnang ba las/

rang gis gang zin tsam zin bris su bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/ 'dir dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor 'chad par byed pa la/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ngos gzung ba dang / ngos zin pa de nyid ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gang la brten pa'i bka' ngos gzung / de la bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i bshad srol ngos bzung ba/ khyad par 'phags pa de'i nang nas kyang gang bshad par bya ba dngos ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po bka' ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa de dag bsdu na/ theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'di theg pa chen po/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags gnyis las 'di sngags kyi theg pa/ de la rgyud sde bzhi yod pa las/ 'di rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ 'di la yang rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang / cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum yod pa las/ 'di cha mthun gyi rgyud/ de la mang po yod pa las/ 'di ni ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud la brtan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bshad srol la 'phags yul du byung tshul dang / gangs can du byung tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshig la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ don la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste/ yo ga la mkhas par grags pa mi gsum yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ lo chen rin bzang gi sku tshe'i stod la paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la zhus pa'i chos skor dang / sku tshe'i smad la paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la la zhus pa'i chos skor dang / jo bo rje bod du byon nas gsungs pa rtsa snur 'dzim gsum du grags pa rnams byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa khyad par 'phags pa ngos bzung ba ni/ 'phags yul gyi rnams las/ kun dga' snying po/ gangs khrod pa rnams las lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la dharmā pha la la zhus pa rnams yin la/ de yang lo chen gyis brag steng pa la gnang /

des mal la/ des sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba yin no/ /de'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa la/ rje btsun rin po ches 'chad thabs kyi man ngag gzhan phan spyi chings/ sa gong gcod par byed pa bsdus don/ 'bru gnyer bar byed pa mchan/ lag len dang nyams len ston par byed pa gzhan phan 'od zer dang nyer mkho rnams yin no/ /bzhi pa gang bshad par bya ba dngos ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i ras bris la brten pa gzhan phan mtha' yas/ de nyid rdul tshon dang sbyar ba rdul tshon kha skong / de gnyis ka la dgos pa cha gsum gtor ma ste/ 'di gsum ni gang bshad pa dang nyan par byed pa yin no/ /spyi don gnyis pa ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyong rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs spyir bstan pa dang / brtag pa dang po kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos btags ma phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ dkyil 'khor bcu bdun te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ste bcu gnyis/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bcu drug ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor te bcu bdun no/ /dang po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor dang drug 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs skyongs bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 'jigs byed dgus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/

gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dang drug go /yang dngos btags phye na zhe gcig tu 'gyur te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te so drug las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bzhi bcu/ ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor dang zhe gcig tu yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyams len bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan 'od zer gyi phyag len gyi rim pa rnams rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi nang du bkod pa ltar nyams su len par byed pa la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba rten dang mchod pa bsham pa ni/ rang gi gnas sam/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gnas shin tu yangs par phyag dar dang / rkyang snul legs par byas pa'i sar/ bla bre dang yol ba bkram la/ ras la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po'i steng du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor zhal 'jig rten pa'i shar du phyogs par bkram/ de'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor mchod yon gnyis pa/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri mchog byang du zhal zas rnams bsham mo/ /spyi mchod de'i phyi rol tu/ rgyas par na spos/ mar me/ lha bshos gsum tshan pa re re byas pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa bsham/ bsdu na spos mar me lha bshos gsum tshan pa re re byas pa phyogs bzhir bco lnga bco lnga bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su lho nub nas shar lho'i bar gtso bo'i zhal 'gros dang mthun par phyogs skyong 'byung po'i gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis mtheb kyus brgyan pa/

rigs drug dang yi dwags la zan ril bcu tshan gnyis/ bgegs la mtheb kyu gnyis ltag sprad/ de'i steng du mtheb kyu gcig bslangs nas bzhag pa ni/ sa steng sa 'og sa bla gsum gyi bgegs la ster ba yin gsungs/ yi dam gyi gtor ma ni sbyong rgyud nas ma bshad pas mi mdzad do/ /de ltar gtor ma lnga tshar du bsham pa phyag len no/ /de las gzhan pa'i yo byad ni/ /til nag gu gul nag po/ bye nag yungs kar/ khrus ras/ khrus long / gos zung la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bsham mo/ /rnal 'byor pa so so'i mdun du stegs bu'i steng du/ rang gi g.yas su rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu'i mtshal zhal rdo rje'i lte ba la bstan te bzhag gzhan yang rnga dang / dung dang / sil snyan la sogs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang 'tshogs par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun te/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa/ phyi rol tu phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la sogs pa rnams la gtor ma gtang ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang pa/ bdag dang gtso bo tha mi dad du bsgrubs te brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba/ gshin don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa la yang drug ste/ thog mar mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ lha grub pa'i rgyu gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ grub nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sgrub khang gi nang du zhugs par bsam pa'o/ /'di'i phyag rgya ni tshe dpag med las/ rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan la/ sngags ni kun rig nas 'byung ngo /

/de nas mchod pa bsang ba ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod pa la gnod byed kyi bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam mo/ /rdo rje'i me'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs brjod pa'i tshe phyag rgya de las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas mchod pa'i ma dag pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsam mo/ /bsang sbyangs gnyis ka'i sngags dang phyag rgya brtag pa dang po las gsungs so/ /swa bhā wa ni bla ma kha cig bzhed kyang dngos su ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang rung gsungs/ mchod pa'i snod bcud gnyis ka oṃ las bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'grel par gsungs so/ /de'ang oṃ ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi sa bon yin la/ nam mkha' mdzod las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas so/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag 'don ni oṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi rang sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya rnams ni gsang ba spyi rgyud la sogs las 'byung ngo / /dharmā ra ṇi'i rol sngags kyang rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni shāka thub las/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs dag la/ /thos nas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i lam med cing / /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /ces pas bstan/ ngag 'don ni bdag dang 'gro ba zhes pa nas/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med par rtogs 'gyur ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por brjod/ /ces pas bstod/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag 'don ni/ slob dpon kun snying gis rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par gsungs pa'i chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la zhes sogs te/

dgod par bya zhes pa yan gyis smon pa sems bskyed bstan/ de'i ched du nas bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan/ 'di lan gsum byed pa ni sems bskyed kyi cho ga yin pas shin tu legs gsungs/ gsum pa ni brtag pa dang po las/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ de la yang rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma'i man ngag gis rdo rje 'byung ba nas kha bskang ba ste/ de la yang drug thog mar sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ rigs kyi khro bo bsgom pa/ de la dbang bskur zhing go bsgo ba/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir bsnun bsreg bcing gsum bya ba/ phyin chad mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir las kha tshar ba bya ba'o/ /thog mar sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i dang po yid byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang po stong nyid bsam nas ni/ /lus can kun gyi dri ma bkru/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngag 'don ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa'i bar te/ de'i don bsgom pa ni/ yid ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ngag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rtsug dgu las/ rdo rje'i lce ru rab bsam pas/ /sngags bzlas mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang skad cig gis zhes pa nas/ dzi ha zhes pa'i bar te/ ngag 'don dang bsam bya dkyus bzhin du bsgom pa ni/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang ba byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa lus byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi zhes pa nas/ rtse gcig par gyur ces pa'i bar ni/ lus phyag rgya 'cha' ba la dbang bar bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa rigs kyi khro bo bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ gsod dang bskrod pa'i las rnams la/ /bsngags pa'i khro bo nga nyid de/ /me ltar 'bar ba zhes bya 'o/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngag 'don ni/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba zhes pa nas/ bzhugs par gyur pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa la dbang bskur zhing go bgo ba ni/ khro bo ti srin ta'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ/ zhes brjod pas khro bo'i nga rgyal bzung la/ phyag rgya de nyid spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs shing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na laka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes brjod pas/ gnas de rnams su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa gyen du langs pa re re'i rtsa ba rdo rje sngon po chu rgyugs kyis bcings par bsam/ go bgo ba ni/ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang pa/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig gnas snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /snying kha nu ma'i bar dang ni/ /snying kha mgrin pa rgyab dpral ba/ /dgur mdud pa bcings la/ rna ltag gnyis su 'gu gu chung la/ lhag ma lus tshad dang mnyam par bsam zhing / oṃ truṃ oṃ badz+ra tu khe ho/ zhes brjod cing thal mo rtse sprad la gsham gdab bo/ /bzhi pa bsnun bsreg bcing gsum ni/ rdo rje gsor zhing oṃ badz+ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe rdo rje de las de 'dra ba'i me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsnun par bsam/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya de las me 'od dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsreg par bsam/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ni tri sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya de las ye shes kyi srad bu kha dog sna lnga pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bcings bar bsam mo/ /lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ ḍi ḍ+ro'i sngags rgyas 'og phyogs rab bcings te/ /'jigs byed steng la gnod sbyin steng gi 'og /gtsug tor shar dang zhags pas shar gyi nang / /ba dan nub dang nag mo'i sngags rgyas byang / /rtse mo'i sngags rgyas lho phyogs bcing bar bya/

/zhes pa ltar rdo rje bsdams pa kha phub pa brkyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍ+ro sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas phung brdal ba ltar bsam mo/ /'jigs byed kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hu lu sogs brjod pa'i tshe steng du rdo rje'i gur gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ gur de'i 'og tu de dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i gur gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ druṃ sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ shar du gur steng ma dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hūm̐ sogs brjod pa'i tshe shar gyi de'i nang du gur nang ma dang mnyam pa'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje ba dan gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṃ sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ nub tu gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i ra ba gru bzhi gcig grub par bsam/ rdo rje nag mo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hri badz+ra ka li sogs brjod pas/ byang du gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam mo/ /khyad par rdo rje'i char yar phab par bsam mo/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ shrī sogs brjod pas lhor gur 'og ma dang mnyam pa'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa gcig grub par bsam/ de yang steng dang shar gnyis lan gnyis 'ching ba ni/ mgon po mngon byung gi rgyud las/ tshangs pa brgya byin mthu che bas/ /shar dang steng gnyis lan gnyis bcings/ /zhes gsungs/ lho rjes la 'ching ba ni/ gshin rje'i bu mo chu len ma/ /zhes bya ba 'gros shin tu bul bas lho rjes la 'ching ba yin gsungs/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ hūm̐ badz+ra karma zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ de dag thams cad kyi phyi rol tu sna tshogs rdo rje 'bum brtsigs su byas pa'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa gcig bsam/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ sogs brjod pas/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po gcig grub par bsam mo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa snying khar bkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ zhes brjod pas/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur grub par bsam mo/ /drug pa las kha tshar ba la brgyad de/ khro bo spyan drang ba/ de la gdan dbul zhing mchod bstod bya ba/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba/ bdag bsrung ba/ gnas bsrung ba/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba/ sems dpa' tha ma bzhi'i bsrung ba/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas brtan par bsam pa'o/ /dang po khro bo spyan drang ba sogs kyi tshigs bcad rnams ni mgon po mngon byung gi rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol gyis spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma las gdan dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa sogs nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po sogs nas/ gdon mi za zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bdag bsrung ba ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ snying kha/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su reg cing sum+bha ni sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ dpral bar rin po che ser po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyis rgyas gdab par bsam mo/ /gnas bsrung ba ni sngar gyi sngags rgya de nyid phyogs mtshams rnams su bstan pas/ sngar gyi srung 'khor de dag gsal gdab cing brtan par bsam pa'am/ yang na cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung bar bsam gsungs/ sems dpa' tha ma bzhi'i sngags rgyas kyang sngar gyi srung 'khor brtan par bsam zhing / yig brgya tshar gsum gyis kyang lhag chad kha bskongs shing brtan par bsam mo/ /srung 'khor rgyas pa'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba las/ de nas phyag na rdo rje rang gi sku ngo bo ste/

khro bo me nyi ma zhes bya ba'i snying po nyid kyi thugs kha nas phyung ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro ta sogs kyis bstan te/ 'di'i phyag na rdo rje ni sku mdog ljang sngon yin te/ pad+ma cod paṇa gyi rgyud las/ hūm̐ skyes phyag na rdo rje ni/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ /sku mdog ljang sngon cung zad khro/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhes pa dang mthun zhing / 'di ni rgyud gsung pa po'i phyag na rdo rje dang don gcig go gsungs so/ /ngag 'don ni/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar byas la/ de nas satwa dgu bskor gyi dang po gsum gyi pad bskor sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya gnas gsum du reg cing / dang pos lus lha bsgom pa la dbang / lus kyi bar chad bsrung / gnyis pas ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang / ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba gsum pas sems ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang ba dang / yid kyi bar chad bsrung ba'o/ /bar pa gsum gyi dang pos bsrung bskyed/ gnyis pas gsal btab/ gsum pas brtan par bsam pa'o/ /tha ma gsum gyis cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bar chad bsrung bar bsam mo/ /bzhi pa lha grub pa'i rgyu gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs nas gsal bar bstan cing / de yang rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a ā zhes sogs nas/ aṃ a zhes pa'i bar brjod pa'i g.yas kyi zla ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thabs snying rje chen po/ g.yon gyi zla ba ni/ spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab bo/ /de gnyis kyi steng gi g.yas kyi hūm̐ ni/ ye shes lnga dang / g.yon gyi a ni dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'o/

/de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs stong nyid bcu drug ni a li bcu drug gi rnam par shar ba'o/ /de'i hūm̐ la g.yas bskor dang / a la g.yon bskor bar bsam mo/ /g.yas kyi mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo rnams la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can la sogs pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga dang g.yon gyi mthe bong la sogs pa'i ser mo rnams la/ oṃ las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i yum la ste/ de dag thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gsal bar bsam cing / lha phan tshun mthong ba'i ye shes/ lam bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes so/ /thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/ a na yo ni a nu ga te sarba dharma zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ lha phan tshun reg pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las/ pha ra pha ra a nu tra bi tra sarba dharma zhes brjod pas/ phan tshun snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni/ sbyor lam bzod pa'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las/ badz+ra añca li a dhen ta a nu tra bi tra sarba dharmā zhes brjod pas phan tshun chu la chu bzhag pa dang / mar la mar bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres pa'i bde ba gang yin pa de ni sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ye shes so/ /phyag rgya phral te/ badz+ra ban+dha trad gsum brjod pas mthong spang gi dri ma bral bar bsam mo/ /rang gi snying khar zla ba la dang po'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang po'i rdo rje'am/ a dmar po'i rnam pa rang gi lus la char ltar babs pas lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes par bsam zhing / dang po'i rdo rje la thim par bsam mo/

/rdo rje bsdams pa bskyed cing / oṃ badz+ra a be sha a ā zhes pa bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod pas/ mthong lam gyi ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍo sogs nas/ badz+ra mu ṭi bam zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing / snying khar rdo rje bsdams pa bkrol la se gol lan gsum gtogs pas/ sgom lam sa dgu pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam mo/ /lnga pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa ni/ tshe dpag med las/ bdag gi de nyid dran bya zhing / /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /thams cad zos shing kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas lha bskyed pa bstan la/ ji ltar bskyed pa ni/ yang tshe dpag med las/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgoms par byas nas su/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsam zhing dam tshig phyag rgya dang / /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgya'i phyag rgya de byin brlab/ /steng 'og ji bzhin go rim du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dang / shāka thub las/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas bde gshegs bskyed rnams kyis/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/ /rtag tu pad+ma'i rigs nyid kyi/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying khar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim bzhin du brjod na/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis ye shes tshogs bsog bstan/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/

/zhes pas zla gdan bstan/ de'i 'og gi pad+ma ni gleng gzhi'i skabs nas/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ zhes pas bstan to/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /zhes pas sa bon bstan la/ bsam zhing dam tshig sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa bstan cing / sgrub pa pos ni sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis sku yongs su rdzogs pa bstan te/ rdo rje mchog gsum bskyed pa bstan pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi ngag 'don ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ bzhugs par gyur ces pa'i bar ro/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgya'i phyag rgya de byin brlab/ /ces pas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ sngags ni/ bh+rid ta sogs kun rig nas gsungs/ phyag rgya shāka thub las/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i dpral bar ni/ /sogs gong du bstan to/ /steng 'og ji bzhin go rim du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas dbang bskur ba bstan cing / sngags oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sogs phyag rdor nas gsungs so/ /phyag rgya kun rig nas 'byung ngo / /bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir ye shes pa 'jug pa ma bshad pas/ 'jug pa yang mi mdzad la/ de'i stobs kyis mjug tu gshegs gsol mi dgos pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no/ /'bras bu lha bskyed pa ni/ drug pa grub nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la lnga ste/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams ngan song nas drangs pa de dag gis ched du brjod pas ched du brjod cing mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba/ slar yang bzlas pa'i sgo nas gzhan don ji ltar bya ba/ dngos grub blangs shing yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs pa/ slar yang mchod bstod bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ tshangs pa chen po zhes pa nas/ gsol to zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni e ma ho zhes pa nas bzhag ces pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni gleng gzhi'i skabs nas gsungs so/

/bstod pa ni me ltar 'bar ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan brgya rtsa'i sgo nas bstod pa ste/ de'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas mtshan bcu ni/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas sogs sh+lau ka phyed gnyis kyis bstan/ rdo rje rgyal po'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /sogs dang / rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje pad+ma byang chub la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje las kyi sgo nas drug ni/ rdo rje rgyud sde gnod sbyin la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje bsrung ba'i sgo nas brgyad ni/ rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas dgu ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi sgo nas dgu ni/ bsgrub bka' bsgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen gyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ 'od stug pa ni sogs so/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sgo nas drug ni/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ sgra chen zhing ni la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgo nas lnga ni/ glog bzhin zhal gyi la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje chos kyi sgo nas drug ni/ spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje rnon po'i sgo nas lnga ni/ 'khyil shing rgyan yang la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje smra ba'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba la sogs pa tshig rkang bzhi ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' ma gtogs gzhan thams cad tshig rkang pa bzhi bzhis bstan te/ de ltar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag su la mnga' na/ chos brgyud sangs rgyas la mnga' ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de la'o/

/lnga pa slar yang bzlas pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ de dag dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgyad rtsa nyid du tshang bar bzla/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i skabs 'dir brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzla bar bya'o/ /bsgom bzlas gnyis dkyus bzhin no/ /spyir sbyong rgyud bshad pa'i skabs su bsnyen pa bsgrub pa las sbyor zhes pa'am/ bsnyen pa dang dkyil 'khor las rim gnyis zhes bshad pa las/ bsnyen pa'i skabs re zhig bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor las rim gyi dbang du byas pa'i bdag bskyed do/ /lnga pa dngos grub blangs shing yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba sogs kyang dkyus bzhin no/ /drug pa slar yang mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rgyud nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len no/ /gnyis pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rnam rgyal bum pa dri'i chu/ /rab tu bkang ste gzhag par bya/ /zhes rnam rgyal bum pa bstan la/ dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni gzhag par bya/ /zhes pas dbang bum bstan cing / gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /zhes pas mchod bum bstan la/ las bum ni 'dir ma bshad pas mi mdzad de/ tshe dpag med las/ mar me gtor ma bum pa dang / /zhes pa dang / kun rig las/ bya dang bum pa rkang pa dang / /zhes pas bum pa 'di'i las bum bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ des ni nye bar mkho ba'i bum pa bstan pa yin no/ /spyir bum pa'i tshad/ mtshan nyid phye ba/ bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa dang / phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du 'dod pa dang / bum nang du gzhal yas khang rdzogs par bskyed pa dang / nang gi chu dang bum rdzas rnams lha'i rgyur byas nas bskyed pa dang 'dod lugs mang du byung yang / rang lugs ni bum pa chu dang rdzas so so'i sum gnyis tsam gang ba'i chu'i steng du so so'i gdan gyi steng du lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa ste/

ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /bum rdzas ni/ dpung bzang las/ mu ge'i bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /nas sran gro 'bras til dang lnga/ /'bras bu sna lnga bum par gzhug /nad kyi bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /sle tres kan rgyu ka ri dang / /rgya mtsho shu thag dbang po lag /sman sna lnga yang bum par blug /mtshon gyi bskal pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /mu men byu ru la sogs pa'i/ /rin chen lnga yang bum par blug /tshul khrims rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /dza ti ga pur gur gam dang / /tsan+da dkar dmar a ka ru/ /dri sna lnga yang bum par blug /kun gyi snying por gyur pas na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'o ma bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /mar dang lañcha la sogs pa'i/ /snying po lnga yang bum par blug /gzhan yang bum pa'i tshad dang mtshan nyid sogs rgyas par shes par 'dod na/ 'phags pa rin po che'i bum pa'i rnam bshad las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa la don bcu ste/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba/ de la byon legs bya zhing mchod yon dbul ba/ khrus gsol zhing gdan dbul pa/ mchod pa dbul zhing phyag 'tshal ba/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab cing las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba can/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyi ru ni/ /gling bzhi po dag bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa bri/ /zhes pas dngos su 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug bstan la/ shugs kyis dkyil 'khor sgo nyis sbrags bstan pa yin no/ /'o na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gang gis bstan na/ brtag pa dang po las/ gtso bo bris sku lugs ma'ang rung /

/rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces pas bstan la/ ngag 'don ni/ yak+ṣa nas/ gdan dang bcas par gyur ces sogs te dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra ba/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhes pas gtso bo bskyed pa bstan nas/ 'khor gzhan rnams ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor mang po rnams ni zhes sogs kyis bstan cing / sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje 'byung ba sogs nas kha bskang pa'o/ /bskyed tshul ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ sarba bid zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis cung zad zhib par bshad na/ dang po rten bskyed pa la/ bskyed pa dngos dang / bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gsal btab pa'o/ /dang po dngos ni oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ sha sogs nas/ so so'i gdan rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar ro/ /de yang sha zhes pa ni sha'i sgra las drangs pas shu n+yā ta yin pas/ gnyis ka'am gang rung gis chog go /bha las bskyed pa ni 'byung bzhi'i skad dod la bha wa bha yu zhes pa ste yod cing 'byung ba'i don yin pas dngos po thams cad la 'jug la/ 'dir ni 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i don yin te/ bha wa wa yu zhes pa 'byung ba rlung / bha wa a na la 'byung ba me/ bha wa u da ka zhes pa 'byung ba chu/ bha wa bhu mi zhes pa 'byung ba sa ste/ de rnams kyi ming gi yi ge dang po yin pas so/ /gnyis pa gsal gdab pa la/ 'og gzhi/ logs/ steng thog sgo/ rta babs so/ /'og gzhi ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs mtshan ma can gyi 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab gru bzhi lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can no/

/logs la rtsig pa/ pha gu/ dra ba/ dra phyed/ mda' yab/ pu shu'o/ /rtsig pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje gru bzhi pa rgyar nub nas shar gyi bar la cha chen bcu gnyis yod pa'i dbus nas bgrangs pa'i lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab pa'i mtha' nang ma'i steng du rtsig pa lnga sbrags ni/ zheng du cha phran gcig dpang du cha phran bcu drug dkyus su sgo'i bug pa'i thad ma gtogs zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba/ sgo'i bug pa nas sgo glegs kyi bar du song ba'o/ /pha gu ni/ rtsig pa'i steng du kha dog ser po/ dpang du cha phran gcig zheng du cha phran phyed dang gnyis las phyed phyi ngos su 'phyar du yod pa dkyus su zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba'o/ /dra phyed ni/ pha gu'i steng du bar stong gi dod yin pas/ stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ bre 'phul bzhi brtsegs zheng cha phran re re/ dkyus su 'og ma cha phran gang pa/ steng ma rnams g.yas g.yon du cha phran phyed phyed kyis ring du song ba/ phyogs re rer brgyad brgyad/ zur rnams su re re ste sum cu so drug go /de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb dpang thig skud gang pa/ dkyus zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ga ra'i kha nas mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed cha phran gnyis kyi bar thur du 'phyang ba ste/ slob dpon dpal 'bras rdo rjes/ mu tig gi chun 'phyang gi dbus na nor bu'i rgyan yod pa'i dra ba dang / rgyan med pa ni dra ba phyed pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /mda' yab ni/ phyi'i gser gyi gdung leb dang / nang gi rdo rje'i gdung gru bzhi pa mnyam pa'i steng du lcam btang ste thog brtsigs pa'i phyi na 'dod snam cha phran gnyis yod pa khebs pa'i bar gru bzhir phub pa'i lcam sne la rin po che'i rgyan spyi blugs mchu bcad pa lta bu thur du cha phran gcig gi bar 'phyang ba zur nas zur gyi bar du'o/ /pu shu ni/ rin po che'i dra ba seng mas bskor ba'i dra mig gi nang na rin po che mig gsum pa yod pa gyen du cha phran gcig 'grengs pas zur nas zur gyi bar brgyan par byas pa'o/

/de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyogs bzhir lha snam dpang du cha phran re re/ zheng du cha chen re re pa zur thig gis bcad pa phyogs mdog can/ de'i dbus su chu shel las grub pa'i gar pu/ dpang du cha chen bzhi pa rgyar cha chen drug yod pa'i steng gi zheng phyi'i dbang du byas nas cha chen drug nang gi dbang du byas pa'i cha chen bcu gnyis te/ dbus nas bgrangs pa'i cha chen lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab pa'i mtha' nang ma'i steng du rtsig pa lnga sbrags zheng du cha phran gcig dpang du cha phran bcu drug dkyus su sgo'i bug pa'i thad ma gtogs zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba/ sgo'i bug pa'i thad nas sgo logs kyi bar du song ba'o/ /de'i steng du pha gu kha dog ser po dpang du cha phran gang / zheng du cha phran phyed gnyis yod pa'i phyed phyir 'phyar du yod pa/ dkyus su zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba'o/ /de'i steng du dra phyed ni bar stong gi don yin pas/ stong pa'i rang bzhin la rin po che'i bre 'phul bzhi 'og ma 'og ma rnams las steng ma steng ma rnams g.yas g.yon du cha phran phyed phyed kyis ring ba phyogs bzhir brgyad brgyad/ zur bzhir re re ste sum cu rtsa drug 'god pa'o/ /de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb dpang thig skud gang pa/ zheng cha phran gcig dkyus zur nas zur gyi bar tal por song ba/ de'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ga ra'i kha nas dra ba dra phyed cha phran gnyis kyi tshad thur du 'phyang ba'o/ /mda' yab ni gser gyi gdung leb dang gdung zlum mnyam pa'i steng du lcam btang ste thog phub pa rtsig pa'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab kyi tshul cha phran gnyis 'phyar du yod pa khor mor phub pa'i lcam sne la spyi blugs mchu bcad pa lta bu cha phran gcig thur du 'phyang bas khor mor brgyan pa'o/ /pu shu ni rin po che'i grwa mig gi nang du rin po che'i mig gsum pa yod pa'am/

rdo ka ma shi las byas pa'i mchod rten lta bu gyen du 'grengs pas 'khor mor brgyan pa'o/ /gsum pa steng thog ni/ shel gyi gar bu dang lha snam 'byar ba'i tshang thig gi g.yas g.yon nas cha chen re re dor ba'i sar ka ba cha phran bcu drug pa/ phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis/ zur bzhir re re ste bcu gnyis 'dzugs/ ka ba'i steng du gzhu ring thung la cha phran gang dang thig skud gang / de'i steng du gdung gru bzhi pa la cha phran gang / de dang phyi'i gser gyi gdung leb mnyam pa'i steng du lcam btang la thog phub pa nang ngos su gdung gru bzhi pa la cha phran phyed dang gsum gyi bar 'phyar du med pa/ shel gyi gar bu non tsam la nang ma'i rta babs dang reg tsam phub pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang nang ma'i rtsig pa'i nang du lha snam phyogs mdog can dpang du cha phran gang zheng du cha chen re re yod pa'i nang du 'khor lo 'god pa'i rten dpang du cha chen gcig pa/ de'i steng du 'khor lo'i rtsibs la cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng du lte ba'i mu khyud la cha phran gnyis yod pa'i mu khyud kyi steng du ka ba dpang du cha phran dgu pa phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis te brgyad 'dzugs/ ka ba'i steng du gzhu ring thung la cha phran gang dang thig skud gang / de'i steng du gdung zlum cha phran gang zlum por btang / gzhal yas khang nang ma'i phyi'i gser gyi gdung leb dang gdung zlum mnyam pa'i steng nar lcam btang la thog phub pa/ phyi ni sngar bshad zin la/ nang ngos ni gdung zlum dang mnyam por byas te/ bya 'dab kyi sne mo la mda' yab/ pu shu ni sngar ltar ro/ /gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa zlum po phyogs mdog can dpang du cha phran gsum brtsigs/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gang / de steng dra ba dra phyed dang gser gyi gdung leb la cha phran gnyis/ de rnams zlum po'o/ /de'i steng du thal gdung dpang cha phran gang pa gru bzhi btang pa'i dbus kyi dra mig ma gtogs gzhan dra mig rnams la lcam btang la phub pa'i phyi'i bya 'dab kyi lcam sne la mda' yab dang /

pu shu ni sngar bzhin la dbus kyi re mig gru bzhir yod pa'i gdung gru bzhi pa'i steng du gtso bo'i sku mdog ltar brtsig pa kha dog dkar po/ dpang du cha phran gsum du thig skud gang chag pa gru bzhir brtsig de'i steng du pha gu dra phyed gser gyi gdung leb mda' yab pu shu rnams ni snga ma bzhin la gru bzhir byed pa'o/ /gser gyi gdung leb kyi steng nar thal lcam btang la thog phub la dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog cha chen gang gis brgyan pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang phyi ma nas nang mar 'gro sa ni/ gzhal yas khang nang ma'i sgo bzhi'i thad kyi shel gyi gar bu la sgam spras kyi rnam pa lta bu'i them skas kyi phreng ba yod pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang 'di la rgya mnyam dpang mnyam gyi don tshang ste gzhal yas khang dpang mnyam gyi don tshang ste gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i rtsig pa'i nang ngos nas nang ngos kyi bar la cha chen brgyad yod pa ltar/ shel gyi gar bu nas khang bzang gru bzhi pa'i gser gyi gdung leb man la phyi'i dbang du byas pa'i cha chen brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gzhal yas khang nang ma la yang tshang ste/ nang ma'i rtsig pa'i shar nub kyi nang ngos nas nang ngos bar la nang ma rang gi cha chen brgyad yod pa ltar/ nang ma'i rtsig pa'i rtsa ba nas khang bzang gru bzhi pa'i gser gyi gdung leb man la nang gi cha chen brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgo ni/ gzhal yas khang gnyis kyi rtsig pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i sgo/ mdun ngos su sgo khyud/ g.yas g.yon du sgo 'gram/ mdun ngos su sgo logs rnams la/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi nang ngos mnyam pas cha phran bzhi bzhi/ sgo 'gram dang sgo logs kyi nang mnyam pas cha phran gnyis gnyis/ sgo logs kyi phyi ngos la cha phran gsum yod pa ni rtsig gdong sags ga can du yod pas so/ /sgo'i dpang la cha phran brgyad/ sgo 'gram dang / sgo khyud sgo logs rnams kyi dpang cha phran dgu'o/

/lnga pa rta babs ni/ sgo 'gram dang sgo logs kyi phyi ngos su cha phran re re song ba'i sar ka ba dang ka brgyan la dpang du cha phran lnga yod pa g.yas g.yon du bzhi bzhi 'dzugs/ yas bub tha ma rdo rje'i gdung ni dpang dang zheng la cha phran re re yod pa ka rgyan nas ka rgyan gyi bar du gtong / de'i steng du mdun ngos kyi snam bu dang po dbyibs thig shing lta bu dpang dang zheng la cha phran re re/ dkyus su cha phran bcu drug yod pa gcig gtong / de'i steng du snam bu gnyis pa dbyibs sogs 'dra ba la dkyus su cha phran bcu bzhi gtong / de'i steng du snam bu gsum pa dbyibs sogs 'dra ba la dkyus su cha phran bcu gnyis gtong / de'i steng du snam bu bzhi pa dbyibs sogs 'dra ba la dkyus su cha phran bcu gtong / g.yas g.yon gyi snam bu rnams dbyibs sogs gong bzhin/ dkyus su cha phran bzhi yod pa dang po ka rgyan gyi steng du gtong / gnyis pa ka ba'i steng du/ gsum pa mun pa'i/ bzhi pa sgo logs kyi steng du gtong / mdun ngos kyi snam bu ngos mnyam por yod kyang kha dog mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa yin te/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ bsam gtan dag pas rta babs bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /g.yas g.yon gyi snam bu rnams ni bang rim du yod pa'o/ /sgo 'gram gyi steng du gdung dpang zheng la cha phran re re/ dkyus su cha phran brgyad yod pa gcig gtong la/ de dang snam bu mnyam pa'i steng du lcam gtang la thog phub/ de'i steng du pad+ma la dpang du cha phran gang / zheng cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng du chos 'khor la zheng dang dpang gnyis ka la cha phran gnyis re/ gdugs yu la cha phran gang / gdugs dngos la cha chen gcig tog la cha phran gang yod pa'o/ /pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon du cha phran re song ba'i sar ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra gnyis chos 'khor la kha phyogs pa/ de nas cha phran re re song sar gdugs 'dzin gyi spre'u re re yod pa'o/

/de'i phyir 'khyam kha dog sna tshogs pa/ de'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i khor yug sngon po/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /gdan ni gzhal yas khang gi nang du seṅge'i khri sogs nas so so'i gdan sogs gsal gdab pa rten bskyed pa'o/ /brten pa bskyed pa ni/ rigs lnga dang yum bzhi snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa yin pas yongs su gyur pa las brjod dgos so/ /sems dpa' bcu drug dang / sgeg sogs brgyad/ sgo ba bzhi rnams sa bon las bskyed do/ /gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha rnams dang / 'jig rten pa'i khor yug gi lha rtsa rig yongs su gyur pa las bskyed do/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i lha ni/ yo ga rgyal po'i tshul du gsungs pa yin pas/ rigs lnga ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ yum bzhi ni de rnams kyi btsun mo/ sems dpa' bcu drug ni de dag gi thugs kyi sras/ sgeg sogs bzhi ni de dag gi btsun mo/ bdug pa ma sogs bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhi ni de dag gi g.yog dang pho nya dang bran la sogs pa yin no/ /de la sogs pa thams cad gtso bo'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba yin te/ gtso bo de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i ye shes bzhi ni rigs bzhi dang / tshad med bzhi ni yum bzhi dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab bcu drug sems dpa' bcu drug dang / phar phyin bcu las/ shes rab dang / ye shes kyi phar phyin spyi khyab tu btang pas sgeg sogs brgyad/ bdud bzhi 'joms par byed pa'i dad pa sogs bzhi sgo ba bzhi/ thugs kyi sprul pa skal bzang bcu drug gsung gi sprul pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sku'i sprul pa nyan thos bcu drug yon tan gyi sprul pa khro bo bcu drug 'phrin las kyi sprul pa khor yug pa rnams so/ /gzhal yas khang ni lha re re'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ni de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i mi mthun pa'i bar chad 'joms par nus pa'i nus mthu yin te/

rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gtso bo nas brtsams me ri'i bar/ /gtso bo nyid kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /ma gtogs rgyud ni tha dad dang / /rten dang brten pa rdzas tha dad/ /gnas pa'i rnam par gzhag pa ni/ /rgyud dang gong ma'i gzhung bzang dang / /dam pa'i gsung las thos ma myong / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ spyan 'dren tshul ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sh+lau ka gsum po 'di ma ga ta bzang mo'i rtogs brjod las 'byung ngo zhes zer yang / sngon gyi rab gnas mkhan po zhig gis mdzad dam zhes rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsungs so/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka bzhi ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rab gnas kyi cho gar gsungs so/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥnas/ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyi bar shāka thub nas gsungs/ de la byon legs bya zhing mchod yon dbul ba yang slob dpon kun snying gis gsungs/ khrus gsol ba/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig ni/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs/ gdan dbul ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs sh+lau ka gcig ste kun snying gis gsungs/ mchod pa ni/ lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ /sogs sh+lau ka lnga ni/ legs grub kyi rgyud las gsungs so/ /phyag 'tshal ba oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ ka ro mi zhes pa'i bar rdo rje 'byung ba nas gsungs/ dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang por/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥgyi'i bdag tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /rdo rje bcing bas bcing ba nyid/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du rtse sbyar te/ /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du sbrel/ /mthe bong gnyis ni nang du gzhug /bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan te/ sngags rgya ni dkyus bzhin no/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa gong du bshad pa bzhin no/

/mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'dir dbang mi bskur bar dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par/ kun rig gi mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ dbang mi bskur bar rigs bdag rang chas can du bsgom pa'o/ /gsungs pa la dgongs nas/ rje btsun gyis gzhan phan 'od zer du ma gsungs/ de'i phyir gzhan phan mtha' yas su yang ma gsungs pas mi mdzad do/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab cing las la sbyar ba ni rje btsun chen pos bka' dang bstan bcos gzhan nas bshad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab 'dir ma gsungs kyang / kho bo ni 'dir phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs yod par mngon te/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dngos su gsungs la/ chos kyi phyag rgya ni lha so so'i sngags brjod pa tsam la bshad cing / las kyi phyag rgya ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ de nyid gnyis su byas te gar byas nas las kyi'o zhes pas las rgya bstan la/ phyag rgya chen po ni shugs las 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de'ang las rgya ni rang gi dku g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyar la/ oṃ na mo nas/ bud+dha ya zhes pa'i bar brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phral nas gnas gsum du gar bskor bya zhing / tad+ya thā nas swāhā'i bar brjod pa gtso bo'i las rgya dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa sogs ni gtso bo'i chos rgya'o/ /lte ba'i thad kar mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya 'cha' ba ni gtso bo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /gtso bo'i sku la rtog pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /se gol gtog cing / sems can thams cad ngan song nas 'don pa'i 'phrin las mdzod ces pa ni las la sbyar ba'o/ /nang sgeg bzhi'i dam rgya sogs de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs/ byang sems nyan rang gi dam rgya la mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti'i dkyil chog ltar/ de'ang brtag pa dang po las/ thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba las/

/gung mo srin lag rtse mnyam bsgrengs/ /mthe chung gnyis ni nang du bcug /mdzub mo gnyis ni bkug byas te/ /cer ba byang sems spyi yi/ /nyan thos kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar ba/ /snying khar sbyar ba nyan thos kyi'o/ /zhes dang / rang rgyal gyi phyag rgya ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur nang bstan te/ /mdzub mo mthe bong rtse mnyam bsgrengs/ /g.yas pas mtheb srin sbyar brang sprad/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi phyag rgya 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ nang sgeg bzhi'i dam rgya ma gtogs dam rgya gzhan rnams sbyong rgyud rang nas gsungs so/ /bcu pa mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ arka mchog brtag gsang la sogs pa yi/ /dbyangs snyan pa yis bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ arga mchog brtag ces pa nyer spyod phyi'i mchod pa bstan la/ gsang zhes pas gsang mchod bstan cing / sogs pa yi zhes pa'i sogs khong nas mchod pa nyer lnga pa bstan pa yin no/ /dbyangs snyan pa yis bstod dang zhes pas bstod pa bstan la/ lha rdzas kyi mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod ces pas/ lha rdzas kyi mchog rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga bstan pa yin no/ /phyi mchod rgyas par byed na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma dang / stong gsum ma/ chu bo gaṅgā ma la sogs pa mdzad pa phyag len te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma ni/ de nyid 'dus par lhug par gsungs pa skyang pho chos blos tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'o/ /stong gsum ma dang / chu bo gaṅgā ma ni/ lo chen rin bzang gis gsungs so/ /mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pas te gleng gzhi'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / /gsang mchod/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' dhū pe na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang brgyad po 'di ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs so/ /rin chen sna bdun dang /

'dod yon lnga ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs so/ /bstod pa/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces pa nas/ dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka drug po 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ tis gsungs so/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhi ni sbyong rgyud rang gi dngos bstan no/ /sgeg mo phreng ba sogs sh+lau ka gnyis ni rje btsun gyis gsungs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka bcu drug ni rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs/ rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka bcu gnyis ni smṛ tis gsungs/ brtag pa dang po las/ sgo yi 'khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /zhes pa nas 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar sh+lau ka lnga ni rje btsun gyis gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i bstod chen gyi phyag rgya rnams ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gu ge mtho ling gser gyi lha khang na/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos bzhengs pa'i kun rig lha tshogs rnams kyi bzhugs tshul dang / phyag mtshan gyi 'dzin lugs la gzigs nas/ de'i don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa rnams mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rjes zin bris su btab yod pa la/ phyis gsham shog dpe 'khyar nas/ rdo rje gar ma man ma tshang ba'i kha skong rnams/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun phyag len bzhin/ byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung zhes phyag rgya rnams dngos su ston par mdzad cing / tshigs bcad rnams zhal nas gsungs pa ni 'di ltar/ gang gi mkhyen rab rin chen lham me ba/ /shes bya'i rgyal mtshan bzang po'i rtser son nas/ /thub bstan khang chen rgyan gyur lo tsā ba/ /rin chen bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la btud nas de nyid las 'ongs pa'i/

/kun rig bstod ring kun gyi dril stabs dang / /phyag rgya 'ching tshul phyag len ji bzhin du/ /legs par mthong nas legs bca' 'dir brjod bya/ /bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung lus bsrings nas/ /lag g.yon dril bu snying kha'i thad du sil/ /g.yas pa de steng rdo rje sen bskor bya/ /de ni tshig rkang dang po'i phyag rgya ste/ /gnyis pa gar gyi bskor ba mdzes par bya/ /gsum pa rang rang lha yi phyag chen bcings/ /bzhi pa pad bskor cung zad sngon 'gro ba'i/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba'i bstod phyag lags/ /phyag chen rnams ni rim bzhin 'dir brjod na/ /lag g.yon thal mo brkyangs pa skyil krung steng / /gan rkyal bzhag ste g.yas kyang de bzhin bzhag /mthe bong rtse sprad rnam snang phyag chen te/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po'ang de dang khyad par med/ /lag g.yon skyil krung steng du gong bzhin bzhag /lag g.yas gan rkyal pus mo g.yas kyi steng / /brkyangs pa rgyal mchog rin chen phyag rgya 'o/ /lag g.yas thal mo brkyangs pa snying kha'i thad/ /gyen bslangs kha phyir bstan la mtheb mdzub sbyar/ /g.yon pa de 'dra nang bstan kha sprad pa/ /shākya ri dbang zhes bya'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag g.yon rnam par snang mdzad dang 'dra zhing / /g.yas pa snying khar thal brkyangs gyen bslang ste/ /kha phyir bstan pa me tog cher rgyas so/ /lag g.yas thal mo brkyangs pa snying kha'i thad/ /gan rkyal bzhag ste mtheb mdzub sbyar ba ni/ /yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phyag chen yin/ /de las mtheb mdzub sbyar ba steng byas nas/ /mthe bong lag mthil bkug pa sor mos mnan/ /mā ma ki zhes bya ba'i phyag chen no/ /lag g.yas thal mo brkyangs pa gyen bslang ste/ /mtheb mdzub sbyar ba snying kha g.yas pa'i thad/ /kha phyir bstan pa gos dkar mo yi 'o/ /de las mtheb mdzub sbyar ba steng byas te/ /mtheb srin sbyar ba rje btsun sgrol ma'i yin/ /'di bzhi lag pa g.yon pa gdan brten no/

/mthe bong lag mthil bkug pa'i phyi rol nas/ /sor mo sdom pa'i rdo rje khu tshur te/ /lag g.yon de 'dra byas pa kha gyen bstan/ /dku g.yon brten pa'i g.yas pa mā ma ki /'dra bar byed pa de ni rdor sems so/ /lag g.yon khu tshur nang bstan snying kha'i thad/ /g.yas pa de 'dra nu g.yas steng thad du/ /kha nang bstan pa rdo rje rgyal po'i yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur nu ma g.yon pa'i thad/ /'phred la cung zad kha phyir bstan la bzhag /snying khar g.yas pa'i khu tshur kha gyen bstan/ /bzhag pa de ni rdo rje chags pa'i 'o/ /snying kha'i thad du lag pa'i khu tshur gnyis/ /phan tshun kha sbyar mdzub mo phyir la 'phangs/ /rdo rje legs pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin/ /lag g.yon rdor sems 'dra la g.yas pa yi/ /khu tshur dpral ba'i skra mtshams kha nang bstan/ /'phred la bzhag pa rdo rje rin chen no/ /lag g.yas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'dra ba la/ /cung zad bskor tshul byas pa gzi brjid do/ /lag g.yas khu tshur nu ma g.yon pa'i steng / /kha nang bstan pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan no/ /lag g.yas khu tshur gyen bslangs kha yi g.yas/ /kha phyir bstan pa rdo rje bzhad pa'i ste/ /gsum po lag g.yon gdan la brten pa 'o/ /lag g.yon rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra zhing / /g.yas pa'i khu tshur snying thad kha nang bstan/ /mtheb mdzub sbyar ba cung zad nang nas bskor/ /rdo rje chos zhes bya ba'i phyag chen yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying thad kha nang bstan/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur dpung pa g.yas pa'i thad/ /kha phyir bstan pa rdo rje rnon po'i yin/ /lag g.yas khu tshur lte ba'i thad ka ru/ /kha phyir bstan pa'i gung mo bslang byas nas/ /cung zad bskor ba rdo rje rgyu yi lags/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyen bstan kha thad nas/ /snying khar phab pa rdo rje smra ba'i yin/ /gnyis po g.yon pa gdan la brten pa 'o/ /lag gnyis rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra bar/ /byas pa de ni rdo rje las kyi 'o/

/lag gnyis khu tshur gyen bslangs kha phyir bstan/ /rang rang dpung pa'i thad bzhag bsrung ba'i yin/ /lag gnyis khu tshur 'phred la kha nang bstan/ /kha 'gram g.yas g.yon bzhag pa gnod sbyin no/ /lag g.yon khu tshur dku g.yon kha gyen bstan/ /de steng g.yas pa'i khu tshur kha phub bzhag /'di ni rdo rje khu tshur phyag rgya 'o/ /lag gnyis khu tshur kha ni gyen bstan pa/ /'gying pa'i tshul gyis dpyi zur gnyis su bzhag /rdo rje sgeg mo zhes bya'i phyag chen no/ /lag gnyis khu tshur gyen bslangs kha phyir bstan/ /mig zur gnyis nas dpung pa'i steng thad bzhag /rdo rje phreng ba ma yi phyag rgya yin/ /lag g.yon khu tshur gyen bslang dpung g.yon thad/ /kha nang bstan pa'i mkhrig ma cung zad tsam/ /snying kha'i phyogs su bkug pa'i gru mo'i mdun/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur kha gyen bstan pa yin/ /pi wang bsgyur tshul rdo rje glu ma'i yin/ /lag g.yas thal mo gyen bslang kha nang bstan/ /lag ngar nang du g.yon pa'i thal mo'i nang bstan bslang / /gnyis ka g.yas su bskor zhing bsgyur ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i thal mo rna ba g.yas thad bslang / /g.yon pa'i thal mo lag ngar phyi ru bslang / /g.yon pa'i phyogs la'ang de bzhin gar ma'i 'o/ /lag gnyis khu tshur snying thad 'og tu phub/ /rdo rje bdug spos ma yi phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa khu tshur snying thad kha gyen bstan/ /de steng g.yas pa khu tshur thur du phub/ /de nas gyen du 'thor tshul me tog ma/ /lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying thad gshibs/ /mthe bong gyen du bsgrengs te g.yas su bskor/ /rdo rje mar me ma yi phyag chen yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying thad kha gyen bstan/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyen bslangs kha phyir bstan/ /dri yi byug tshul dri chab ma yi 'o/ /lag gnyis rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag chen bzhin/ /lcags kyu 'dzin tshul byed pa lcags kyu'i 'o/ /pad bskor 'phro la lag gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol/

/so sor gyes nas pus mo gnyis lta bu/ /khu tshur kha phub bzhag pa zhags pa'i 'o/ /pad bskor 'phro la lag gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol/ /so sor gyes nas pus mo gnyis steng du/ /khu tshur gyen bstan bzhag ste lcags sgrog go /lag g.yas rdo rje dril bu spyi bor dkrol/ /lag g.yon gdan la brten pa dril bu'i 'o/ /de nas skal bzang bcu drug phyag chen ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag chen ji bzhin no/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur nu ma g.yas pa'i thad/ /kha nang bstan pa mkhar sil 'dzin tshul dang / /g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying thad kha gyen bstan/ /lhung bzed 'dzin tshul nyan thos phyag chen yin/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur snying thad kha nang bstan/ /mkhar sil 'dzin tshul yin no g.yon pa ni/ /khu tshur gyen bstan nu ma g.yon gyi thad/ /glegs bam 'dzin tshul rang rgyal bcu gnyis so/ /pad bskor 'phro la khu tshur rgyab sprod bya/ /mthe chung gnyis ni lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ /sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba 'jig rten gsum snang sogs/ /pad bskor 'phro la lag gnyis pad+mo'i tshul/ /'jig rten 'khor yug rnams kyi phyag chen no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa phyogs skyong dang 'byung po sogs la gtor ma gtang ba ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /ces pas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma bstan la/ de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma byin/ /zhes pas 'byung po'i gtor ma ston zhing / sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /zhes pas rigs drug dang / yi dwags kyi gtor ma bstan la/ gnod sbyin srin po kha zas su/ /bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas bgegs gtor bstan pa yin no/ /ji ltar gtong tshul ni dpung bzang nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad de/ 'di la yang phyogs skyong / 'byung po/ bgegs gtor dang gsum/ dang po la rdzas dang / mgron dang / mjug gi cho ga oṃ da sha sogs/ dang gsum/ dang po la bsang ba/ yak+ṣa sogs/

sbyang ba/ dzā la sogs/ byin gyis brlab pa a ka ro sogs/ dang gsum/ gnyis pa mgron gyi bya ba la/ spyan drang pa/ phyogs skyong sogs/ gdan la bzhugs pad+ma ka sogs/ pa/ phyag rgya bstan oṃ in+d+ra ya sogs 'gre/ pa/ mchod pa 'bul da sha sogs/ ba/ bstod pa dbang sogs/ bya ba/ gtor ma oṃ in+t+ra ya/ btang ba/ 'phrin las bcol shar phyogs/ ba/ chos kyi sbyin chos rnams/ pa/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol bsrung ma/ ba gdab pa dang dgu/ gnyis pa 'byung po'i gtor ma la/ rdzas dang / mgron dang / me tog gi oṃ sarba lo ka cho ga dang gsum/ dang po la bsang yak+ṣa/ ba/ sbyang dz+wa la/ ba/ byin gyis brlab a ka ro/ pa gsum/ gnyis pa mgron gyi bya ba la/ spyan drang lha dang / ba/ gdan la sarba/ bzhugs pa/ mchod pa sarba/ bya ba/ gtor ma 'bul de la/ ba/ 'phrin las bcol 'byung po/ ba/ chos kyi chos rnams/ sbyin pa/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab 'byung po/ pa dang bdun/ gsum pa bgegs kyi gtor ma la/ mgron gyi na mo/ bya ba/ mchod pa gum ka bya ba/ gtor ma gum ka ro/ gtang ba/ bden pa'i stobs rgyan gyi/ brjod pa/ 'phrin las gzhol oṃ chen po'am/ ba/ bgegs bskrad pa oṃ sarba bigh+na gats+tsha sogs/ dang drug go /lnga pa dbang la gnyis/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ brtag pa dang po las/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas su/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu brtag /ces pa dang / bdag nyid kyis ni dbang yang blang / /zhes pas bstan te/ rang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa sor chud par bya ba'i phyir/ slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba zhig rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/

sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub tu/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la yang gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang / dbang gi dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po 'jug pa la yang gnyis/ sta gon dang / 'jug pa dngos so/ /dang po sta gon la bdun/ yon dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sems bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa/ bsrung ba bya ba'o/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas ci 'byor pa yi yon yang dbul/ /zhes pas bstan te/ maṇ+ḍal dbul tshul dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gis slob dpon gsol ba btab/ /de nas rigs su skye ba yod/ /ces dang / nyan sogs 'dod pas lan gsum gdab/ /ces gsungs pas gsol ba gdab dgos la/ gzhan phan 'od zer nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang / rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis kha bskangs pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ 'di ni gtsug dgu'i rgyud nas gsungs shing / 'di dang cha 'dra ba gcig rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs nas kyang 'byung / gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub pa/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug /ces pas bstan te/ de la yang gsum/ thun mong gi sems bskyed pa/ nang gi sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa khas blangs kyi sgo nas gzung ba'o/ /dang po thun mong gi sems bskyed pa ni/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed de/ 'di ni theg pa gong ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin pas na de skad ces bya ste/ ngag 'don ni/ dbang med bdag gis zhes sogs nas/ bdag gis gnas par bgyi zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di ni yo ga'i rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag brgya pa nas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nang gi sems bskyed pa ni/ gsang sngags nang gi lugs la lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas sems bskyed pa ste/

zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed do/ /ngag 'don ni sa ma ya a/ zhes pa nas/ tha su khaṃ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa rigs lnga'i sdom gzung ni/ ji ltar dus gsum nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god ces pa'i bar te/ rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs so/ /bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / lnga pa smon lam 'debs pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas byin brlab byang chub smon lam btab/ /ces pas bstan te/ dang po ni/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum du reg cing byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas/ /snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang / /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dmar po kha zlum pa re re bsam zhing / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gtug cing / oṃ badz+ra a ti taṣ+ṭha dz+nya na sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lnga pa smon lam 'debs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa haṃ zhes brjod de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bzung ste/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba zhes pa nas/ myur du thob par gyur cig ces pa'i bar ro/ /drug pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bsgrag la zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ 'jig rten du ni sogs nas/ 'gyur zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las gsungs so/ /bdun pa bsrung ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ /zhes pas bstan te/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtug cing / satwa kro dha lan gsum brjod pas bsrung ba'o/ /des sta gon 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ gnyis pa 'jug pa dngos la bcu gsum ste/ yon dbul ba/ gdong bcing ba/ phyag rgya bcing zhing nang du gzhug pa/ ye shes dbab pa/ de nyid brtan par bya ba/

me tog 'dor ba/ de nyid mgo la bcing ba/ gdong g.yog phye ba/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ dam tshig bskyed pa/ de nyid brtan par bya ba/ sdom pa bsgrag pa/ sdom pa gzung ba dngos so/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ras la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yog nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan te/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong g.yog bcing ba'o/ /gsum pa phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal gyi lag gnyis bya/ /zhes dang / me tog rin chen sogs kyis de brgyan te/ /yon gyi lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i lha so bdun gyi thugs kha nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas char ltar babs pa/ snying kha'i dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge la thim pas sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad dag lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes par bsam zhing / rdo rje bsdams pa spyi bor bzhag cing / oṃ badz+ra pra pe sha ya hūm̐ zhes mang du brjod pa'o/ /lnga pa de brtan par bya ba ni/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ a sa me sogs brjod/ drug pa me tog dor ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pa mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis me tog 'dor bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ sangs rgyas dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir/ /nas/ ha na hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis me tog dbul lo/ /bdun pa de nyid mgo la bcing ba ni/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas mgo la bcing par bsam zhing / oṃ pra ti ts+tsha sogs brjod/

brgyad pa gdong g.yog phye ba ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrib byed kyi dri ma dang gdong dus mnyam du bsal bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra ha se sogs brjod/ dgu pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar bsam mo/ /bcu pa dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pa mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de ltar ye shes phab pa'i myong ba dang rtogs pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa rang rgyud la zhugs par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod/ bcu gcig pa de nyid brtan par bya ba ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da sogs brjod pas brtan par bsam mo/ /bcu gnyis pa sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i zhes sogs nas/ bsrung bar bya zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bcu gsum pa sdom pa gzung ba dngos ni/ khyod kyis srog chags sogs nas/ de bzhin no zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de rnams kyis 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song / gnyis pa bcug nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po spyir bstan pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ de la yang / sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /zhes tshig rkang gcig gis sngags dbang bstan la/ bum pa la sogs nas/ bskur zhes pa'i bar tshig rkang pa gnyis kyis dbang bcu bstan te/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang dang gcig rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang la dbu rgyan gyi dbang / dar dpyang dang phreng ba'i dbang gnyis gcig tu byas te rin 'byung la dbang gnyis dang dbang gsum/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang dang don grub dril bu'i dbang gcig tu byas te rigs lnga'i phyag rgya'i dbang dang dbang bzhi/

rnam snang ming gi dbang dang lnga/ rdo rje rgya gram byin te las rnam pa bzhi'i dbang dang drug 'khor lo lag tu byin te/ slob dpon gyi dbang dang bdun/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi dbang dang brgyad/ dril bu gsung gi dbang dang dgu /rdo rje thugs kyi dbang dang bcu'o/ /thabs shes kyi dbang ni/ de nas rdo rje dril bu lag tu byin/ /zhes rkang pa gcig gis bstan to/ /rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang ni/ 'khor lo la sogs zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan cing / bka' bsgo ni/ sngags grub phyir ni sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul la brgyad de/ yon dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sngags dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / rten de la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi dbang / dbang de dag gi mtha' rten sbyin pa'o/ /dang po yon dbul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gzhan phan 'od zer nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis kha bskangs pa ste/ 'di'i don de nyid 'dus par lhug par gsungs pa/ brjod bde ba'i phyir gur nas gsungs pa'i/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa sngags dbang ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gus 'dud drag po byas pas lha so bdun gyi thugs kha nas/ sngags tshan pa bcu gsum po 'di dag gser gyi mdog can du byas te byung / spyi bo nas thim pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag lus dang sems la bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes/ sngags rnams kyi lung thob par bsam zhing / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ na mo nas/ oṃ bha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang la gnyis te/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / de'i mtha' rten las rnam pa bzhi'i dbang ngo /

/dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang ni/ bum pa spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs brjod pas/ zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa lnga dag rnam snang sogs rigs lnga'i byang chub kyi sems me long lta bu la sogs pa ye shes lnga'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa rin 'byung gi dbang la gsum/ dang po dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ rin po che las byas pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan mgo la bcings la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca sogs brjod pas/ nyon mongs pa mtha' dag sbyangs nas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa phreng ba'i dbang ni/ rin po che sna lnga las byas pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dbu rgyan gyi rtsa bar bcings la/ oṃ rat+na ma la sogs brjod/ gsum pa dar dpyang ni/ dar kha dog sna lnga pa lus tshad dang mnyam pa mgo la bcings par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra pa tra sogs brjod/ gsum pa 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang dang / bzhi pa don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang stabs gcig tu 'byung ste/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu lag tu byin la/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra sogs brjod pas rigs lnga'i ye shes lnga thob par bsam mo/ /lnga pa rnam snang ming gi dbang ni/ dril bu spyi bo la sogs pa gnas lngar dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha na ma sogs brjod pas/ rigs lnga'i ming gi dbang thob par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa las rnam pa bzhi'i dbang ni/ rdo rje rgya gram lag tu byin la/ oṃ badz+ra karma sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag par bsam la/ 'khor lo lag tu byin la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa de'i mtha' rten du dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'am/

dang po phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ni/ dpon slob gnyis kas rigs lnga'i phyag chen bcas la spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dril bu bsil zhing / oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ oṃ sogs brjod/ gnyis pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ni/ yum lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag cing / mthar lag pa g.yon du byin la/ oṃ bud+dha rat+na sogs brjod/ gsum pa rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtug cing / mthar lag pa g.yas su byin la/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ye sogs brjod/ bdun pa thabs shes zung 'jug gi dbang ni/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol nas byin la/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi nas/ hūm̐ a zhes pa'i bar ro/ /brgyad pa dbang de dag gi mtha' rten sbyin pa la gnyis te/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang dang / bka' sgo'o/ /dang po ni rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs lag tu byin la/ oṃ tsakra rat+na sogs brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /nas/ 'gyur zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de nas dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos sogs dang / dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dbul/ der ma zad lus longs spyod kyi drug cha yang 'bul snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod du gzhug go /drug pa bdag dang gtso bo tha mi dad du bsgrubs te brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas dngos su gsungs shing / shugs bstan gyi dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la yang mdzad pas/ thog mar rtsa rig dang / lha so so'i sngags tshar re bzla ba ni lha thams cad gsal btab pa'i tshul lo/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dha ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs kyi sbyongs ba'i rgyal po dang /

bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam/ rat+na dha ra sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ me tog cher rgyas dang bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam/ pad+ma dha ra'i dus su nub phyogs pa dang / bi shwa dha ra'i dus su byang phyogs pa dang / ta thā ga ta dha ra'i dus su gtso bo dang / bdag tha mi dad snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas gtso bo'i thugs kha nas byung ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis rang gnas su 'khod par bsam pa ni bdag bsgrub pa'o/ /brtan byed kyi bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du bzla bya'i sngags rnams bsam la/ lha so so'i sngags brjod pa'i tshe/ lha de dang de la phog pas/ de thams cad dbang du 'dus shing brtan par bsam mo/ /bdun pa gshin don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po spyir bstan pa la bcu ste/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba/ dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang khang du bcug ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ dbang bskur te mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba/ tsha tsha btab ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba/ bzlas pa'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba/ brab ste ro med na ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang / de thams cad kyis thun mong du phung po chas su 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ gong du bstan pa bzhin yin la/ gnyis pa dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang khang du bcug ste sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rang gi lha'am lha gzhan gyi/ /snying po snying khar bris nas ni/ /lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed de/ /khyim gyi dbus su gzhug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan cing / gsum pa mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sbyong ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas ni/
