/mchod rten dbus su gzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ro bsregs te sbyong ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ /cho ga bzhin du khung brkos la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /lnga pa tsha tsha btab ste sbyong pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de yi ming nas smos nas su/ /gur gum bzang pos sngags bris la/ /rim gyis 'bum ni tshang ba dang / /mchod rten las ni rab tu brtag /ces sogs sh+lau ka phyed dang gsum gyis bstan to/ /drug pa sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sbyong ba ni/ yang rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas kyang / /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong nyid du/ /sbyin sreg byas par gyur pa na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa bzlas te sbyong ba ni/ yang sbyong rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags bzlas shing / /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba nyid du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /zhes pas bstan la/ brgyad pa brab ste sbyong ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ bye ma yungs kar thal ba rnams/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas/ /bzlas pa byas te gtor nas kyang / /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dor/ /zhes pas bstan cing / dgu pa ro med na ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ yang sbyong rgyud las/ yang na med par gyur na yang / /zlos shing bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /ming tsam legs par bris nas kyang / /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba'am/ /yang na gzugs su bris kyang rung / /sbyin sreg mngon par dbang bskur na/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes pas bstan pa yin no/ /bcu pa de dag gis thun mong du phung po chas su 'jug pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs nas kyang /

/sngags kyis btab ste bdug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul la don tshan rnam pa bco lngas bstan te/ rten bskyed dgug cing sdig pa bral/ /sbyang ba sbyin sreg bzlas te sbyangs/ /brab cing phyin drug khrus kyis sbyangs/ /g.yo dang brtan pa'i dug kyang sbyangs/ /bkra shis skyabs 'gro dbang yang bskur/ /de la mchod bstod sbyangs bstan bya/ /zhes bya ste/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ lho sgo yi ni sa yi char/ /khru gang sa yi tshad du ni/ /stegs su legs par brtsigs nas kyang / /ba byung lnga yi gci bas byug /ces pas sbyong stegs bstan la/ de'ang rgya dang zabs su khru gang pa'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du ṇi'am/ yang na rang gi ming yig dang po klad kor gyis brgyan pa las tshe 'das bskyed pa ni slob dpon kun snying gis gsungs so/ /ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa rten dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya yis/ /srid pa bar ma dgug par bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ phyag rgya dang / ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /gsum pa sdig pa bral te rten sbyang rung du bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ shwa dha ni sogs nas/ dri ma med par gyur ces pa'i bar te/ 'di'i sngags rgya gnyis ka shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa sbyang ba la gsum ste/ zhi ba'i sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba/ drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni rdzas sngags gnyis ka zhi ba ste/ de'i phyir na de skad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni rdzas zhi ba/ sngags drag pos te/ de'i phyir na zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdzas drag po gu gul nag po/ sngags drag po sum+bha ni ste/ de'i phyir na drag po'i sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /lnga pa til gyi sbyang ba ni/

sbyin sreg gi skabs nas 'byung la/ de'i ngag 'don dang bsam bya dkyus bzhin no/ /drug pa bzlas te sbyang ba ni/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag sogs gong bzhin no/ /ngag 'don dkyus bzhin no/ /bdun pa brab pa yang / bye ma yungs kar sogs kyis bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ nas/ he du na hūm̐ phaṭ zhes pa'i bar te shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ngo / /brgyad pa khrus kyi sbyang ba ni/ gtsug dgu las/ rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ /rdo rje'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de'am bzlas pa'i lha la khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig ni/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs shing / 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /sogs sh+lau ka gnyis ni slob dpon dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyis khrus kyi cho gar gsungs so/ /rten la khrus bya ba ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin sogs nas/ khrus bya'o zhes pa'i bar ni mdo sde nas 'byung ngo / /dgu pa g.yo ba'i dug sbyong ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang zhes sogs nas dug bcom mo/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bcu pa brtan pa'i dug sbyong ba ni/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te/ /zhes pa nas/ rlung gi nang du song / zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di gnyis rma bya chen mo'i mdo las gsungs so/ /bcu gcig pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ gtsug dgu las/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis/ /dus gsum du ni khrus bya 'o/ /zhes pas bstan te/ ngag 'don ni/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /zhes pa nas/ sdig par ma gyur cig ces pa'i bar te/ 'di ni yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /bcu gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zhes pa nas/ bsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar ro/ /'di ni spyod 'jug las gsungs so/ /bcu gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni gong du bstan to/ /bcu bzhi pa mchod rten bya ba ni/

de ltar dbang bskur nas tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa la/ rgyas par ni 'dod yon lngas mchod cing / bsdu na oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /nas/ phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ skabs 'dir nub tha ma yin na byang bu bsreg pa bstan te/ byang bu la me sbar te/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me/ /zhes pa nas/ 'bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar te/ 'di ni yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud nas gsungs so/ /bco lnga pa lam sbyang bstan gyi lam sbyang ba ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzhin du/ /zhes pa nas/ tra tha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /lam bstan pa ni/ pad+ma 'dam gyi nas/ ga ts+tshan+tu swāhā zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di gnyis kyi tshigs bcad rnams ni gtsug dgu'i rgyud nas gsungs shing / sngags rnams ni phyag rdor gyi skabs nas 'byung ngo / /tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes pa la mchod pa sogs gleng gzhi'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ me ltar 'bar ba las/ de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par gzhag pas bsrung nas ni/ /mjug tu mngon par mchod byas te/ /lha rnams thams cad gshegs par gyur/ /ces pas dngos su sbyin sreg gi mjug chog bstan nas/ shugs la ni dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi mjug chog bstan pa yin no/ /de la yang brgyad/ rang nyid la dbang bskur zhing gnas gsum bsrung ba bya ba/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya ba/ dngos grub blang ba/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya ba/ mjug tu bkra shis bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ gnyis pa ni/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/

gsum pa ni mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /sogs ni gsang ba rgyan gyi rgyud las gsungs so/ /bstod pa ni gong du bstan pa bzhin no/ /dngos grub blang ba/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya ba rnams bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len te dkyus bzhin no/ /mjug tu bkra shis bya ba ni/ ston mchog dam pa sogs te sh+lau ka gsum po 'di ni stong chen rab 'joms kyi mdo las gsungs so/ /de rnams kyis kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bshad pa rang lugs mdor bsdus pa lung dang sbyar na de tsam yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / skabs der bdag gi bla ma rje btsun mus pa chen po thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid ni/ sku tshe hril por yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kho na la sbyangs pa ltar/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdus/ dka' gnas kyi dogs dpyod sogs blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig mdzad mdzad kyang / rang gi blo gros kyis zur tsam zin pa ni de tsam mo/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung rgyun las byung ba rnams kyi nang nas rang gi blo nus kyis ji ltar zin pa'i tshul rnams legs par bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar khyab bdag rnam snang chen po nyid/ /gzhan ngor dge slong mchog gi skur sprul nas/ /bdag sogs mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog /'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun mus par 'dud/ /mgon khyod zab rgyas chos tshul gang gsungs kyang / /rtag tu de nyid kho nar sbyangs pa ltar/ /mkhas dbang kun gyi dregs pa 'phrog mdzad pa/ /'di ni gsung gi yon tan bla na med/ /rtag tu rim gnyis zab mo'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /nyams myong bzang po'i rgyun la mnyam 'jog cing / /zab chos 'chad kyang de rgyun ngang gnas pa/ /'di ni thugs kyi yon tan bla na med/

/nam yang bag med spyod pas ma gos shing / /dbyibs mdzes lhun chags gzi 'od rab 'bar ba/ /tshul khrims dri bsung phyogs kun g.yo ba can/ /'di ni sku yi yon tan bla na med/ /de ltar skyon med yon tan bye ba'i gter/ /gter chen khyod kyi bka' drin gzhal du med/ /med phyir dus gsum dge rnams mchod par 'bul/ /'bul gyi da dung byang chub bar du skyobs/ /bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las/ rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo chen po'i gsung gi zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag mahā paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung la/ de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma sgra tshad lo tsā ba dkon mchog rgya mtshos zin bris su btab pa'i dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor gsung rgyun 'chi med lam gyi nor bu legs bshad pad+mo bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi don du dam pa'i chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams bsdu na/

theg pa dman pa dang / chen po gnyis sam/ yang na sde snod gsum du 'dus shing / mdo sde'i sde snod de la yang / mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /nye lam rdo rje theg pa zhig /ma 'ong dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las 'di sngags kyi theg pa yin zhing / sngags kyi theg pa de la yang rgyud sde'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang / rgyud so so'i dgongs pa grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi bzhed pas/ dbye bsdu'i sgo nas bzhag tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba la brten nas rgya gar gyi slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis phyi nang gi rgyud sde gnyis su bzhag pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa sogs la brten nas grub chen kun snying la sogs pas rgyud sde gsum du bzhag pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur la brten nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la sogs pas rgyud sde bzhi ru bzhag pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas slob dpon klu sgrub la sogs pas rgyud sde lngar bzhag pa dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud sogs la brten nas grub chen lo hi pa dang / jo bo na ro ta pa sogs kyis rgyud sde chen po sgo drug tu bzhag pa sogs rab tu mang po zhig yod kyang / da res 'dir gsum du bzhag pa'i lugs yin te/ de yang de nyid 'dus par/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pa/ /dum bu las bshad rang bya 'am/ /bsgrub pa 'dis ni thams cad du/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nas slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang bya dbye bas/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/

/zhes gsungs shing / grub chen kun snying gis/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel par/ thams cad du zhes bya ba ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud rnams so/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar na rgyud sde gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa las/ 'dir thabs dang shes rab gnyis ka dang ldan pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud zhes bya ba yin te/ de yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab rkyang pas min/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thabs shes rab gnyis ka dang ldan zhing zung du 'jug pa zhig la yo ga ste rnal 'byor zer ba yin la/ thabs shes gnyis po de yang ji lta bu zhig yin snyam na/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zab cing rgya che zhes bshad gang / /rnam par rtog med zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /de ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /ces gsungs pas/ rgya che ba lha so bdun la sogs pa gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa rnams yin la/ de nyid shes rab stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin zhing / de brjod byar ston pa'i rgyud sde rnams la 'di pa'i lugs kyi rnal 'byor ram/ gnyis ka'i rgyud du bzhed pa la/ de la yang slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka' bas/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyis gsal bar phye/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud dang / cha mthun pa'i rgyud dang gsum du gnas pa las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud de la yang / de nyid 'dus pa dum bu bzhi'i bdag nyid can te/ de yang dum bu dang pos rdo rje dbyings/ gnyis pas khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsum pas 'gro ba 'dul ba/ bzhi pas don thams cad legs par grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ston pa yin zhing / 'di nyid dang po 'og min stug po bkod par gsungs la/

de rjes ri rab kyi rtser gsungs shing / slar yang lcang lo can du gsungs pas na de nyid 'dus pa 'di la lha gnas gsum pa zhes kyang yo ga ba rnams zer ba yin la/ gzhan yang rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud don nye bar bsdu ba ste de rnams ni rtsa ba'i rgyud yin zhing / bshad pa'i rgyud ni/ spyi'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / so so'i bshad rgyud la thams cad gsang ba zhes pa dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtogs pa zhes bya ba dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis las/ dum bu phyi ma gnyis kyi bshad rgyud ni bod du ma 'gyur zhes bla ma rnams gsungs shing / cha mthun gyi rgyud la dpal mchog gi skor dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud dang / rab gnas kyi rgyud chung la sogs pa rnams yin zhing / ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud cha mthun gyi khongs su btus kyang / 'chad thabs kyi sgo nas rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud sde gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rgyud rang skya tshugs pa zhig yin par bzhed pas/ de yang spyi rgyud 'chad thabs la dus kyi 'khor lo lta bu rgyud 'grel pas 'chad pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu rgyud gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa dang / rgyud rgyud nyid kyis 'chad pa rnams su yod pa las/ 'di rgyud rgyud nyid kyis 'chad pa zhes bya ste brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud kyi tshul du byas nas/ brtag pa phyi ma bshad rgyud kyi tshul du gsungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'di rang gi gong 'khrug bsdeb te yo ga gzhan nas kha skong dgos pa sogs ha cang med par 'di rang nas dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa yin no/ /'o na de lta bu'i rgyud 'di rnams yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dus dang gang zag gang la dgongs nas gsungs shing / spyir mi'i yul du byung ba'i dus ji ltar yin zhing /

khyad par du gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dus nam gyi tshe dar ba yin snyam na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba'i dbang du mdzad nas mi rigs bzhi dang / dus tshod/ rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi ru 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams rim pa bzhin rdzogs ldan dang / gnyis ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / rtsod dus ste dus tshod bzhi dang / bram ze/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ dmangs rigs rnams la dgongs nas gsungs pa las/ 'di rnams gnyis ldan gyi dus dang / rgyal rigs la gtso bor dgongs nas gsungs pa yin la/ mi'i yul du byung ba'i tshul ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis nas/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'jam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rjes mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /ces gsungs te sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu nas lho phyogs kyi grong khyer pa ti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la/ phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te rgyud 'di rnams gsungs pa yin la/ rgyal po des sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogs la gnang zhing / de la rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i slob dpon kun dga' snying po zhes bya bas/ spyir chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing / khyad par yo ga skor gyi dbang dang bshad pa rnams phul du phyin par mdzad de/ de nas slob dpon shes rab bskyangs dang sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs las brgyud de rgya gar dang kha che sogs su dar bar byas pa yin zhing / bod du rgyal po su'i ring la/ lo tsā ba gang gis bsgyur cing dar ba yin na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rgyal rabs lnga pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba snying po la sogs pa spyan drangs te/

sad mi mi bdun gyis bsgyur nas mnga' bdag khri ral gyi bar du dar bar byung / yang kun dga' snying po'i lugs thun mong ma yin pa ni de dus ma dar la/ de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya bas lo chen rin chen bzang po la sogs kha cher slob gnyer la brdzangs nas lo chen dang lo chung gnyis kyis kha che mkhan po las dbang dang gdams ngag mang du gsan cing / lhag par 'dus pa rnam gnyis la mkhas par gyur te mnga' ris stod du phebs nas yo ga'i skor rnams dar bar mdzad cing / dus de tsam na lo chen gu ger bzhugs shing / lo chung pu hrang du bzhugs pas zhang shes bla ma la sogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams thag nye ba dang / lo chung 'di lo chen gyi 'khor gyi thog ma kha che tshun chad du byon pa dang / dbyangs la mkhas shing / rgyal blon yang dbyangs la dges pas lo chung las dar bar mdzad de stod du yang sgra che zhing / smad du dar ba rnams ni lo chen gyi sku tshe stod kyi bshad srol yin la/ phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang mjal ba la jo bo rjes sngar yang de la bde mchog la sogs pa dang / rdo rje 'byung ba tshar gcig tsam las gzhan yo ga'i skor rnams ha cang ma gsan/ des paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pha la dang mjal nas yo ga'i skor rnams gsan pas grub chen kun snying gi gdams pa ma nor bar byung ba dang mnyes te kun dga' snying po'i brgyud pa bzhi 'di kun mkhyen gyi ṭik+kar 'dug kyang / rje btsun gyi rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭik+ka na brgyud pa bdun pa zer ba 'dug pas brtag go par 'dug gsungs nas bsnyal pa nyi ma shes rab dang / brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims las dar ba ni lo chen gyi sku tshe smad kyi bshad srol yin la deng sang stod lugs smad lugs kyi khyad par sa cha stod du dar ba dang / smad du dar ba la 'jog kyang / rje btsun gyi dgongs pa ni kha che mkhan po'i lugs lo chen sku tshe stod la babs pa dang /

rgya gar shar phyogs dharmā pha la'i lugs sku tshe smad la babs pa rnams yin par bzhed la/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos kyang rgya gar du tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po zhes mkhas pa mi gsum du grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni kun snying gi 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas gsang ba'i 'grel pa ā ba ta ra/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa ku sa la'i rgyan la sogs pa du ma byung zhing / bod du yang snga rabs pa rnams kyi 'bru 'grel rgan po zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i 'grel pa dang bshad srol mang du byung na yang / da hril te bsgril na/ spyir yo ga dang / khyad par sbyong rgyud la grub chen kun snying nas rim gyis brgyud de jo bo rin chen bzang po la babs shing / de la yang kha che'i mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba nas brgyud pa dang / jo bo rje nas brgyud pa dang / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pha la nas brgyud pa'i lugs dang gsum tsam yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid yin zhing / de nyid la yang brag steng pa nas brgyud pa dang / dge bshes bsnyal pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i lugs srol gnyis las/ dbang bka' dang / bshad bka' 'di rnams brag steng pa nas bla ma mal lo tsā ba la brgyud de bla chen sa skya pa la babs pa 'di yin zhing / spyir sa skya pa chen po de la go mi dge bsnyen sogs las brgyud de kun rig jo bo lugs su grags pa dang / dbus pa dge ser nas gnam kha'u pa la brgyud nas kun rig smad lugs su grags pa 'di dang / mal nas brgyud pa'i kun rig stod lugs su grags pa gsum char bzhugs kyang / brag steng pa nas bla ma mal lo tsā ba la brgyud pa 'di nyid la thugs rtsis su mdzad pas/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i rten po rang ni gong du bshad pa'i ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/

bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i don du lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis zhus nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi byang phyogs dga' ba'i tshal du gsungs pa de yang brtag pa dang po nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gsungs shing / brtag pa phyi ma 'khor los bsgyur ba yan bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs nas phyag na rdo rje zhi ba dang / me ltar 'bar ba man khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis gsungs pa brjod bya'i gtso bo ni kun rig la sogs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ bdag bskyed kyi bcu gnyis/ ro sreg gi gcig sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhi ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tsam ston pa'i rgyud 'di dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gzhan rgya gar dang / bod du mang po zhig byung na yang / gtso bor gyur pa ni rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad dang mchan bu gnyis/ cho ga'i rnam gzhag ston pa gzhan phan 'od zer/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag ston pa gzhan phan spyi chings/ lag len gyi rnam gzhag ston pa gzhan phan nyer mkho ste gzhan phan skor gsum mam lngar grags pa rnams dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdul tshon kha skong dang / ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas la sogs pa rnams la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sgrub par byed/ ces pa de rnams kyis 'jam dbyangs sa lo chen po'i gsung gi zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan des/ /sa skya'i bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i phyir/ /sa skya lo tsā kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /sa skya'i lnga rig mkhas pa gang de rgyal/

/deng sang blo gsal dpyod ldan cher dkon pas/ /shes bya kun la blo gros rab rgyas kyang / /mkhas dang mi mkhas rnam dbye mi shes pa'i/ /blun po'i dbus 'dir mkhas kyang ci zhig bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo chen po'i gsung gi zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la/ de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba gang gis reg zig zin bris kyi brda rnying / tu bkod par mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi spyi'i don la nye bar mkho ba'i zin don tshan 'di rnams mkhas pa gong ma de dag gi gsung rab so so nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sgra ji bzhin du glegs bam 'dir bkod pa'i dgos pa ni gong du mchan bur bris zin pa de nyid dang / gzhan yang ding sang / dus bskal gyi dbang gis blo gsal rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing gong ma'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can rnams la mthong rgya dang rtog dpyod 'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can brgya lam zhig na re re tsam du snang zhing / cung zad srid kyang 'dir bkod pa'i mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab mtha' dag ni ding sang gi skye bo dpe tshogs can su'i yang lag tu 'dzoms pa ni shin tu dka' bar mthong nas rgyu mtshan des na skyes bu blo gros dang rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i las 'phro can gsung rab rgya chen po mthong 'dod can rnams la gcig tu phan pa'i bsam pa kho na'i dbang byas te/ gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad rin chen rnams/ /gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam 'di/ /blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston yin/

/'di la slob par 'dod rnams kyis/ /rang rang blo gros dang sbyar te/ /'dir bshad don tshan gcig bzung nas/ gzhan rnams bklags pas bde blag rtogs/ /zhes bya bar rtogs par gyis la/ blo chung log rtog can rnams kyis ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig bris zin bris 'di la sbyar byang mi snang yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob mkhas pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad zer ba bzhugs byang la yod pas de ltar du rigs par bya'o/ /las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud nyan pa po'i gang zag ni/ rgyud stong phrag brgya pa las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang por ldan pas nyon/ /brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang pos ni/ phyi rol gyi yul gzugs sgra sogs la 'jug pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsdus nas gang bshad par bya ba'i chos kyi tshig don la rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis nyon ces pa'o/ /gnyis pas ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang 'thob 'dod dang / rang nyid kyis de thob nas sems can gzhan yang rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la dgod 'dod kyi bsam pa sems bskyed dang ldan pas te snod kyi yon tan bstan to/ /phyi ma gnyis kyis snod kyi skyon bstan te/ brjed pa ni bstan bya'i chos kyi tshig don rnams brjed pa dang / nges pa ni/ gzhan du brjed skyen pa la bshad kyang / 'dir le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du song pa la zer ro/ /brjed nges pa la skyon ci yod snyam na/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis rgyud byin gyis rlob par mi byed ces pa'o/ /de bas na de lta bu'i skyon spangs shing gong du smos pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / gzhan yang thun mong du rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang /

thun mong ma yin pa gang la me tog phog pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gsal btab nas nyan dgos/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ yo ga a wa ta ra las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud dang / rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod pa'i rgyud dang / dpung bzang sogs bya ba'i rgyud do/ /dang po la rnal 'byor zhes pa'i don ni/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pos min/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes dang / sgra pa ba rnams kyis yo rtsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ chos gnyis tshogs pa gcig la 'jog dgos so/ /gnyis po de yang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zab cing rgya che zhes bya ba/ /rnam par rtog med zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di dag bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /ces bya bas na/ zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis so/ /de la zab pa ni/ spros pa dang bral ba'i shes rab stong pa nyid kyi steng du sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /rgya che ba ni/ de'i steng du lha'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /de la yang sgrub thabs shig kyang sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ gong gi de la ltos te rgya che bar 'grub bo/ /mdor na spros bral gyi stong pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'i steng du rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha'i rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /'o na 'di'i gong na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyang yod pa ma yin nam snyam na/ 'di'i zab pa ni chos kyi sku'i sgrub thabs dang / rgya che ba ni gzugs sku'i sgrub thabs yin pas/ sku gnyis kyi sgrub thabs su song zhing / de yang bden pa gnyis kyi rnam par 'dus pas na rnal 'byor bla med yod kyang /

'di las zab pa'i brjod bya zur pa bstan rgyu med do/ /rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud la yang / rtsa rgyud rgyud don shin tu rtogs dka'i gnas/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun rgyud kyis bsgrub par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud do/ /de yang gang zhig thog mar byung zhing bshad gzhir gyur pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang / de'i rjes su byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pa ni bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /de la de nyid bsdus pa ni rtsa ba'i rgyud yin te dang por byung zhing bshad gzhir gyur pas so/ /dang por byung ba ni/ yo ga ba rnams kyi lugs kyis/ 'o skol gyi ston pa ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas zhag bdun gyi bar du chos ci yang ma gsungs par ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag de nas 'og min du byon te rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa gsungs pas na 'di nyid rgyud thams cad kyi rtsa rgyud du 'dod cing dang por byung bar grub bo/ /bshad gzhir gyur pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo sogs thams cad kyi bshad gzhi yin pas so/ /de la yang rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang / rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bzhi'o/ /rgyud phyi ma ni/ de nyid bsdus pa de'i ma tshang ba kha skong ba dang / mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'o/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma ni/ phyag na rdo rjes yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la khyed kyi gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rgya che ba dang / rigs sngags kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba de dag khyad par du 'phags mod/ de lta na yang / rtsod pa'i dus kyi snyigs ma lnga brdo ba'i sems can rnams kyi tshe thung ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas mkho ba'i yul du ma gyur pas/ de bas bsdus pa zhig bstan rgyu yod dam/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis dum bu bzhi'i nyams len de dril nas yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nyams len la de bas bsdus pa med pas sems dpa' 'byung chung la sogs ston par byed pa rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma gsungs/

rgyud nye bar bsdu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas ri rab kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam 'phrul dang / dkyil 'khor dang / chos nyan gyi 'khor gyi bkod pa sogs bsdus nas/ 'og min ga la ba der gshegs pa'i tshul ston pa'o/ /rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dum bu bzhi las/ dum bu dang po rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor/ gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsum pa 'gro ba 'dul ba/ bzhi pa don dam par grub pa'o/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la rigs thams cad pa'i bshad rgyud dang / rigs so so ba'i bshad rgyud gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo ste/ 'di nas rigs lnga char gyi dkyil 'khor dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa du ma ston zhing / de thams cad kyang de nyid bsdus pa la phan 'dogs byed du gyur pas so/ /'di la badz+ra shi kha ra zhes pa dang / sngags kyi mdo sde rgya che rol ba zhes kyang zer ro/ /'di nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bcu/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig rnams ston no/ /gnyis pa la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud dang / gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud do/ /dang po ni thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud do/ /'di nas yo ga spyi'i lam gyi 'gros dang / rnam gzhag la sogs pa shin tu gsal bar ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtogs pa ste/ 'di la slob dpon mu ti ka ko ṣa'i 'grel pa yod cing / de nyid grub chen kun dga' snying po'i rjes su 'jug pa yin zhing / spros pa'i tshogs kyang shin tu chung ba rnam par dag pa zhig kyang yod do/ /cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ dpal mchog dang po/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis bsgyur pa'i yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le rnams so/ /dang po la dpal mchog sher dum dang / sngags dum gnyis kyi dang po nas/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang sbyar ba dang / sher phyin dgu brgya pa dang sbyar ba dang / tshul brgya lnga bcu pa dang sbyar ba rnams ston zhing / sngags dum de nyid ltar byas pa ston no/ /'di nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig ste bcu bzhi rnams bshad do/ /'di rnams 'phags yul du ji ltar bkral ba'i tshul la/ yo ga ba mi gsum du grags pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ de nyid bsdus pa'i don gyi 'grel pa/ yo ga a wa ta ra zhes pa deb gcig tsam zhes pa shog bu gdong thon sum cu so grangs yod pa la ngos 'dzin pa gsung rab gzhan las bshad do/ /gcig tsam yod pa mdzad/ 'di nas yo ga spyi'i lam gyi rnam gzhag dang por dum bu bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob dgos tshul dang / de nas mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom dgos tshul dang / mthar 'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub tshul la sogs pa bstan cing / 'di'i lugs kyi bshad bka' dang dbang bka' sogs da lta bod na yang med cing / grub chen kun snying gi 'grel pa yod phyin chad 'di la ltos kyang mi dgos pas smon lam gyi yul tsam du bzhag go /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshig gi 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan zhes pa yod cing / 'di nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang dang / gtso bo yang zhal gcig par byed pa sogs grub chen kun snying dang grub mtha' mi mthun pa du ma snang zhing 'di nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' dang / bshad bka' sogs lo chen gyi dus su byung yang da lta chad nas med do/ /grub chen kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa de nyid snang chen zhes pa/ sh+lau ka stong phrag bcu drug yod pa po ti bzhi byas pa'am/ dum bu dang po la po ti gcig 'di la stod 'grel du grags/

gnyis pa la po ti gcig gsum pa 'gro 'dul nas don grub kyi phyed yan la po ti gcig phyed man nas rgyud nyer bsdu'i bar la po ti gcig 'gro 'dul la 'gro 'dul gyi nag 'jam zhes pa shog bu mda' tshad sum cu tsam byas pa nas/ de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ston pa dang / don grub la yang don grub nag 'jam zhes pa mda' tshad sum cu tsam nas/ de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ston pa yod do/ /dum bu bzhi'i dkyil 'khor 'di dag kyang / dang po sku/ gnyis pa thugs/ gsum pa gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor/ bzhi pa la rin 'byung dang don yod grub pa phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i 'phrin las kyi ngo bo don yod grub pa yin zhing / don byed pa'i yon tan gang la ldan pa'i yon tan de rin chen 'byung ldan yin pas so/ /gong gi slob dpon gsum po 'di la/ bod snga rabs pa rnams/ tshig la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen zhes zer/ rgyu mtshan ni slob dpon kun snying gis 'grel pa po ti bzhi tsam byas pa brtsams pa dang / sangs rgyas gsang bas don gyi 'grel pa chung chung de brtsams pas zer ba yin nam/ gzhan ma mthong / bu rin po ches de nyid go ldog ste/ tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i gzhung / dum bu dang po'i dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba dang / gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi kha skong la/ sems dpa' 'byung chen dang / 'byung chung gnyis kyi/ dang po la srung 'khor/ tshogs zhing / gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba yan rdor dbyings dang 'dra ba la/ rnal 'byor bdag rdzogs kyi skabs su sems dpa' nyer gcig lus la bkod pa dang /

sems dpa' nyer brgyad lus la bkod pa la khyad par yod dam snyam na yod mod/ de ltar na yang sems dpa' gcig lus la bkod pas chog ces ston pa dang / sems dpa' 'byung chung ni/ srung 'khor med cing / tshogs zhing sprul te phyag bzhi dang rgyun bshags rnams byas nas/ gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba sngon du song ste rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gcig ldan ston pa mdzad do/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa la dkyil chog dngos su med kyang / dum bu gnyis pa'i dkyil chog de/ de nyid kyi yang dkyil chog tu yang 'gro/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo la rgya gar gyi 'grel pa med cing / dbang bka' yang lo chen nas brgyud pa'i yo ga stod lugs pa la med kyi/ phyis rting zangs dkar lo tsā bas kha che dz+nyā na shrī la zhus te yo ga smad lugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la yod do/ /rgyud de nyid kyang zangs dkar lo tsās bsgyur cing / kha che dz+nyā na shrī nas kyi bshad srol la brten pa'i khong gi ṭīk+ka yang yod do/ /dpal mchog la grub chen kun snying gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sh+lau ka gsum khri lnga stong byas pa gcig yod cing / de nyid nas dkyil 'khor bcu gsum po re re la yang dkyil chog re dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /bod du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos gcig la 'di las yig tshogs che ba med do/ /'di la bstan 'gyur bsdud mkhan rnams kyis slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal mchog gi 'grel pa che chung gnyis su byas kyang / che ba ni sher dum dang sngags dum gnyis lhan cig tu byas pa dang / chung ba ni/ de nyid las sher dum gyi 'grel pa zur du byung ba yin gyi/ gong gi de las logs pa min no/ /gzhan yang pad+ma lcags kyus byas pa yin yang zer/ zom rong chos bzang gis byas kyang zer ba'i 'grel pa chen po zhig kyang yod de/ bod ma yin par 'dug go /mtshan brjod la/

mtshan brjod bshad pa lugs drug dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla med du bkral ba'i lugs gsum/ yo gar bkral ba'i lugs gsum mo/ /dang po la gsang 'dus dang mthun par bkral ba/ dus 'khor dang mthun pa/ lam 'bras dang mthun par bkral ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon zla bzang dpal gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ste/ de ni gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa tshigs bcad du byas pa la/ a nu pa rak+ṣi ta ste/ dpe med mtshos mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad dang bcas pa'o/ /de dag ni sems 'grel du mtshan brjod kyi lung drangs te rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa byas pa rnams rgyas su btang ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ ma cig zha ma lugs kyi bshad pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa yo gar bkral ba'i lugs la/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa ste/ de nyid la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi tshul gnyis ro gcig shes par byed pa'i bshad pa zer zhing / de nas sa bcu la yang lha mo bcu byas te rab tu dga' ba ma zhes pa la sogs pa'i mtshan gyis btags pa yod do/ /'di nas chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor ston no/ /dkyil 'khor de yang zlum po sgo gsum sbrags la sgo phyi ma 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la bskyed chog rgyas pa dang bcas pa ston/ 'di la nam mkha' dri med che ba zhes kyang zer ro/ /bar pa ni/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa gsang sngags kyi don la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba sngags don rnam gzigs zhes pa yod do/ /de nas 'jam dpal seng ldeng gi dkyil 'khor ston zhing / 'di la slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog yon tan kun 'byung / mtshan brjod klags pa'i bsgom khog dge bsnyen ma grags sbyin ma'i don bsdu zhes pa rnams yod do/

/chung ba slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ste/ 'di nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lnga/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig rnams ston zhing / 'di la nam mkha' dri med chung ba zhes kyang zer ro/ /'di la slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung phran la dbugs dbyung gi dkyil 'khor drug ste/ mi bskyod pa'i dbugs dbyung nas/ rnam snang gi dbugs dbyung gi bar dang / 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ngo / /'di'i rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ dbus su 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la mthar rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba ste bde mchog 'khor lo bsgyur drug lta bu'o/ /'di rnams yo gar 'jog pa ni/ gong gi yo ga la mkhas pa'i/ slob dpon de dag gi rjes su 'brangs pa yang min zhing / de rnams dang bshad srol mthun pa yang min mod kyang / 'di nas bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa dang ye shes dgug gzhug phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs ci rigs pa bshad pas bya spyod las khyad par du 'phags shing / dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor med pas bla med du 'jog tu mi rung bas de ltar du bzhag pa yin no/ /chos dbyings gsung dbang la/ rin po che pas/ rdor dbyings kyi cho gas rgyas bkab pa'i dkyil chog gcig mdzad mod kyang / rigs pa ma yin te/ gong gi rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir ro/ /des na 'dzim pa rin chen seṅge'i dkyil chog ltar byed rgyu yin no/ /'jam dpal seng ldang la/ bla ma khyung lhas pas/ rin po che pa'i dgongs pa yin zer ba'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i cho ga sbyar ba'i dkyil chog gcig mdzad mod/ de yang 'thad pa ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan gong bzhin no/ /des na rngog pa'i dkyil chog ltar legs pa yin no/ /ngan song sbyong rgyud la brtag pa snga phyi gnyis byas pa'i brtag pa snga ma rtsa rgyud dang /

phyi ma rgyud phyi'i tshul du gsungs la/ brtag pa snga ma nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyi ma nas shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor nas bzung ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas sbyin sreg gi thab bzhi/ me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas drag po'i sbyin sreg dor ba'i thab gsum/ kun rig gi skabs nas ro hom ste dkyil 'khor gyi las nyi shu bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang gtsug dgu'i rgyud du byas pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud dang mtshan 'dra zhing / mang nyung yang de tsam pa zhig la/ brtag pa snga phyi gnyis kyi/ dang po gleng gzhi dang gleng slong sogs sbyong rgyud dang 'dra bar byas pa la/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dod du shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor bskyal/ de la tshogs zhing gi skabs su mchod pa nyi shu pa dang / rnal 'byor bdag rdzogs rdor dbyings kyi skabs ltar 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la bskyed chog rgyas pa dang / brtag pa phyi ma'i shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi dod du kun rig bskyal/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la bskyed chog rgyas pa sbyar/ lhag ma rnams kun rig dang 'dra bar byas pa yod do/ /de ni sa skya pa yan gyi rgyud 'bum rnying pa rnams na med/ phyis chag los bsgyur pa yin zhing / dpe de'i mjug tu gtsug dgu'i rgyud kyi rgya dpe kha cher nub pa la brten nas slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang / 'jigs byed 'byung gnas sbas pa'i man ngag la brten nas bris zer ba snang ngo / /'di ni bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis brtsams par gsal zhing / slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang / a bh+ya'i man ngag la brten zer ba yang / rdor dbyings kyi cho ga de gtsug dgu la sbyar ba dang / slob dpon a bh+yas phreng bar bshad pa'i gtsug dgu la 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la bskyed chog rgyas pa yod pa mthong bar 'dug kyang /

paṇ+ḍi ta khong rang gis ma mkhyen pa yin te/ grub chen kun snying gis tan tra sde bco brgyad po thams cad yo gar 'grel pa dang / slob dpon a bh+yas rgyud sde bzhi po thams cad la bla med kyi rgyab sbyar te bshad pa'i tshul gnyis phyogs gcig tu bsres kyang mi 'dre ba'i phyir ro/ /des na de lta bu'i rgyud ni med kyang rung ba yin no/ /'di la rin po che pas yo ga'i chos 'byung du/ 'di paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab can zhig gis byas pa yin min brtag go /zhes pa dang / 'di legs grags 'dug pas legs pa'i skyon yang mang po rtogs zhes bris shing / phyis gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog rtsom pa'i dus rgyud rnam dag tu byas te/ dkyil chog de yang dgongs pa ltar brtsams shing / slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog ni yo ga chung ba'i lugs su byas shing / gtsug dgu'i rgyud ni yo ga che ba'i lugs su 'dug go zhes gsung ba bris so/ /gnyis pa bod kha ba can gyi khrod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar la rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su/ sngags 'chang dharmā kirti zhes pa zhig la sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bka' dang bshad bka' byung zhing / bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi gtsug lag khang gong ma yang sbyong rgyud dang mthun par byas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su slob dpon zhi ba snying po nas brgyud pa'i sbyong rgyud kyi dbang dang bshad bka' yang byung yang de gnyis da lta chad nas med do/ /'di'i dus su cho ga rim gsum zhes pa slob dpon ye shes 'od 'phros mdzad pa'i gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga dang / slob dpon chags med rgyal pos mdzad pa'i ro bsreg gi cho ga dang / slob dpon zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa'i mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga rnams dar ro/ /yang de'i dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba bod du gangs gzigs pa la byon pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gsan te/

lo tsā ba dbas mañju warma la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba mang po spyan 'dren pa la btang bas/ slob dpon gyis 'jam dbyangs la gsol ba btab pas/ bod dbus gtsang gi sa'i mthil du phyin na tshe'i bar chad du 'gro bas 'gro mi nyan zhes gsungs pa la brten nas slob dpon gdan ma 'drongs/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis der slob dpon la sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bka' dang bshad bka' la sogs pa gsan no/ /'bru 'grel rgan po zhes pa zhig byung ba de slob dpon de nyid kyis brtsams pa yin nam yang zer/ slob dpon gyi gsung bgros lo tsā ba rnams kyis yi ger btab pa yin nam yang zer/ gong gi slob dpon dharmā kirti dang / zhi ba snying po gnyis kyis brtsams pa yin nam yang zer/ de gnyis kyi gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa yin nam yang zer te/ gang ltar yang po ti chen po zhig gi nang nas yo ga ba rnams kyi yo ga'i gzhung rnams su lha'i sku mdog dang zhal phyag sogs mi gsal ba rnams de nas kha skong ba mdzad do/ /bstan pa phyi dar la/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la rgya gar gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas zhi ba bod du byon te/ de la lo chen gyis de nyid bsdus pa la phyag len rdo rje 'byung ba'i steng nas mdzad cing / bshad pa de nyid snang chen ma 'gyur bas/ ko sa la'i rgyan gyi steng nas mdzad pas bshad pa dang phyag len cung ma mthun zhing / spros pa'i tshogs kyang che ba dang / sbyong rgyud la/ lha dang sngags sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa de yin pa la/ cho ga thams cad rdor dbyings kyi rgyas bkab pa'i dbang dang / bshad bka' yam me ba zhig snang ngo / /lugs de nyid sa cha smad du dar ba la yo ga smad lugs zhes grags shing de nyid 'dzin mkhan la/ lo chen gyi dngos slob chab lha khang gi gsum ston ye 'bar/ g.yag sde bye ma lung gi gnyan ston tshul 'bar/ nyang stod kyi skyang bu chos blo/ spre'u chung gi lce ston zhar ba/

rong ri lu phug pa chos mgon sogs byung ngo / /de'i rjes la bar der/ jo bo rje lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis spyan drangs te bod du byon/ lo chen dang mjal te yo ga'i gsung gleng byas pas/ lo chen thugs ma ches par yo ga ma gsan/ bla med kyi gsung gleng byas pas cung mnyes te/ bde mchog lo hi pa zhus so/ /go mi bsgom chen gyis jo bo la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / bshad bka' rnams zhus/ de la khong gi bla ma skyi nor dz+nyā na/ des snyal pa nyi ma shes rab la/ des snur nyi ma 'od zer la/ des rtsa skya ba dang / 'dzim pa sogs la rim par brgyud do/ /rtsa bsnur 'dzim gsum rnams mkhan po sangs rgyas zhi ba nas brgyud pa'i sbyong rgyud kun rig gi dbang bka' de la paṇ+ḍi tas btags chos yin zhes zer/ de nas lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pha la bod du gangs gzigs pa la byon te/ lo chen dang mjal te gsung gleng bgyis pas yo ga la shin du mkhas shing / grub chen kun snying dang khong gi bar na khong rang the ba'i brgyud pa yang lnga las med cing / phyag len dang bshad pa gnyis ka grub chen kun snying gi gzhung gi steng nas mdzad pas shin tu 'grig cing / spros pa yang chung bar 'dug pas/ de la yo ga'i dbang bka' dang bshad bka' rnams gsan cing / lugs de nyid sa cha stod du dar ba la yo ga stod lugs zhes grags so/ /de yang paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyis yo ga stod 'grel gyi bshad bka' rnams bod du byon cing / de'i dus su de nyid snang chen gyi dum bu dang po'i 'grel pa 'gyur ba de la yo ga stod 'grel zhes grags so/ /dum bu gnyis pa man gyi 'grel pa phyis rting zangs dkar lo tsā bas bsgyur pa yin no/ /lugs de nyid 'dzin mkhan la lo chen gyi dngos slob brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ rin chen bsod nams/ snum phyi ru ba rnams las/

dang po la mal los gsan/ de la rje sa skya pas gsan nas brgyud do/ /lo chen gyi gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa/ snul phyi ru bas mdzad pa'i yo ga'i bshad 'bum chen mo zhes pa yod cing / gzhan phan 'od zer gyi rtsom gzhi cha gcig de nyid yin no/ /yo ga stod lugs kyi phyi mo gzhan phan 'od zer yin zhing / de la brten nas khang bsod nams 'bum gyi kun rig spru lung pa kun smon gyi kun rig phur bsod dbang gi kun rig tshwa mo rong pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi kun rig ti shrī brang 'od kyi gzhan phan snying po/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi kun rig kun bsod ma/ kun rig brag nag ma/ tsha rang pa rgya mtsho dpal gyi kun rig rnams ni stod lugs kyi rjes 'brang ngo / /rtsa bsnur 'dzim gsum gyi kun rig dang / bshes gnyen rdo rje seṅge'i kun rig rnams ni jo bo rje'i rjes 'brang ste/ de yang stod lugs kyi khongs su gtogs/ zangs dkar gyi kun rig dang / rong pa chos mgon/ g.yag sde stong kun pa'i kun rig rin po che pa'i kun rig sogs ni smad lugs so/ /chag los dbang bskur bal po ra wen tra la zhus nas/ dkyil chog stod lugs kyi cho ga'i lugs bzhin brtsams pa zhig 'dug pa ni/ gang nas brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / de las byung ba'i chos gnyis ma 'brel lo/ /g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams kyis kyang / kun rig gi dbang paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ta tsan+t+ra la zhus nas/ dkyil chog stod lugs la brten nas brtsams 'dug pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /mdor na deng sang bod du dar ba'i yo ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lugs yin na/ stod lugs smad lugs gang rung zhig tu 'du dgos pas lugs de gnyis gang du yang ma song ba'i kun rig gi cho ga la sogs pa rnams ni rang bzo las ma 'das so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun las byung ba'i sbyong rgyud kyi spyi'i don la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/

da 'di man chad yo ga'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang / rgyud kyi don che rags khongs su chud pa la phan pa'i phyir bris pa lags/ ni sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi spyi'i don legs par bshad pa rje rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gsung rgyun sgra zin bris 'di la sbyar byang mi snang yang rje ngor pa'i gsung la bdag chen chu mig pas zin tho ltab pa'o/ /zhes pa bzhugs byang na 'dug pas de bzhin du go bar gyis shig ji bzhin du bkod pa'i zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad par bya'o/ /de yang zin bris de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sems can mchog rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'chad/ de la de nyid 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje rtse mo lta bu bshad pa'i rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud sogs dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud lta bu cha mthun gyi rgyud yin/ de rnams kyi nang nas sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba la shin tu byin rlabs che ba'am/ phyag rgya dang dbyangs la sogs pa spros pa'i bya ba shas chung zhing / bzlas pa dang lha bsgom pa shas che bas bsgom pa'i rgyud ces bya ba ngan 'gro thams cad sbyong ba'i rgyud bshad par bya ba yin no/ /de'i bshad tshul la'ang / lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i stod la sa cha smad du byung zhing spros pa che ba dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba nas 'byung ba bzhin 'chad cing / lha dang phyag rgya mi mthun pa sbyong rgyud bzhin 'chad pa smad lugs dang / lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad/ sa cha stod gu ge nyid du byung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba nas kha mi skong bar rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar mdzad cing bshad pa gtso bor mdzad pa stod lugs gnyis so/ /rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la ni gnyis ka bzhugs pa yin te/ lo chen gyi lo chung des dbus pa dge ser ba/

des gnam kha'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ des sa chen te smad lugs/ lo chen brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags/ sa chen te stod lugs so/ /de tshul ji ltar 'chad ce na bshad srol so so mi 'dra ba/ rin chen bzang po'i lugs bzhin du/ /dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ lo chen gyi lugs la gnyis las/ stod lugs ltar 'chad do/ /smad lugs pa rnams brtag pa dang po/ phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma zhes gsum du 'chad pa de nyid snang chen dang mthun zhing / 'di la yang de lta bu 'chad du rung bas legs po yin no/ /'dir don rnam pa bzhi ste/ gleng gzhi/ gleng slong ba/ rgyud dngos/ 'khor rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ brtag pa dang po kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor shākya thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi spo la sangs rgyas pa de nyid kyis gsungs kyi/ de nyid 'dus pa ltar sprul bshad byas pa ni ma yin no/ /dang po gleng gzhi ni/ dang po sbyor ba bstan cing / gleng slong ba dang / gsang sngags thugs kha nas sprul pa gnyis kyis ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bstan pas/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang / bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag des slob ma tshe ldan rjes su 'dzin dgos pas/ de'i rjes su rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bstan/ dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log pa thob pa'i slob ma des/ mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la sa dang po'i rtogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir du lha bcu gnyis kyi ras bris zhing khams ma la brten nas mchog bsgrub pa'i cho ga bstan/ tshe 'di la mchog bsgrub pa'i skal ba med pa'i gang zag la de'i rjes su thun mong gis dngos grub bsgrub pa'i cho ga bstan/ yang bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag des tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin dgos pas/ de'i rjes su tshe 'das la dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba/

mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ mchod rten bya bas sdig pa sbyong ba/ dri'i gtsang khang du bzhag pas sdig pa sbyong ba/ bzlas pa bya bas sdig pa sbyong ba/ ro bsreg ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ sbyin sreg bya bas sdig pa sbyong ba/ rten med pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i tshul/ phyir bzlog gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba ste tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs dgu bstan/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis kun rig gi cho ga gsungs pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ nor bu dri ma med pa 'das nas/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i dgung bdun lon nas dmyal ba mnar med na gnas pa'i don du byas pa'i/ de dga' ldan pa'i lhar bskyed pa la 'khor rnams ngo mtshar skyes pa rgyud kyi phan yon dang bcas pa ston/ brtag pa gnyis pa phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig 'chad pa la gnyis/ sdud pa po'i tshig gis mtshams sbyar nas ston pa la phyag btsal nas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang / dkyil 'khor bcu gcig dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brtag pa dang po kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad tshar ba'i rjes de nas bshad do/ /gang gis na thugs shākya thub pa dang dbyer med kyang 'khor gyi tshul bzung ba thugs rgyud ye shes su snang ba'i phyag na rdo rjes so/ /rgyud gang la brten nas bshad ce na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus bshad/ des na brtag pa phyi ma 'di byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'o/ /gang na/ chos kun gzugs su ma grub kyang / /gzugs su yang ni rnam par btags/ /chos kun sgra ru/ sogs dang / de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di la/ /rtog pas btags pa yin par brjod/ /ces rtse mo las bshad pa ltar/ brtag pa'i rgyal po snga ma bshad tshar ba'i rjes su brtag pa phyi ma 'di bshad do/ /ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang skya ba de gdan las bzhengs nas ni/

rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs shing / rdo dril 'dzin pa'i rdo rje gsor nas kyang / ston pa shākya'i rgyal po dgyes par mdzad cing thub pa'i gtso bo de la phyag btsal nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ji lta bu zhe na/ spyir sgrib gnyis kyang rnam par dag mod/ 'dir ngan song gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje ni mi phyed pa ste/ sgrib pa dag pa la bar du gcod pas mi phyed pa'o/ /spyir phyag na rdo rje la bya spyod du sku mdog sngon por gsungs/ bla med du sku mdog gzhan gsungs mod/ 'dir brtag pa dang po'i rgyud sdud pa po dang / gnyis pa gsung ba po dang / srung 'khor bsdus pa'i phyag rdor rnams don gcig la/ sku mdog ljang skya dang / phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag rdor thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /'dir sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis 'chad pa min nam/ ji ltar drug tu 'du snyam na/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni gong du bshad zin la/ shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba bya rgyu med pas dkyil 'khor gcig nyid yin zhing / 'di gtsug dgu dang 'ga' zhig mi mtshungs te/ mi mtshungs pa dgus mi mtshungs pa'i phyir zhes zer/ dmar chos rgyal sogs la la mtshungs te dgus mtshungs pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ /'dir phyi ma'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin no/ /rgyas par phyis 'chad do/ /'o na dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis ji ltar bya zhe na/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la dbye ba byed pa ste/ de la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba 'chi bdag 'joms pa zhes bya ba zhig yin la/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la/

rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de bzhin du phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ gza' brgyad/ rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor te drug dang kun dril bas bcu gnyis so/ /tshe dpag med ni sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag steng du bum pa 'dzin pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba ni gtso bo rdo rje chos/ bde ba chen po/ kun tu bzang po gsum gang rung 'god pa yin/ me ltar 'bar ba 'di smad lugs pa rnams phyi ma'i phyi ma zhes 'dod pa de yin no/ /dang po shāka thub sku'i dkyil 'khor la lnga/ sngags 'phyung ba/ slob ma rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ phyag rgya'i ye shes/ dngos grub kyi ye shes/ nor bu dri med kyi sngon gyi skye rgyud bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags phyung bas ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha sprul bskyed gnyis bstan/ gnyis pas slob ma yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga dang / gsum pas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dngos su bstan cing / las dang chos shugs la bstan/ ye shes shes pa phyag rgya de rnams la brten nas ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa bskyed pas phyag rgya'i ye shes shes bya yi/ don la lag pa'i phyag rgya nyid yin no/ /bzhi pas ras bris la brten nas ye shes lnga'i dngos grub kyi thabs bstan/ lnga pa brtag pa gong du 'chad rgyu yin na'ang / rgyud kyi bzhugs tshul gyis 'dir 'chad do/ /dang po ni/ ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags shākya thub pa rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i sngags 'di de dang thugs rgyud dbyer med pa phyag na rdo rje nyid kyi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /'dis sngon ston pas sngags gsungs pas 'khor rnams kyis lung thob pa dang / de'i mthus sems can gyi sgrib pa dag pa bstan cing / rjes 'jug dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha sprul bskyed gnyis ka bstan to/

/gnyan ston tshul 'bar na re/ sngags 'di dag lha bskyed sngags su mi 'thad de/ brab pa'i sngags yin pa'i phyir/ gal te yin na bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa nas bshad dgos pa'i phyir te med do zhes gsungs/ brab sngags bskyed sngags su 'gal na/ sarba bid hūm̐ dang / bud+dha lo tsā ni hūm̐/ zhes sogs lha so bdun gyi snying po thams cad bskyed sngags min par 'gyur te/ de dag gis brab par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ kun rig tu/ rang gi lha dang lha gzhan gyi snying pos brab par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'og nas bshad pa'i na ra ka ga te sogs kyi brab sngags thun mong ma yin pa ni bskyed sngags su nged kyang mi 'dod do/ /de la sngags dang po lngas rim pa bzhin du gtso bo thub pa dang / rdo rje gtsug tor/ rin chen gtsug tor/ pad+ma gtsug tor/ sna tshogs gtsug tor te lnga'i sprul bskyed kyi sngags/ de nas bzhi/ gzi brjid gtsug tor/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rnam par 'thor ba'i gtsug tor/ rnam par 'joms pa'i gtsug tor te bzhi'i rim bzhin yin/ brid ta sogs gsum sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags yin la bskyed sngags ma yin/ de dra ba dra ba'i sngags dang / na rag dmyal ba dang / pre tsa ta yi dwags dang / tir+ya ga dud 'gro dang / gsum ka'i he tu na rgyu ste/ des na sngags gsum ka ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i don gyi 'phrin las kyi sngags te brab sngags thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /brab sngags bshad pa'i rjes de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod pa'i thabs kyi yo byad bshad do/ /zhes mtshams sbyar/ sngags bzhis bdug spos ma dang / me tog mar me/ dri chab ma rnams kyis so/ /de nas bzhi sgo ba bzhi 'o/ /sngags kyi phreng ba bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug pa phan yon dang bcas pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug pa phan yon dang bcas pa'o/

/dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngags phreng bshad pa'i rjes de nas snying po dang ldan pa'i lha de dag gi dkyil 'khor yang bshad de zhes sbyar/ 'khor lo la bde mchog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ rtse mo phyed/ rtsa ba phyed du 'chad/ 'dir rtsa ba sum cha/ rtse mo sum gnyis so/ /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /zhes pa yan go sla'o/ /lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bris shing mchod pa bshams pa'i rjes de nas dri zhim po'i chus kha bshal zhing lus la tsan+da la sogs pa'i dris bskus nas/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas slob dpon rang nyid dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du zhugs nas/ bdag bskyed dang bum bzlas tshul bzhin du byas te/ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs/ de nas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mos pa bskyed cing mchod nas/ slob ma kun rig tu bshad pa'i cho ga 'don pa bsgyur bas dbang bskur ro/ /phan yon ni/ ngan song thams cad las rnam par grol te nas/ byed do'i bar gyis bstan te/ de'i phyag na rdo rje hūm̐ zhes byas bsang / zhes pa ni dbang bskur gyi ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su phyag rdor la sogs pa'i lha rnams hūm̐ gi rnam par babs pa zhes so/ /snga ma bzhin du bya'o ni/ /kun rig bzhin du'o/ /gzhan go sla/ skabs 'dir slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad pa'i gtsug dgu'i gzhung dang / sbyong rgyud kyi thub pa'i skabs mthun pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ 'di la stod lugs pa rnams kyis gzhung 'di rgyud 'di'i thub pa'i skabs la brten zhes gsungs pa la/ smad lugs pa bsnyal pa nyi ma mgon la sogs pa kha cig na re/ kun snying gi gzhung thub pa'i skabs 'di la brten pa ma yin te/ 'di dang mi mtshungs pa dgus mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de la gsung ba po ston pa mi mtshungs te/

'di ni phyag rdor gyis gsungs/ gzhung de ni bsdus pa'i rgyud shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i phyir te/ de las/ dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba yi/ /cho ga shākya seṅges gsungs/ /zhes pas so/ /bsdus pa'i rgyud mi mtshungs te/ de las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga bshad/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags phreng mi mtshungs te/ 'di las/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ sogs bshad la/ de nas dur ga ti dang / mu ne bshad pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor mi mtshungs te/ 'di nas kyang rtsibs brgyad pa bshad la/ de nas kyang bshad pa'i phyir zhes pa ni phyogs snga'i don min nam snyam/ 'on te khong tsho'i gsung 'di la lha snam med la/ de la lha snam yod pas so gsungs pa 'dra'o/ /lha 'god tshul mi 'dra ste/ phyogs bzhi'i lha la 'di las ni/ /sngon la spyan sngar te shar dgod/ /de nas rgyab ste nub/ de nas g.yas g.yon rim bzhin lho byang du 'god par bshad pa'i phyir/ de las ni shar lho nub byang nas rim par bshad pa'i phyir/ mtshams la 'di las/ gzi brjid phung po me yi phyogs/ /zhes me nas dbang ldan/ rlung / srin po sogs bshad la/ de las ni dbang ldan nas/ me srin rlung rnams bshad pa'i phyir/ lha grangs mi mtshungs te/ 'dir bcu bdun/ de las so bdun bshad pa'i phyir/ lha rang gi ngo bo mi mtshungs te/ 'di las/ spyan sngar lag na rdo rje/ rgyab tu 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ g.yas su rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/ g.yon du rnam par rgyal ma rnams bshad la/ de las rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs gtsug tor sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ ngan song sbyong tshul mi mtshungs te/ 'di las smin mtshams mdzod spu nas 'od zer spro bsdu byas pas sbyong / de las/ snying kha nas byed par bshad pa'i phyir/ bstod pa mi mtshungs te/ 'di las/ sangs rgyas kun pas sogs gsungs/ de las/ khams gsum pa yi 'gro rnams kyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad cing /

/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /shākya seṅge la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rgol ba brjod nas/ rang lugs la res 'ga' tan tra tā sang gra nas btus zer/ res 'ga' rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgyud nas btus pa yin no zhes zer ro/ /de la stod lugs pa'i rjes 'brang dmar chos rgyal la sogs pa rnams kyis gtsug dgu'i gzhung kun rig nas btus pa yin te/ mi mtshungs par bshad pa rnams bzlog ste/ mtshungs pa dgus mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ thub pa'i skabs sogs shāka thub dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i phyag rdor gyis gsungs kyang / thub pa nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yin pa'i phyir/ 'on te phyag rdor gyis bshad pa tsam gyis thub pa'i bkar 'gal na/ mdo sher snying sogs thub pa'i bka' min par 'gyur ro/ /des na sbyong rgyud gtso cher thub pas gsungs pas na/ slob dpon gyis thub pas gsungs zhes brjod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gang las btus pa'i rgyud mtshungs te/ slob dpon gyi lugs kyis rgyud 'di nyid la rtsa rgyud ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon la paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan gyis/ khyed kyi rdor dbyings kyi rnam snang zhal bzhi par mi 'thad de/ de nyid 'dus pa las ma bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la/ slob dpon na re/ skyon med de/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra la/ /zhal bzhi pa la zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad pas so/ /gsum pa sngags phreng mtshungs te/ dur ga ti bshad pa nyid kyis sbyong rgyud la brten par grub bo/ /sarba pā paṃ sogs bshad pas mi 'dra na/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa sogs kun rig la yang sngags mi 'dra ba gzhan yod pas 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor mtshungs te/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi steng na lha bcu bdun gyi lha snam med pa gcig dang / lha snam yod pa so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bshad du rung ba'i phyir te/

lha snam yod pa'i so bdun ma 'dir mi 'thad pa'i shes byed med pa'i phyir/ kun rig la so bdun yod pa'i zla bos kyang so bdun bsgrub nus par 'gyur ro/ /gal te so bdun bshad na bcu bdun bshad par 'gal na/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid kyang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ sgo sbrags dang / sgo rkyang gnyis bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di nyid la rgyas bsdus gnyis bshad du rung ba las/ slob dpon gyi de rgyas pa yin no/ /lnga pa lha 'god tshul mtshungs te/ spyan sngar zhes sogs dang / shar lho sogs don la mthun pa'i phyir/ gal te 'gal na/ lag len dang rgyud 'gal bar 'gyur te/ lag len la shar du sbyong rgyal sogs 'chad la/ rgyud las/ de'i spyan sngar ngan song kun sbyong ba'i rgyal po zhes dang / rgyab tu shākya ri dbang po/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshams kyi lha 'god tshul mi mtshungs pa'i skyon med de/ dbang ldan phyogs su gdugs dkar po/ /gzi brjid phung po me yi phyogs/ /rnam par 'joms pa nir sti ni/ /rnam par 'thor ba rlung gi phyogs/ /zhes slob dpon gyi 'khrugs bsdeb nas bshad pa'o/ /des na rgyud mang por go rim dang rnam grangs mi 'dra ba 'chad byed rnams kyis go bde bar mdzad pa chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa lha grangs mtshungs te/ dngos bstan gyi bcu bdun la kun rig nas bshad pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug sgeg sogs bzhi ste nyi shu bsnan nas so bdun du bshad pas so/ /kha bskong pa nyid kyis 'gal na/ skal bzang stong bkod pa'i rdor dbyings kyang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ rdor dbyings nas stong po ma bshad pa'i phyir/ de slob dpon gyis rtse mo nas kha bskangs pas mi 'gal snyam na/ 'dir yang kun rig nas kha bskangs pas ci'i phyir 'gal/ bdun pa lha'i ngo bo mtshungs te/ rgyud du lag na rdo rje stobs chen sogs bzhi bshad la/ slob dpon gyis don thob kyi rdo rje sogs rigs bzhi'i gtsug tor du bshad pa'i phyir/

de nas gnyis 'dra la/ rdo rje rnon pos mi shes pa rnam par 'thor ba'i phyir lha de gnyis 'dra/ mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'i lha des bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa'i phyir rnam par 'joms pa dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'dra/ des na mi mtshungs pa'i skyon med do/ /brgyad pa ngan song sbyong tshul mtshungs te/ smin mtshams nas spro bsdu byed pa ni/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan/ slob dpon gyis snying kha'i dkyil 'khor bkod/ de'i gtso bo thub pa'i smin mtshams nas spro bsdu byas nas ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir ro/ /dgu pa bstod pa mtshungs te/ sangs rgyas kun pas sogs bsdus pa yin la/ slob dpon gyis lha re re la bstod pa re re gsungs pas rgyas pa'o/ /gal te kun snying gis rgyas pa bshad/ rgyud nas bsdus pa bshad pa 'gal na/ kun rig la chos dbyings ye shes sogs kyis bstod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rgyud nas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyud nas gtso bo la mtshan brgya'i sgo nas bstod pa yin la/ slob dpon gyis gtso 'khor thams cad la sh+lau ka re res bstod pas mi 'gal lo/ /khyod kyi tan tra tad tra saṃ tra na/ zhes pa de nyid 'dus pa yin pas/ de las shāka thub ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje gtsug tor zhes pa'i rgyud bod na med/ rgya gar na yod na'ang des shāka thub ston par gang gis shes/ des na gtug sa yod pa'i sbyong rgyud bor nas/ med pa'i rdo rje gtsug tor la brten zer ba ni/ mkhas pa'i rna bar 'bab pa'i tshig min no/ /zhes gsungs te shin tu legs so/ /des na rang lugs la kun snying gi gtsug dgu de nyid sbyong rgyud kyi shāka thub kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la brten pa yin no/ /da ni sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la dbang bka' med par 'dod pa dgag pa dang / dbang bka' yod kyang bskur tshul 'khrul par byed pa dgag pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ bu na re/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la stod lugs dang / smad lugs gnyis yod kyang / dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams 'phags pas/ rong pa chos mgon la zhus zer nas dbang bka' byed pa ni ma dag ste/ rong pa'i grub mtha' la rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob na/ yo ga'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur thob par khas len pa de la dgongs nas byed pa yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la bod na dbang bka' med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes chos 'byung du bkod do/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ dbang bka' med zer ba de khyed rang gi lugs la brten nas byed pa yin nam/ 'dzim pa rin she'i lugs la brten nas byed pa yin/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ khyed rang gi 'chi bdag 'joms pa la dbang bka' yod pa'i phyir dang / phyag na rdo rje la 'jig rten pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la thob cing / 'di rnams a tsi ma khyad 'phags yin zhes gsan yig tu bkod pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ ci rung rung du ma smra zhig 'phags pa rin po ches/ rong pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas dbang bskur byas pa yang ma yin te/ 'phags pas rong pa la dbang bka' med pa ma dgongs pa yang mi srid cing / rdor dbyings kyi dbang bskur thob nas kyang / dpal mchog rtse mo sogs yo ga mtha' dag gi dbang bka' zhus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dzim pa'i lugs la brten nas dbang bka' yod pa 'gog na/ 'dzim pa'i lugs la kun rig dang / gtsug dgu ma gtogs dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la dbang bka' med par 'dod de/ dkyil 'khor bcu gcig la sgrub thabs re byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ma bkod de/ bod na dbang bka' med pa'i phyir/ khyad par 'chi bdag 'joms pa la/ 'dir ni 'jug pa'i chos rnams ma bkod de/ bka' med pa'i phyir/ zhes 'dod la/ khyod kyi 'chi bdag 'joms pa la bka' byas pa'i phyir/ 'dzim pa dang yang 'gal lo/

/des na dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po la dbang bka' brgyud pa mi 'dra ba gsum tsam yod pas skur pa ma 'debs shig gnyis pa dbang bka' yod kyang lag len 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ bo dong 'jam dpal gyi slob ma/ bla ma 'dzam gling nyi shar zhes pa de dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po la nyin gcig sta gon/ nyin gcig 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug la 'jug pa rnams phyogs gcig byas/ ye shes dbab pa sogs mi 'dra ba/ mjug rnams phyogs gcig byas/ nyin gcig 'jig rten pa drug la de dang mthun par byed pa de ni mi 'thad de/ dkyil 'khor re re la 'jug pa'i chos rnams dang / dbang bskur rnams re re dgos pa'i phyir/ dkyil chog gcig las ma byung ba snyam na/ dper na rtse mo rigs bsdus la yang 'jug pa'i chos rnams gcig las ma bkod kyang / dkyil 'khor bcu po re re la re re dgos pa bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i lag len deng sang dbus phyogs sogs na dar kyang rnam dag ma yin no/ /'dzim pa blo chen gyis 'jig rten pa drug la bka'i dbang bskur mi byed zer ba yod kyang / dang po kha cig dpal mchog gi ming po gsum dang / sring mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sogs la rigs bzhi'i phyag mi byed de/ skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa 'chor ba'i phyir zer ba byung ba la/ sngon gyi yo ga ba rnams kyis rigs bzhi'i phyag gtso bo la byed pa yin pas mi 'gal gsung pa de dang mthun par/ 'dir yang bka'i dbang bskur yang gtso bo la len pas phyag len la mdzad do/ /rang lugs nyin gcig spyi'i sta gon byas nas/ nyin re la re re byed dam/ gnyis gnyis gang byed kyang / 'jug pa'i chos rnams dang dbang bskur rnams tshang ma re re mdzad/ bar du nyi ma chag na sta gon bskyor ba/ ma chag na rgyun gcig la byed pa rdo rje phreng ba dang mtshungs so/ /sta gon dang 'jug pa phyogs gcig pa de byas nas sta gon med pa'i lugs byed pa'i gang zag 'ga' re yod kyang /

rje rdo rje 'chang chen po ni dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi tshe sta gon nges par mdzad do/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi spyi'i don legs par bshad pa rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/ yang 'dir skabs su bab pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun zin zin bris 'di la sbyar byang mi snang yang / rje dpal ldan rdo rjes mdzad pa yin par rje bla ma dag gsung ngo / /bris su btab pa'i ri bo dge ldan pa'i kun rig gi 'dod pa brjod pa dang de dgag 'os par bstan pa'i yi ge las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dus phyis byung ba'i ri bo dge ldan pa rnams kyis 'dod pa'i kun rig 'di ni/ sa skya pa sogs mkhas pa'i lugs thams cad bor nas rang bzo'i lugs byed pa 'di ni gtan nas rigs par ma yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan de yi phyir na dge ldan pas 'dod pa'i log rtog rnams lung rigs rnam dag gi sgo nas gsal bar bya'o/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma byed pa ni ma bshad pas mi 'thad do/ /mchod pa byin brlab la ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa ni/ yo ga'i lugs la yin pas oṃ ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ gis chog ga'o/ /skyabs 'gro la gyer mo zhig byed 'dod pas/ thugs rje khyab pa'i sogs tshigs bcad byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ khyad par bzhi ldan dang / bla ma'i skyabs 'gro chad cing / skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa'ang mi thob pas so/ /rang phyag rdor du gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de gyur pa las khro bor gsal ba zhes zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ yo gar 'di 'dra ma bshad cing / rang gis tshad mar byed pa'i bu ston dang yang 'gal bas so/ /khro bo de g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums pas bzhugs so zer ba'ang / rin chen bzang pos rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bshad pa'i bsdus pa yin na g.yas brkyangs yin la/ bu ston sogs dang yang 'gal lo/

/oṃ dang sarba bid oṃ/ de bzhin du bid āḥ bid hūm̐ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ 'di dag don la 'bru gsum yin pas/ de gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa bla med nas bshad kyi/ yo ga nas ma bshad/ bu ston dang yang 'gal te/ bri ta sogs gsum gyis byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir ro/ /bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ sogs kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal la dbang bskur ba'ang mi 'thad de/ khro bo la khro bo'i sngags/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes bshad la/ rigs lnga'i dbang bskur med do/ /byed na'ang khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje'i rigs su kun snying bzhed pas/ rigs kyi gtso bo rnam snang byed pa yin no/ /bsnun bsreg gi skabs su hūm̐ bcug oṃ med pa'i badz+ra a na larka hūm̐ sems dpa' 'byung bar bshad pa la/ oṃ bcug hūm̐ med par 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mchod sngags oṃ yod hūm̐ med la/ hūm̐ bcug oṃ med pa sogs gnyis ka 'gal lo/ /hu lus steng gi gur/ yak+ṣas gur 'og bla bre byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ druṃ badz+ra ban+dha haṃ gis shar phyogs su stag leb sgor mo byed byas na yang mtshungs te/ yo gar ma bshad pa'i phyir las gnyis ka la med do/ /yo ga'i tshogs zhing snying kha nas sprul/ der bsdu ba yin pa la/ sarba bid maṇ+ḍal badz+ra tsakra hūm̐ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun du grub par 'gyur ro/ /gshegs tshe rang bzhin du mi dmigs par gyur ces pa'ang yo ga kun dang bu dang 'gal lo/ /tshogs zhing mchod tshe/ pra ba ra pad ka ra zer ba dang / mjug tu tshad med bzhi bsgom pa gsang 'dus nas rgyas bkab pa yin te mi 'thad do/ /gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su phyag rgya la dgag bsgrub 'ga' re yod de ma spros so/ /dang po sbyor ba'i bdag bskyed mi 'dod pa bu ston gyi yo ga'i cho ga bcu dang 'gal te/ des bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gnyis bshad/

rdo rje cho ga lnga bskyed byed pa'i shog bu rim bzhin drug gnyis tsam yod pas smad lugs min/ nges don du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i cha mthun sgrub thabs kyang med do/ /stod lugs min te/ stod lugs pa bdag nyid cho ga gsum las rdor sems su bskyed/ brid ta sogs kyis byin gyis rlob/ bud+dha sogs kyis dbang bskur ba'i bdag bskyed rtsa skya pa sogs bzhed pas so/ /stod lugs smad lugs gnyis ka dang 'gal ba'i kun rig 'di ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /kun rig gi bdag bskyed bcad nas med pa'i bya rgyud la bdag bskyed byed pa 'di 'dra gsang sngags pa kun dang mi mthun no/ /badz+ra muṣ+ṭi'i phyag rgya bkrol nas/ gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed/ cho ga gsum las gtso bo bskyed/ de'i snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las sbyong rgyal bskyed pa sogs mi 'thad pa mang ngo / /sgo srung gi rjes la bskal pa bha dra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las rdo rje bzhi bskyed/ bskal pa bha dra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa de 'phros 'dus pa las skal bzang bcu drug bskyed lo/ de ni mi 'thad de/ ming yig dang po las bskyed pa 'dir ma bshad cing / byed na'ang kaṃ las bya ba 'thad pa yin no/ /nyan thos shra wa ka rang rgyal pra te ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhes ngag 'don byed pa'ang ngag 'don dang go rgyu gnyis kyi dbye ba ma shes so/ /dper na gaṃ las go bo ri zhes pa lta bu zer dgos so/ /badz+ra kro dha'i ming dang po thig les brgyan pa las khro bo bcu drug bskyed pa'ang / snga ma'i skyon yang 'jug mod/ badz+ra rdo rje'i rigs yin/ rin chen sogs rdo rje'i ming las bskyed pa nor zhing / bran la sogs pa de dag kyang rdo rje khro bor 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad bskyed pa'i rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pa'ang / bid oṃ sogs sbyar bar rigs te gong du bshad pa'i phyir ro/

/phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs kyi skabs su'ang grub mtha' gsar pa mang po yod pas/ khong rang gis tshad mar byed pa'i bu ston dang mi mthun pas de dang des dgag par bya'o/ /'dir tshig mang du dogs pas ma bris so/ /de ltar stod lugs smad lugs gnyis/ /res 'ga' bsres shing res 'ga' ni/ /gnyis ka dang yang mi mthun pa'i/ /rang bzo'i grub mtha' 'di bor nas/ /sangs rgyas nas bzung bla ma'i bar/ /man ngag brgyud pa dang ldan zhing / /rang gzhan rjes 'jug la phan pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di la 'jug par shog /ces pa 'di'ang kun dga'i mtshan can gyis gsungs so/ /'di la dgag bsgrub rgyas par ma bris/ nor pa'i gzhung rnams bkod pas rgyas par gzhan du shes dgos so/ /zhes pa de yan gyis rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes chen gyi/ /gsung rgyun dri med mthong bas yid bskul te/ /dang 'dod dad pas zin bris phyogs gcig bsdebs/ /bsod nams 'di yis kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i dgongs pa rab rdzogs nas/ /kun dga' snying po brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan/ /kun dga'i ming can bdag gis cher gsal te/ /kun dga'i don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi lta grub kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba la gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can kun mkhyen pa'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed chos kun ji lta'i dbyings nyid du/ /ye shes mig gis rig nas thugs rje yis/ /lam mchog rnam par snang ba'i 'od mdzad pa/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'dud/ /gang thugs gnyis med dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /'khor gyi tshul 'dzin gsang rgyud bsdus mdzad pa/ /rdor sems kun bzang phyag na rdo rje sogs/ /mtshan mchog du mas spras la gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi don/ /rmad byung brgyud pa'i tshul lugs ji bzhin du/ /rang nyid dran pa gso zhing gzhan la'ang / /phan gdags ched du ci nus dbye bar bya/ /'di la don gnyis te/ bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dang / bshad pa dngos so/ sa bcad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhan phan kun khyab tu blta bar gyis shig kho bos byas pa'i bstan bcos 'dir ni thams cad de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul nyid bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ phyogs gar gtogs ngos bzung ba dang / de 'jig rten du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de la rgya bod du bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de'i brjod bya ngos bzung ba/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngags don rnam gzigs las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya ba'i rgyud/ /de ni pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum las/ kha cig rgyud 'di bdag gi rnal 'byor mi gsal zhing / bri bskyed shin tu gsal bas na/ spyod pa'i rgyud yin no zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal bar gsungs shing /
