spyod rgyud la yang bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal bas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor mi gsal ba de spyod rgyud yin pa'i shes byed du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des bya rgyud yin pa yang khegs pas na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin te/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes bde bas 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gang yin snyam na/ gro lung pas bshad rgyud dam/ phyung rgyud dam/ bsdus rgyud lta bu ma yin te/ rtsa rgyud rang rkyang ba yin pas/ 'di la rtsa rgyud dam/ rgyud rgyas pa gzhan logs na med do/ /zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid bsdus pa las gzhan pa'i yo ga'i rgyud yin na/ de nyid bsdus pa rtsa rgyud du byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bu ston gyis/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun pa'i rgyud/ 'phros pa'am/ yan lag gi rgyud drug las/ phyi ma yin te/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa las/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa dral ba la 'phros nas/ ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs rgya cher bstan pas 'phros rgyud dam/ de nyid kyi rtsa ba'i lha phal cher dum bu dang po'i lha dang phal cher 'dra zhing / de'i chas su gyur pas yan lag gi rgyud ces gsungs so/ /bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka'i don/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyi rnam phye ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun rgyud dang gsum las/ 'di cha mthun gyi rgyud yin par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/

/'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /yi dam skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis te/ nyer brgyad na rgya gar shar lho'i phyogs/ grong khyer pa ti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba byung / de la phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur te/ lha gnas gsum du grags pa de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dag gnang nas/ de nas mi yul du dar ro/ /de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud la lha gnas gsum du grags pa ni/ lha gnas dang po 'og min/ gnyis pa ri rab kyi rtse/ gsum pa bka' bsdu ba'i gnas lcang lo can dang gsum du grags pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen kun snying gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa yod par grags kyang bod du ma 'gyur zhing / ka mo dhe nus mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni bod du 'gyur yang bla med du 'grel ba'i lugs so/ /bod du rgyud 'di rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba snying po dang / lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun gyi dus su 'gyur nas/ phyis ral pa can gyi dus su a tsar+ya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa las/ dus phyis lo tsā ba gzhan gyis bcos pa ni med do/ /'di la me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas drag po'i sbyin sreg yod kyang sngon gyi rgyal blon rnams kyis sngags pas mngon spyod byas su dogs nas ma bsgyur ba yin no zhes snga ma dag 'chad pa la/ rje btsun gyis lo tsā ba phyi ma rnams kyis gzhan la 'gyur chad pa dag 'jug pa ltar 'di la yang 'jug par rigs pa las ma bcug pa'i phyir/

rgya dpe nyid la med do snyam du sems pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ pro lung pas me ltar 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi skabs nas/ de nas khung bu gsum las rnam gcig ni/ /zhes bshad pas/ mngon spyod ma gsungs pa ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid las/ rdo rje khro bo'i las dngos su/ /bsad pa yin par bshad mod kyi/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang rnams kyang / /de dag byed 'gyur gdon mi za/ /zhes las 'jam po gsum dngos su bstan pas drag po shugs las shes pa la dgongs so/ /zhes bzhed pa ni rmad du byung ba'i bshad par snang zhing lugs snga ma'i sgrub byed du 'gro'o/ /'di la bod na 'grel par ming btags pa brgyad tsam snang yang / bod kyis sbyar ba las rgya gar nas 'gyur ba ni med gsungs/ de yang gzi brjid bshad pa zhes bya ba 'dis byas cha med pa gcig dang / mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'khyin lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa dang / de nyid snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'bring mtshams kyi sprag lo chung bas byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa dang / zangs dkar gyis byas pa'i 'bru 'bum mam/ nam mkha' dri med ces bya ba khong rang gis mdzad par kha byang btab pa dang / rong zom chos kyi bzang pos byas pa'i 'grel pa dang / go rub lo tsā bas byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa 'dod 'jo'i ba bya ba dang / 'bru 'grel zhes bya ba mtshan dkyus su bcug pa gcig dang / rma rin chen mchog gis byas pa'i dris lan rgol ba mig tshar bya ba dang brgyad do/ /'o na bshad srol gang gi rjes su 'brang snyam na/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / pradz+nyā sid+dhi dang / rab 'byor bskyangs dang bzhi yin la/ kha cig swa ti pha la dang bzhi yin gyi/ rab 'byor bskyangs kun snying gi slob brgyud min zhes zer/ kha cig de gnyis ka ma yin gyi/

nyi ma'i snying po dang bzhi yin zhes zer ro/ /de bzhi char gyi slob ma kun dga' snying po ste/ 'di nyid 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ yi ge a ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes lung bstan cing / grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa las kyang / sgrol ma dkar mos byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la 'grel bshad mdzad/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa'i yon tan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /de nas pradz+nyā wa li ta/ pradz+nyā bo ti/ mu ti ta ko sha dharmā pa la rnams la rim par brgyud de/ dharmā pha la'i slob ma ni rje di paṃ ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'o/ /yang kha cig na re/ slob dpon chen po gu ha zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon zhig gis de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud dang / rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang lnga'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams 'jam dpal las dngos su thob nas/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sogs la rim pa bzhin brgyud de/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya bas de nyid bsdus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa sh+lau ka stong phrag bcu gnyis pa ko sa la'i rgyan zhes bya ba mdzad/ yang sngar slob dpon grub pa thob pa de dang ming mtshungs pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba zhes bya bas de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa mdzad de/ de ltar na don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas pa'i mi gsum du grags so/ /zhes bzhed do/ /yang kun dga' snying po'i mched grogs slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya ba 'jam dpal gyi grub pa thob cing sku che ba'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa des dpal sbas bzang po la bshad/

des bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad/ des na len+d+ra'i nub sgo ba shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros la bshad/ des bram ze bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma ka ra dang / shradha ka ra gsum la bshad/ phyi ma gnyis kyis lo chen la bshad do/ /yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje gnyis la bshad/ de la sgeg pa'i rdo rje gsang mtshan yin la/ mtshan dngos ni dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pa zhes grags shing / rin po che'i gling du bsgrub pa mdzad nas dngos grub brnyes pas nor bu gling pa zhes kyang grags/ mu stegs kyis gsod par brtsams pa'i tshe 'jam dpal du sprul nas gzugs sna tshogs su ston pas sna tshogs gzugs can zhes kyang grags/ thugs rjes gzhan la phan 'dogs pas nyi ma lta bu'i slob dpon zhes kyang grags so/ /slob dpon des sūr+ya sid+dha/ des dharmā badz+ra/ des mu tra sid+dhi/ des de wa sha ra la bshad/ de la shan+tiṃ gar+bha dang / smṛ ti dz+nyā na ste slob ma gnyis so/ /de dag la bod du ji ltar brgyud na/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po kha cher lan gsum du byon pa'i dang po la/ kha che'i mkhan po tsan+t+ra ha ri la 'jig rten snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ phyis shradha ka ra warma la gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang / mi bskyod pa gnyis dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas de dag gi bshad ka yang gsan cing 'ga' zhig bsgyur/ lan gnyis pa la paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma ka ra warmā dang / pradz+nyā ka ra warma gnyis la gtugs te yo ga'i gzhung 'grel 'ba' zhig bsgyur/ dpal mchog gi phreng chad bsabs/ dum bu dang po'i rgyud 'grel gnyis ka dag par bcos/ de yan chad kyi lo chen gyi slob ma rnams ni shrar+dha nas brgyud pa'i yo ga'i skor 'dzin pas phyag len kun dga' snying po'i lugs la byed kyang / de nyid snang ba ma bsgyur bas/

bshad pa ko sa la'i rgyan gyi steng nas bshad pas bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i chas su zhugs/ snying kha'i dbang bsdus bum pa 'cha'/ /rnam snang la mi bzhi rgyab sprod lta bu byed pa sogs bshad pa dang / lag len yang ma mthun cing / bon po 'dul ba'i ched du dbyangs la sogs pa'i spros pa yang che bar grags so/ /lan gsum pa la paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba zhes bya ba nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje'i slob mar grags shing / 'ga' zhig de gnyis mtshan dngos dang / gsang mtshan gyi khyad par ma gtogs pa gcig yin par yang 'dod la/ paṇ+ḍi ta de la kun snying gi lugs kyi lag len dang bshad pa gnyis ka zhus pas de nyid la thugs ches shing thugs rtsis che bar mdzad ces bu ston bzhed do/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i mjug tu rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pa la mnga' ris su byon pa la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor gsan pas/ kun snying gi brgyud pa bzhi par 'dug cing de yi gdams pa ma nor bar byung ste mnyes skad do/ /sbyong rgyud la yang rgyud gong 'og 'khrugs bsdebs nas mdzad pa ma gtogs gzhan nas rgyas 'geb pa mi mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su cha lugs ji bzhin pa bum pa lha gnas la rnam rgyal gcig po rdo rje'i glu ma gtogs pa rnams la dbyangs mi mdzad do/ /lo chen de la spyir slob ma mang yang thugs kyi sras mchog bzhi ste/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ mang nang gi gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ grwa pa gzhon she skyi nor dz+nyā na dang bzhi las/ dang pos dharmā pha la'i lugs ma gsan/ sngar gyi shrar+dha dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis kyi lugs 'dzin/ gnyis pas dharmā pha la'i lugs gtso bor 'dzin/ gsum pas gnyis ka'i gung srong / bzhi pas phyis kyi gzhung srong ngo / /yang gzhan du sbyangs shing der thug pa'i pu hrang pa an ston grags rin/ bya ye tshul/ gung pa dge bshes/ mang yul ba dkon mchog brtsegs te bzhi'o/

/dbus gtsang na mar dar tshul ni/ lo chen gyi drung du 'gro ba la rgyang rong spe dmar gyi rkyang po chos blo snga/ de nas shangs kyi bum ston me 'bar/ de nas nyang ston gyi lce zhar/ de nas spang kha 'dar chung gi pha gzhon nu rgya mtsho/ la stod kyi brag steng pa/ snul phyi ru'i dmar ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan no/ /mdog blo ston/ bal shākya rdo rje/ thang ston kong ga ba/ mdog gong ga ba rnams te/ de dag phal cher lo chen la thug pa tsam byas nas gtso bor lo chung gi drung du sbyangs te/ dbus gtsang gi sa cha smad phyogs su dar bas yo ga smad lugs su grags so/ /yang lo chen gyi slob ma brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ des mal la/ des sa skya pa la brgyud de sa cha stod du dar ba rnams la yo ga stod lugs su grags so/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la nas/ jo bo rje/ go mi bsgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ snyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snul nyi ma 'od zer sogs nas brgyud pa la jo bo'i lugs sam/ rtsa snur 'dzim gsum nas brgyud pa zhes grags so/ /bshad srol de dang brag steng pa nas brgyud pa de dang / lo chung nas dbus pa ge ser/ gnam kha 'ub pa/ sa chen rnams la rim pa bzhin brgyud pa'i bshad pa rnams la rtsing zhib bag re dang cho ga gong 'og mi mthun pa bag re ma gtogs phal cher ni 'dra ba nyid du snang zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la'i lugs brag steng pa nas brgyud pa 'di la rje btsun rin po ches rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag gzhan phan spyi chings/ rgyud kyi sa bcad dang mchan gnyis/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa gzhan phan 'od zer dang / gzhan phan nyer mkho gnyis te/ de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas bshad par bya ba yin no/ /bzhi 'di man chad yo ga'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang / rgyud kyi don che rags khong du chud pa la phan pa'i phyir bris pa lags/ pa la gsum ste/

brjod bya'i dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ gsung pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor gyur pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ro bsreg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gcig las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bzhi ste bcu bdun ni brjod bya'i gtso bo yin la/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / kun rig dang / shākya thub pas dpang po byas nas ras la bris pa dang gsum du phye na so drug dang / sdom pas bzhi bcu zhe gcig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la kun rig rtsa ba'i rgyud nas kun rig gi dkyil 'khor dang / ro bsreg gi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang / ras bris dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa tsam bstan/ rgyud phyi ma las shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang / ro sbyong ba'i thabs rgyas pa dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cung zad gsal bar byed pa rnams ston/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sngar gyi ro bsreg gsal bar byed pa ston no/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang / las gsum gyi sbyin sreg gong gi rnams gsal bar byed pa'i phyir rgyas par ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang de dag thams cad don bsdu na ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa dang / ras bris la brten te sgrub pa dang / rang dang gzhan gyi don gyis las la sbyar ba zhes bya ba gsum du yang gsungs pa yin no/ /yang de dag gi don bsdu na/ sngon du slob ma smin par bya ba dang / smin pa des dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab par bya ba dang /

phyag rgya'i ye shes la bslab pa dang / mtshan ma thob nas rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa zhes pa gsum du'ang bsdu ba yin no/ /yang de dag thams cad kyi don dgongs pas bsdu na/ rang gi don dang / gzhan gyi don gnyis su 'du la gzhan don la tshe dang ldan pa'i don bya ba dang / tshe 'das pa'i don bya ba gnyis kyis bsdus pa yin no/ /de ltar na de dag thams cad bsdu na 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ brjod bya'i gtso bo ni dkyil 'khor drug gam bcu gnyis yin la/ ro sreg dang sbyin sreg gnyis ni de'i 'phrin las yin zhing / bzlas pa dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes rnams ni de dag gi grogs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /de dag nyams su len na thog mar slob ma smin par byas la ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa bya zhing ras bris la brten nas bsgrub ste/ rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las la sbyar na gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ji ltar 'dod pa 'grub cing / mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub pa yin no zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su dkyil 'khor bstan la/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su sbyin sreg bstan to/ /de yang bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis gsungs/ dngos por mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i ched du ro sreg gi sbyin sreg dang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnyis gsungs/ de dag gi go rim yang thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos kyang / rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa'i rtags su rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems su 'dus kyang thugs rjes ngan song gi rgyu 'bras gzhom pa'i phyir shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/

de ltar rgyu 'bras tsam yang glo bur gyi rkyen gyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'chi yang sngon gyi las kyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'chi bdag bcom yang 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas don mdzad dgos pas 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang ma rung pa 'dul dgos pas me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs so/ /ma rung pa btul yang dngos por lta ba sun phyung dgos pas ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de sun phyung yang thugs rje chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ de ltar ma g.yos kyang 'gro ba'i don mdzad dgos pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ de ltar don mdzad kyang 'khor ba dbang du bsdu dgos pas ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ dbang du bsdus kyang ma rung pa la mngon spyod kyi las dgos pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ 'jig rten pa'i gnod pa rnams zhi zhing 'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i phyir du 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gsungs la/ so so'i dgos pa ni gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /lnga pa rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag ni/ spyir rgyud 'chad tshul la 'grel chen dri med 'od kyis dus 'khor bsdus rgyud 'chad pa lta bu rgyud 'grel pas 'chad pa dang / gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gzhung phran rnams la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'chad pa lta bu rgyud gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa lta bu dang / rgyud rgyud nyid kyis 'chad pa dang gsum yod pa las/ 'di ni phyi ma ste sa chog gzhan du kha 'phangs pa dang / sems dpa' bcu drug 'god par gsungs kyang de'i zhal phyag ma gsungs pa rnams rgyud gzhan gyis kha bskangs pa ma gtogs rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yod pa rnams ni brtag pa gong 'og 'khrugs bsdebs nas nyams su blang ba yin gyi/

rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab pa la sogs pa mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul 'di rgyas par shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhan phan kun khyab tu blta bar gyis shig 'khrugs ji ltar bsdebs pa'i tshul ni 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su rtogs par bya'o zhes pa de rnams kyis kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge'i gsung rab mchog /gang la bltas kyang rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /dgongs don 'grel ba mkhas rlom gzhan dag gis/ /'gran zla bral la kho bos nges shes brnyed/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i sa skya'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /bsod nams seṅge'i gsung rab 'dir zhugs na/ /bsod nams chen pos don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅge'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes chen dam par mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing / mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis rgyud phyug pa'i chos kyi rje kun dga' blo gros zhes bya ba'i yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyis rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim nas lo gnyis dang zla ba bzhi zhag gsum lon pa'i tshe mdzad pa'i yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi spyi rnam las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ yo ga zhes pa sgra pa rnams kyis yo tsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes pa/ shing gnyis phan tshun sbyar nas mi 'bral bar byed pa dang 'dra bar/ thabs shes dbyer med du sbyar zhing zung du 'jug pa la bya ste/

rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug la/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes so/ /thabs shes gnyis kyang skabs 'dir/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zab cing rgya che zhes bya gang / /rnam par mi rtog zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di dag bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /ces so/ /khyad par 'phags tshul spyi rnam bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde de la dbye na gsum las/ rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud don nye bar bsdu ba ste/ de rnams dang por byung zhing bshad gzhir gyur pas so/ /de nyid 'dus pa la dum bu bzhi las/ dang pos rdo rje dbyings/ gnyis pas khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsum pas 'gro 'dul/ bzhi pas don grub/ rgyud phyi ma ni/ de'i mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa dang / ma tshang ba kha skong / phyi ma'i phyi ma ni/ lag na rdo rjes yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ khyod kyi sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rgya che ba dang / rigs sngags kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba khyad par du 'phags mod/ snyigs dus kyi sems can tshe thung bas bsdus pa gcig bstan na/ zhus pas sangs rgyas kyis dum bu bzhi ka'i nyams len dril nas phyi ma'i phyi ma gsungs/ de'i tshul sems dpa' 'byung chung du bkod do/ /rgyud nye bar bsdu ba ni/ ri rab kyi steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / dkyil 'khor dang / nyan pa sogs kyi sprul pa bsdus nas 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la gnyis las/ dum bu so so'i bshad pa'i rgyud ni thams cad gsang ba ste/ 'di nas rdor dbyings sgo rkyang / lha snam la skal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug bkod pa ston cing / gzhan yang dum bu bzhi ka'i lam gyi 'gros dang rnam gzhag shin tu gsal bar ston no/ /dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa ste/

'di nas dum bu gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid 'jig rten pa mang pos bskor ba kha bskangs te ston cing / dum bu bzhi ka'i lam gyi rnam gzhag la phan 'dogs pa yin no/ /dum bu spyi'i bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo ste/ 'di la badz+ra shi ṣa rwa'am/ sngags kyi sde snod rgya cher rol pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /rdo rje rtse mo ni/ gsang ba thams cad kyi rigs mthon por gyur pa ste/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /'di nas gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su/ le dgu'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ grwa bzhir lha mo'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ston cing / de yang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsags pa la rin po che dang / lcug ma la sogs pa'i ra bas bskor cing / rigs lnga ma gtogs lha mo la gzhal yas khang mi byed pa yin no/ /slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus dpal mchog 'grel chung las/ rtsa rgyud rgyud don shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun rgyud kyi rnam par dbye/ /zhes 'byung bas cha mthun gyi rgyud ni/ dpal mchog dang po la sogs pa ste/ dpal mchog la sher dum dang / sngags dum gnyis las/ dang po gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du yo ga'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i bkod pa mdzad nas/ sher phyin gyi mdo rnams dang mthun par sher dum gsungs shing / de nas lag na rdo rjes zhus pa'i don du 'khor rnams la dpal mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ da ni de dag gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ zhes sher dum gyi nang gi a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /zhes pa lta bu la dkyil 'khor re ston pa dang bcas pa gsungs so/ /'di nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum/ rigs bsdus gzhal yas khang sgo nyis sbrags kyi dbus su/ le dgu la dkyil 'khor dgu dang / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i grwa bzhir/

zhi ba mdung gi dkyil 'khor/ dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor/ ming po gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ sring mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi brjod bya gang ston sogs ni spyi chings bzhin la/ bod kyi yig cha yod tshul cung zad cig rjes su'o/ /sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa phyogs gcig pa ni/ chag los bsgyur nas bsdus don dang mchan sogs byas yod kyang / bu ston gyis yo ga che ba'i lugs su 'dug cing / kun snying gi gtsug dgu'i gzhung ni chung ba'i lugs su 'dug la/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i cho ga rnams rgyud so so nas btus par bzhed pa la/ rdor dbyings kyi cho ga 'brel chags su 'byung bas 'di nas de bsdus sam/ de nas 'di bsdus brtag go /gsungs pa ni thugs rtog zhugs pa yin te/ rgyud de nyid brtag pa gong ma'i kun rig dang / 'og ma'i shāka thub go brjes/ cho ga rdor 'byung bzhin kha bskangs/ mjug na yang gtsug dgu'i rgyud rgyas pa dpe nub nas med pa la/ kun snying dang a bh+ya'i man ngag la brten nas brtsams zhes 'byung bas rgyud kyi nang du mi bgrangs so/ /sa paṇa gyis su ga ta shrī las gsan nas bsgyur pa'i/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le gsum la/ dang po nas/ rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo bcu sbrags gcig 'byung / gzhan gnyis nas rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor ston cing / phyi ma dpal mchog dang mthun shas che'o/ /mtshan brjod ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba khri drug stong yod pa'i nang nas 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa glur blangs pa phan yon dang bcas pa zur du phyung ba yin no/ /rab gnas kyi rgyud ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud rgyas pa zhig gi le'u dang po zur du phyung ba yin zhing / bla med dang thun mong lta bur snang yang /

bzhugs sa 'dir byas so/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ding sang bod na bzhugs pa de rnams su nges so/ /rgyud de rnams kyi 'grel tshul la/ kha cig tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po zhes sogs kyi brda chad yod kyang / de rnams su ma nges pas 'dir 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bkral ba'i tshul dang / za hor gyi paṇa grub rnams kyis bkral ba'i tshul gnyis so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan 'phags yul ba rang la yang nang sel gyi mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang / lam gyi spyi mi 'dra ba med la/ za hor pa rnams rgyud de'i dbye ba gsum du bsdud pa sogs spyi mi 'dra ba che bas lung de gnyis so sor bzhag go /de yang ma rgyud la/ 'phags yul gyi ma rgyud dang / sham+bha la'i ma rgyud gnyis spyi mi 'dra bas dbye ba bzhin no/ /de la 'phags yul ba las sangs rgyas gsang bas/ tan tra a wa ta ra/ bod skad du rgyud la 'jug pa zhes pa mdzad pa la/ rgyud la 'bru bsnan pa med cing / rdor dbyings kyi cho ga lag len du dril nas gsungs shing / rigs lnga dge slong gi tshul du mdzad/ 'di dang 'bru 'grel rgan po gnyis slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs so/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis ko sa la'i rgyal po'i don du rgyud kyi 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad/ 'grel pa de'i mjug tu/ nyid kyi slob dpon bcu gcig tsam brgyud pa dang bcas pa bris kyang / rab gsal zla ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pa mi 'byung ngo / /'di'i rjes 'brang gi gzhung phran/ dpal ldan rgya che ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje lta bu'i dkyil chog kun tu bzang po'i sbyin sreg sogs bzhi tsam 'byung ngo / /phreng bar gsungs pa'i chos dbyings gsung dbang / gtsug dgu rnams kyang 'phags yul ba'i srol yin la/ 'grel tshul bla med dang bstun nas bskyed chog rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor byed do/

/rigs byin gyi kṛ ya sam gra har bshad pa'i yo ga rnams bsnyen pa rgyas pa yan kun snying dang mthun kyang / rig pa'i dbang / slob dpon sogs phreng ba dang mthun cing / dbang gong ma gsum yang bris pa yod de/ 'phags yul bar bzhag gis/ kun snying sogs za hor ba'i lugs min te/ khong rnams gsang dbang rdo rje dril bu nas 'bras tsam dang rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan nas 'bras tsam slob ma'i mtheb srin gyi bar du ster ba la byas shing / shes rab ye shes kyang ye shes kyi mig gis shes rab stong nyid la blta ba la byas kyi/ bla med ltar mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rtse mo la yang 'phags yul bas bkral ba'i srol yod cing / dpal mchog 'grel chung dang / dpal mchog rdor sems kyi sgrub thabs sogs 'phags yul ba'i srol yod do/ /sbyong rgyud la dza lan+dha ra'i slob dpon ka mo dhe nu'i 'grel pa yod cing / de yang bla med ltar bkral lo/ /mtshan brjod la yo gar bkral ba lugs gsum dang / bla med du bkral ba lugs gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'phags pas gtso bo dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / byis pa'i cha byad kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya la gzigs nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid dge slong gi tshul du bstan pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ de nas rigs lnga la byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes gtso byas pa'i rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang cha 'dra bar ston cing / 'di la nam mkha' dri med chung ba zhes zer ro/ /'di nas dbang bzhi'i gsang dbang la/ a ka ru dang / du ru ka bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha kha ra rnams sbyar ba'i khu ba slob ma'i lce la ster ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la bsam gtan bzhi'i rtse mo chang zhes pa la brten nas bsam gtan bzhi'i gnas lte snying mgrin spyi'i 'khor lo bzhir/ ra pa tsa na bzhi bsgom/ ra yig las me byung 'khor lo rnams kyi byang sems zhu bas bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/

zhes pa'i don dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa skye ba 'byung ngo / /slob dpon de'i dngos slob slob dpon byang chub mchog ces kyang bya/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ sna tshogs gzugs can zhes kyang zer ba des 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs/ sgrub thabs gsang ldan dkyil chog yon tan kun 'byung rnams mdzad/ gzhung phran 'di gnyis la mtshan dgod mi dgod gnyis las/ phyi ma dgod pa'i lugs/ de yang 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs rgyud ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin nyid/ rigs lnga'i gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa de la rnam snang gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs nas/ don grub kyi bar 'byung ba/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas sogs te/ 'di ltar mtshams sbyor du byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / a las byung ba dang / zhes sogs rnam snang gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'dzin pa rnams dkar po/ g.yas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang / g.yon po ti 'dzin pa nas/ don grub kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'dzin pa rnams ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang / g.yon po ti 'dzin pa sogs kyi lhar bskyed/ phyag rgya bzhi'am/ dam rgya dngos su bshad nas/ lhag ma gsum las rgya rtags bkod pa dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni gzhal yas khang sgo gsum sbrags/ 'jig rten 'khor yug la/ gzhal yas khang zlum po dang bcas pa gtso bo 'jam dbyangs dang / rnam snang tha mi dad dkar po/ mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ces sogs la/ rab tu dga' ma dang zhes sogs kyi 'khor gyi ming mdzad de/ phar phyin dang sngags ro gcig tu sbyar bar bzhed do/ /de bzhin du pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul/ /zhes pa la/ sbyin pa ma dkar po rin po che'i snod 'dzin pa zhes sogs 'byung ngo / /des na 'di rnams rdo rje 'byung ba sogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/

brgyud pa yang klu sgrub dang / shākya bshes gnyen/ in+t+ra bhu ti sogs dang / byams rtse mo/ pa mgon po sogs la bsnyeg pa yin no/ /za hor pa'i byung tshul ni dpal sdom pa phyi ma'i rgyud ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud phyi ma'i brtag pa bdun pa las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba las/ nga mi snang ba ste sangs rgyas 'das nas ring bsrel bgos pa'i rjes nas/ lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis te nyi shu rtsa brgyad na/ de nyid 'dus pa/ dang po 'og min/ de nas ri rab kyi rtse/ de nas byang phyogs lcang lo can du gsungs pas lha gnas gsum du grags pa de ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ dpal zhes bya ba'i ri de'i rtse mor/ grong khyer pa ti kirti te/ 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams dang / bus/ pa ti kirti zhes bshad kyang / spro lung kun smon gyis/ pā ti kirti/ bod skad za hor zhes bshad pa don la gnas pa 'dra'o/ /rgyal po tsa zhes bya ste tsan+t+ra pra se na ste/ bod skad du rab gsal zla ba/ de la phyag na rdo rjes rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul te dbang bskur nas/ tan tra sde bco brgyad yo gar bkral ba'i man ngag gnang ba yin no/ /de'i dngos slob bzhi zhes bya ba ltar na rgyal ba nyid kyi sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ swasti pha la/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ shes rab grub pa rnams so/ /kha cig tu ye shes rdo rje zhes pa ni/ gnas brtan byang bzang gi slob ma bya rgyud pa de yin zhing / de lo chen gyis dang po dbang skur zhu sa tsan+t+ra ha ri'i dngos slob yin pas mi bgrangs/ kha cig tu nyi ma'i snying po zhes kyang 'byung ste/ 'dir shes rab grub pa'o/ /slob dpon ye shes dpal gyi tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa las/ sgra gcan 'dzin la sras po dang sras mo mang du bshad/ de gnyis ka nas brgyud pa 'di yin zhes kyang 'byung ngo /

/rab 'byor bskyangs kyi slob ma kun snying / des rgyud sde brgya rtsa brgyad la 'grel pa mdzad par brtsams pa las ma rnyed nas dpal mchog sogs la gnyis gnyis mdzad ces pa ni/ dpal mchog la sher dum/ sngags dum gnyis yod pa la 'khrul pa yin la/ rang lugs la rnying ma ba rnams tan tra sde bco brgyad ces 'dod pa rnams la 'grel pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de'ang rnying ma bas rtsa rgyud dang / yan lag gi rgyud gnyis su byas pa'i phyi ma la ding sang ngos 'dzin 'chugs 'dug na'ang / rtsa rgyud la/ mnyam sbyor sku'i rgyud/ zla gsang thig le gsung gi rgyud/ gsang ba 'dus pa thugs kyi rgyud/ rdo rje bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud/ karma mā la 'phrin las kyi rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu dra kha bskong gi rgyud dang drug tu phye zhing / zla gsang thig le yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa yod pa lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dpe cha'i dkar chag tu 'byung zhing / karma ma la las kyi phreng ba ste/ sangs rgyas gsang bas dpung bzang don 'grel bar/ las kyi phreng ba las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug chu yi dbus su spyan drangs te/ zhes rgyud rnam dag tu mdzad pas/ drug po 'di rgyud dri ma med par snang ngo / /slob dpon kun snying gi drung du pradz+nyā wa li tas byon te/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang dang bshad pa mang du gsan/ dkyil chog rtsom par gsol bas/ spros pa chung ba'i dbang du byas rdo rje 'byung ba dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal mdzad/ pradz+nyā wa li tas rgya gar du/ slob dpon gyi snyan pa brjod pas/ rgyal pos mchod gnas su spyan drangs/ sngar nags su bzhugs pas spros pa chung yang / de dus rgyal po 'byor pa che bas de rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du spros pa che ba'i tshul du/ de nyid snang chen brtsams/ de'i dum bu dang po'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la rigs bzhi'i slob dpon du dbang bskur ba sh+lau ka stong phrag bcu drug yod pa po ti bzhir byas pa/

rgyud nyer bsdu yan gyi 'grel pa yod do/ /dum bu dang po gnyis la dkyil chog kha 'phangs pa yod do/ /phyi ma gnyis la 'bru snon tshar ba'i rjes su/ da ni de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad par bya ste/ zhes khrus nas gshegs gsol gyi bar dkyil chog nag 'byams su 'byung ba'o/ /yang slob dpon gyis sems dpa' 'byung ba che chung gnyis mdzad/ che ba ni rdo rje 'byung ba la bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gnyis kyis bsdus pa de yin te/ gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba yan de dang 'dra ba la/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar bskyed nas thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' kho na bskyed pa sems dpa' gcig ldan gyi rnal 'byor kho na ston no/ /sems dpa' gcig ldan rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa la byed pa ni ma yin te/ rnal 'byor bdag rdzogs kyang der 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sems dpa' 'byung chung ni/ me tog gang phog gi lha'i rnal 'byor ston pa ste/ dngos su rdo rje sems dpa' la sbyar te mdzad pas rdo rje dril bu'i bar du 'gro rgyu yin no/ /'di la srung 'khor med/ phyag bzhi rgyun bshags sngon du song nas gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed/ snying khar rdor sems rnal 'byor gcig ldan bsgom pa zhig ston no/ /rin po che pas 'di la brten nas mi 'chi gnyis la/ snying kha'i lha'i sku la bstim par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs mod/ der ni snying khar lhar bskyed pa med do/ /yang slob dpon gyis dpal mchog gi 'grel pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa po ti drug yod pa mdzad/ der rigs rkyang dkyil 'khor bcu gsum po re re la yang khrus nas gshegs su gsol ba'i bar gyi dkyil chog nag 'byams tshar bcu gsum 'byung ngo / /sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad zer yang bod du ma 'gyur/ gzhan yang gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog

sher phyin gyi dkyil chog gsang 'dus/ mnyam sbyor/ rnam snang sgyu dra yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa nas/ kun rig gi sbrang mdo dang bsre ba'i bar te yo ga'i bstan bcos po ti nyi shu tsam slob dpon gyis mdzad do/ /gzhan yang bod du ma 'gyur yang / tan tra sde bco brgyad yo gar bkral ba la/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud sogs dang / gnyis med rnam rgyal bu ston gyis bsgyur pa sogs la slob dpon gyi 'grel pa yod pa 'dra ste/ 'di dag yo gar bkral ba la mi 'grig pa med pas so gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mu ti ta ko shas mdzad pa'i 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon ye shes dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa/ rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa/ yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi 'grel pa rnams kyang slob dpon kun snying gi rjes 'brang yin zhing / de dag kyang yo ga che ba dang chung ba'i lugs gnyis su 'dus so/ /bod 'dir bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba snying po dang / lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis sbyong rgyud bsgyur cing / paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid la brgyud/ de'i dbang bshad byung yang ding sang chad do/ /de dus ye shes 'od 'phro'i kun rig gi dkyil chog chags med rgyal po'i sbyin sreg paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyi mchod rten gyi cho ga rnams bsgyur cing / de gsum la rigs gsum zhes grags so/ /yang de dus slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bod kyi gangs gzigs pa la byon pas/ lo tsā ba dbas mañju warmas sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bshad gsan/ 'bru 'grel rgan po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad kyang zer/ slob dpon gyi gsung bgros lo tsā bas btab pa'am/ yang zhi ba snying po'i gsung bgros yin nam yang zer ro/ /rgyud de rma rin chen mchog gi sa bcad kyis kyang bcos so/

/phyi dar gyi mgo la lo chen gyis de nyid 'dus pa dang / dpal mchog hong kong can bsgyur/ sku tshe'i stod la rgya gar ba sangs rgyas zhi ba mnga' ris stod du byon pa la dbang bshad la sogs gsan kyang / phyag len rdor 'byung la brten cing / bshad pa ko sa la'i rgyan la brten nas mdzad/ kun rig kyang lha sngags sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa la cho ga rdor dbyings kyis rgyas bkab pa'i bshad pa yam me ba gcig gnang / lugs de rnams 'dzin pa la lo chen/ lo chung legs she sa cha smad kyi shangs chab lha khang gi sum ston me 'bar/ g.yag sde bye ma lung gi gnyan ston tshul 'bar/ nyang stod kyi rkyang bu chos blo/ sre'u chung gi lce ston khar ba/ rong ri lugs phug pa rong pa chos mgon sogs la brgyud de sa cha smad du dar ba yo ga smad lugs/ sku tshe'i smad la kha che 'dul 'dzin dharma pha la bod du byon nas rdor dbyings lugs gnyis/ khams gsum rnam rgyal rnams kyi dbang bka'/ dum bu dang po'i bshad bka'/ dpal mchog rigs rkyang bsdus pa gnyis/ kun rig gi dbang / gtsug dgu'i dbang / dpal mchog dang sbyong rgyud sogs kyi bshad bka' gsan/ de'i rgyud 'dzin brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ gu rib pa rin chen bsod nams/ snul phyi ru pa rnams las brgyud de sa cha stod du dar ba stod lugs/ sku tshe'i mjug tu jo bo byon pa la bde gsang sogs las yo ga ma gsan/ skyi nor dz+nyā na'i slob ma go mi sgom chen gyis sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis kyi dbang bshad zhus nas/ bla ma skyi nor la gnang / des snyal pa nyi she des snur nyi ma 'od zer rnams las brgyud de/ rtsa sgyur 'dzim gsum gyi bar du byung ngo / /rdo rje rtse mo ni zangs dkar lo tsā bas/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī la dbang bshad zhus nas bsgyur/ 'grel pa yang mdzad de/ dngos slob rong pa chos mgon/ de nas brgyud de smad lugs pa rnams la de'i dbang byung ste ding sang yang yod do/

/de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa man gyi 'grel pa dang / dpal mchog gi 'grel pa gnyis/ rgyud kyi hong kong rnams kyang lo chen nyid dang / lha bla ye shes 'od kyis phyis bsgyur to// ༈ //rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la ni stod smad gnyis ka'i lugs bzhugs te/ stod lugs ni/ brag steng pa/ mal/ de la rje sa chen/ smad lugs lo chung / dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'ub pa/ gcung chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de la rje sa chen gyis gsan/ sbyong rgyud la 'grel pa 'gyur ba ka mo dhe nu'i de nyid yin la/ gzhung phran kun snying gi gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog des mdzad zer yang / smṛrtis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog de nyid kyis bsgyur ba dang / kun rig gi sbyin sreg mdo dang la sogs yod do/ /bod kyi srol la jo bo rje'i bshad lugs kyi rjes 'brang dang / 'bru 'grel rgan po dang / lo chen gyi bla ma gsum gyi gsung bgros/ gu rib lo tsā bas zin bris su btab pa 'dod 'jo'i ba zhes pa rnams gong 'og gi cho ga mi mthun pa 'ga' re ma gtogs/ rgyud khog bsdebs kyi bshad par 'dra zhing / phyi ma 'dod 'jo'i ba gzhan phan 'od zer gyi rtsom stan lta bu yin no/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa 'di rnams rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas sbyong rgyud gsung dus kyi/ spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / byung tshul rgyas par gsungs pa mdor bsdus nas/ gzhan phan skor gsum du dngos su yi ger ma bkod pa rnams bris pa yin no/ /spyod rgyud las khyad par 'phags tshul rgyas par gsungs te nyid kyi spyi rnam du gsal bas ma bris so/ /gzhan rnams kyang sa bon tsam yin no/ /slob dpon dpal gyi gsung bgros zin bris byed pa la rang bzo chung ba yin pas khong gis mdzad pa'i yo ga'i spyi bshad kyi zin bris btsal bas ma rnyed do/ /'di ni kho bo rang gi blo la ma brjed pa rnams dang / rdo rje spun gzhan gyis phar bsdu tshur bsdu byas pa rang gi blo la yod pa dang gang mthun rnams bris te blo bzo rnams ngag 'phro bcad do/

/spyir bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bstan pa 'ba' zhig la bsam dgongs mdzad pa/ bdag cag lta bu'i skal dman la yang / phyi rabs su bstan pa'i bye brag skra'i rtse mo tsam re la yang phan par dgongs te/ thugs dges pa chen pos rgyun mi chad par bu gcig pa lta bur brtse ba de la/ chos kyi rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pas gsol ba yun ring du btab ste/ sbyong rgyud gsung ba'i dus su/ dang po rgyud 'di'i lam gyi 'gros dang / cho ga'i rnam gzhag nges par bya ba'i phyir du bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i bshad pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha lung dang bcas pa la zhag bco lnga tsam mdzad/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud khyad par du 'phags chos la nyi ma gnyis tsam/ ston pas sprul bshad mdzad/ yo ga gsung tshul la nyin gcig de nas rtsa bshad cha mthun rgyud du 'gro tshul la nyin gcig de nas rgyud sde'i dbye ba zhib tu bstan pa la nyin gcig de za hor dang 'phags yul du byung tshul la nyi ma gsum tsam/ bod du ji ltar dar tshul la nyin gcig bye brag tu sbyong rgyud bshad pa'i spyi'i brjod bya ngos bzung ba la nyin gcig la spyi chings kyi lung dang bcas pa/ de nas rgyud dngos la rje btsun gyi mchan 'di bshad pa'i rtsa ba yin pas gsungs nas yi ge na gcig kyang ma lus pa dang / sa bcad dang bcas pa/ gzhan phan 'od zer gang mkho mkhor gsungs shing / gzhan yang 'jig rten 'khor yug gi skabs su 'bru 'grel/ mtshan brgya'i skabs su gnyan ston tshul 'bar gyi ṭīk+ka nas 'bru snon len/ gzhan yang gang skabs su babs pa'i dgag bsgrub mtshungs pa dgus mtshungs pa sogs sngon gyi dge bshes chen po rnams kyis dgag bsgrub mdzad pa'i rjes brjod bskyor ba dang / gang 'grig gi rgya gzhung bzang po rnams dang yang sbyor bar mdzad cing / phyis kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa rnams la dgag bsgrub mdzad la/

gzhan rnams re zhig btang snyoms su mdzad de/ de ltar na gzhung steng du phebs nas zla gcig tsam bshad pa gnang ngo zhes pa de rnams kyis rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i yongs 'dzin la/ /dad brtson ldan pa'i slob mas nyer gtugs te/ /zab yangs chos tshul rgya mtsho nos pa'i tshul/ /'di 'dra skal bzang dang ba 'dren pa'i gzhi/ /kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyun/ /kun mkhyen bla ma rnams kyis spel ba'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i rnam thar dang mtshungs 'di/ /kun mkhyen 'dod pa rnams kyi blang byar rigs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// ༈ //spyi don drug pa mkhas pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob mar gyur cing / mkhyen rab tshad med pa dang ldan pas gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga gzhan phan lhun grub ces bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dir ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga gzhan phan lhun grub ces bya ba/ de'i don gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ spyi don gyi sgo nas rgyud kyi dbye ba/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag skabs su babs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la mdo sngags gnyis kyi khyad par gsungs tshul/ rgyud sde'i dbye ba/

bye brag tu rnal 'byor rgyud ngos bzung pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phar phyin theg pa la rgyu'i theg pa dang / gsang sngags la 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ji yin snyam na/ phar phyin theg pa la rgyu'i theg pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyu lam nyams su len pa la bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa yun ring du 'gor ba'i phyir dang / rgyu mi 'dra ba bla ma skyel ba dang / bsu ba sogs kyis 'bras bu mi 'dra ba phyag dang / zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa sogs sgrub par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje theg pa la 'bras bu'i theg pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po tshe 'di nyid dam/ 'chi kha'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du nges par 'grub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / rgyu 'dra ba rang lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lha skur bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po las/ 'jam dbyangs kyis gsol pa/ 'dren pas theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /'bras bu gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa ci ma gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ong dus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par gzhan yang yod de/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud dang / su sid+dhi ka ra legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sogs sgrub byed mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde'i dbye ba la/ rgyud sde gnyis dang / gsum dang /

bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu dbye ba rnams yod pa las/ dang po ni/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum phyi dang / bla med la nang gi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ phyi nang dbye ba shes pa yis/ /rgyud sde'i dbye ba shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde gsum du dbye ba ni/ bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum du bzhed de slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya ba'i rgyud/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa las/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pa/ /dum bu las bshad rang bya 'am/ /bsgrub pa 'di ni thams cad du/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ thams cad du ces pa'i 'bru snon la/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos de nyid snang chen du/ thams cad zhes bya ba ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / gnyis ka'i rgyud rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dpung pa bzang po la sogs pa bya ba'i rgyud dang / rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang / de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud dam/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams la bzhed do/ /gsum pa rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba ni/ brtag gnyis las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / /rgod dang bltas pa 'khrig pa ste/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / /rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa rgyud sde lngar dbye ba ni/

ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa'i mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang / gsang ba spyi rgyud la sogs pa bya ba'i rgyud dang / rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang / de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang rnam pa lngar 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pas bzhed do/ /grub chen bha wa bha dra dang / a bh+yas rnal 'byor bla med la gnyis su phye nas rgyud sde lngar bzhed do/ /lnga pa rgyud sde drug tu dbye ba ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang / gsang ba'i yang gsang ba ma'i rgyud mthar thug pa 'khor lo bde mchog dang drug tu jo bo nā ro ta pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa bzhed do/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud ngos bzung ba la/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgra bshad/ de'i dbye ba/ bye brag tu ngan song sbyong rgyud bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgra pa rnams kyis yo tsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes pas shing gnyis phan tshun sbyar nas lcags gzer la sogs pas bsdams te mi 'bral bar byed pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dir brjod bya thabs shes rab gnyis phan tshun dbyer med du sbyar nas zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i don la byas te/ de skad du yang gsang 'dus kyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug la/ /rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis po de ji lta bu zhe na/

rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zab cing rgya che zhes bya gang / /rnam par rtog med zab pas te/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /ces gsungs pas thabs rgya che ba snang phyogs lha sum cu so bdun la sogs pa gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul dang / de nyid shes rab zab mo stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar nyams len gcig gi steng du dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pas na yo ga zhes bya la/ de nyid brjod byar ston pa'i rgyud sde rnams la yang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa de lta bu'i rgyud sde la dbye na/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dum bu bzhi pa rgyud phyi ma dang / phyi ma'i phyi ma dang / rgyud don nye bar bsdus pa dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba/ gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa dum bu phyi ma gnyis la thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud med do/ /thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo ste rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bdun no/ /gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud ni/ dpal mchog gi rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rab gnas kyi rgyud dang bdun yod do/ /de ltar na bod du 'gyur ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rkang grangs bcu bzhi po 'di yin no/ /bco lngar dbye na dpal mchog la sher dum dang / sngags dum gnyis yod do/ /gsum pa bye brag tu ngan song sbyong rgyud bshad pa la/ rgyud 'di ston pa gang gis gsungs pa/ gnas gang du/ dus nam gyi tshe/ dgos pa ci'i phyir gsungs pa/ rgyud kyi bzhugs tshul/ brjod bya'i don ji ltar ston pa'i tshul/

rgyud 'di bod du dus nam gyi tshe 'gyur zhing / gang zag sus bsgyur pa dang / rgyud 'di la bshad srol ji ltar byung zhing / de'i nang nas gang gi rjes su 'brang ba ngos bzung ba dang brgyad yod pa las/ dang po ni/ snga rabs pa rnams kyi gsung bgros la/ rgyud chung 'di la brtag pa gnyis/ /brtag pa gnyis la ston pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyong rgyud 'di la gzhung tshad sh+lau ka stong dang / bam po gsum yod cing / brtag pa gong 'og gnyis yod la/ ston pa ni brtag pa dang po sprul sku shākya thub pas gsungs shing / brtag pa phyi ma la dkyil 'khor bcu gcig yod pa'i dang po bcu phyag na rdo rje zhi bas gsungs shing / phyi ma bcu gcig pa gdul bya ma rung pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du sngar gyi phyag rdor zhi ba de nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur te gsungs pas na/ ston pa de gsum yang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa tsam yin no/ /gnyis pa gnas ni ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi na tshal chen po bzhi yod pa'i byang phyogs dga' ba'i tshal du gsungs so/ /gsum pa dus ni lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas shi 'phos te mnar med du skyes nas mi'i zhag bdun lon pa de'i tshe gsungs so/ /bzhi pa dgos pa ci'i phyir gsungs na/ sngon byung lha'i nor bu dri ma med pa mnar med la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal las thar pa'i phyir dang / rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyi ngan song rgyu dang bcas pa las grol ba'i phyir du gsungs so/ /lnga pa ni brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud dang / phyi ma bshad rgyud kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa dang / yang brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud dang / brtag pa phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang po bcu'i gzhung rnams rgyud phyi ma dang / me ltar 'bar ba man chad rgyud phyi ma'i 'ang phyi ma'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /drug pa rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan gyi brjod bya ni/

rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi thabs bzhi dang / bye brag tu ro bsreg pa'i hoṃ khung gcig ste bcu bdun po de dang de'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa bstan cing / gzhan yang sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo bdun nam/ dgu dang / rang don dang gzhan don gnyis/ gzhan don la yang tshe ldan dang tshe 'das rjes su gzung tshul gnyis/ dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes la bslab pa gnyis so/ /shugs las bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la dbye na/ bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bstan pa yin te/ brtag pa dang por/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por brjod/ /ces dang / dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsam nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dis bdag bskyed bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ ras la bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa bris la/ zhes sogs dang / brtag pa phyi mar/ sku gzugs kyi cho ga yang 'dir de bzhin du byas te/ cung zad du na bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs bri'o/ /yang na sku gzugs ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bris la me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de'i spyan sngar 'bum tsam zhig sngar bsnyen pa byas nas las thams cad bya'o/ /zhes dang / tshe dpag med nas gtso bo ri mo'am lugs ma'ang rung / /rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces bris sku dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bri bar bshad do/ /des na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te so drug las bzhi'i thab dang ro bsreg gi thab dang dbye na bzhi bcu rtsa gcig yod do/

/de dag gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa ni rgyud kyi brjod don mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bdun pa dus nam gyi tshe bsgyur pa ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba snying po dang / lo tsā ba ban+dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing / dus phyis rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi ring la/ rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad du bcos nas gtan la phab pa 'di nyid 'gyur legs shing mkhas pa thams cad kyang 'gyur 'di la tshad mar byed do/ /dus phyis chag lo'i 'gyur dang / bo dong 'jam ral gyi 'gyur yang yod mod/ mi 'thad pa'i cha mang bas mkhas pa rnams kyis tshad mar mi byed do/ /brgyad pa rgyud 'di la bshad srol ji ltar byung zhing de'i nang nas gang gi rjes su 'brang ba ngos bzung ba ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i 'bru 'grel rgan po zhes bya ba yod la/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bshad srol byung zhing / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos/ paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la gsan pa'i yo ga'i chos skor rnams dbus gtsang la sogs pa'i sa phyogs smad du dar bas smad lugs zhes bya la/ yang lo tsā ba chen po des paṇ+ḍi ta shradha ka ra warma dang / dharmā pha la la gsan pa'i yo ga'i chos skor rnams mnga' ris skor gsum la sogs pa'i sa cha stod du dar bas na yo ga stod lugs zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang jo bo chen po rje nas go mi sgom chen la sogs pa/ rtsa snur 'dzim gsum la brgyud pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bka' dang / bshad bka'i srol khyad par 'phags pa dang / gzhan yang chag lo tsā bas bal po ra wen+t+ra la gsan pa'i sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bka' dang / bshad bka' sogs yod pa las/ 'dir lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas bzung ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi bshad srol/

khyad par du rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi mchan bu dang sa bcad gnyis/ gzhan phan skor gsum ste gzhung lnga la sogs pa yo ga stod lugs kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ /spyi don 'di man chad yo ga'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul rang du mi snang yang / rgyud dang cho ga'i don che rags khong du chud pa la phan pa'i phyir bris pa lags/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag la/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs bzhag pa dang / de la rtsod pa spong ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bla ma pur bsod dbang gi 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar/ gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba go log tu byas pa dang / lha'i mngon rtogs dang phyag mtshan mang po nor bar bris 'dug pa ni rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i mchan bu dang / gzhan phan 'od zer gyi dgongs par 'dod kyang / gzhung de dag dang mi mthun pas spang blang shes par bya ba yin te/ gzhung phan tshun zhib tu bltas pas gsal ba yin no/ /yang 'dzim pa blo chen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga shes rab snang bar rnam snang mngon byang las/ spro dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /ye shes skad cig gcig rdzogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya 'o/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa'i lung drangs te/ skad cig gis bskyed par dam bcas nas/ cho ga rang gi ngo bo bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa'i skabs su srung 'khor dang gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba sogs mi byed par/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa sogs sngon du song nas/ rdo rje cho ga gsum las rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed/ yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum byin gyis rlob pa dang / ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab rnams bla med ltar byed pa dang / bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i skabs dang / mdun bskyed rnams la yang yan lag bzhi rdzogs byed pa dang /

bum bskyed kyi skabs su las bum dang / gtor ma'i skabs su 'das gtor dang / 'jug pa'i skabs su dam bzhag bzhi byed pa dang / dbang gi dngos gzhi'i skabs su sngags dbang rnams/ chu dbang gi skabs su byed pa rnams ni bsgrub bya dang / sgrub byed ma 'brel ba sogs phan tshun nang 'gal zhing / bla med kyi cho ga bsres nas/ rgyud 'di nas 'byung ba'i cho ga rnams dor bar snang bas shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyis spang bar bya'o/ /yang brag nag pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis byas pa'i 'di'i mngon rtogs dang / dkyil chog kyang snang mod mngon rtogs kyi skabs su rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du byas pa'i 'bring po la/ dang po sbyor ba med par srung 'khor gyi rjes de ma thag tu dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsgom par byas 'dug pa yang mi 'thad de/ 'dir sku gsum lam byed kyi nyams len tshang dgos pa la/ chos sku lam byed dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin chad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /bdag bskyed rgyas pa'i skabs su sems dpa' nyer brgyad lus la bsgrub pa dang / bsam gtan rim bsgom mngon byang lnga bskyed la sogs pa yo ga che ba smad lugs dang / de'i nang nas kyang bu ston gyi lugs bzhin bkod 'dug pa ni mi 'thad de/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi skabs 'dir rdor dbyings ltar/ cho ga rgyas pa de dag bshad pa med cing / de dag 'di'i dbang bka' dang bshad bka' gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po kha cig gis/ sbyong rgyud kyi ṭīk+kar/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i lag len rtsa skya ba bsod nams brtan pa'i chog khrigs ji lta ba bzhin bris nas mi 'thad pa'i cha 'ga' re la dgag pa mdzad pa ma gtogs/ go rim dang cho ga'i khog phub de bzhin byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtsa skya ba'i dkyil chog rin chen sgron me'i lung rgyun tsam ma gtogs/ rang lugs 'di la rtsa skya pa'i bla ma rnams nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' dang /

rgyud kyi bshad bka' gang yang med cing / cho ga yang mi 'thad pa'i cha shin tu mang ste/ khyed rang gis dgag pa byas pa bzhin no/ /des na phan tshun ma bsre bar rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs bzhin mdzod cig gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud rim rang rang gis gang la thob pa'i brgyud pa de dang de la 'dod kyang / cho ga'i rnam gzhag rnams lung rigs man ngag gis grub cing / tshad ma gsum gyis gnod pa med pa zhig dgos pa la/ ngan song sbyong rgyud 'di nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga'i khog phub/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nas sdom tshig gi tshul gyis phal cher tshang bar bstan cing / der mi gsal ba dkyil 'khor phyi ma bcu gcig nas kha bskangs pas cho ga tshang bar ston la/ dkyil 'khor rang rang gi sgos chos ni/ dkyil 'khor de dang de'i skabs su gsal bar bstan pas/ cho ga gzhan dang ma 'dres par rgyud 'di nas sdom tshig tshun chad kyis gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /de yang tshul ji ltar bstan tshul lung dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/ brtag pa dang por/ de nas khrus la sogs byas la/ /dri dang phreng mchog phreng ba can/ /dri zhim kha bskangs mchog mdzes pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas kyang / /me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /ces pas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor khang par 'jug pa bstan/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang me'i sngags rgya ni rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad la/ khyad par du rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi dam rgya ni shāka thub kyi skabs nas gsungs so/ /de gnyis kyi bsang sbyangs sngon du song nas/ mchod rdzas kyi snod bcud gnyis ka oṃ las bskyed pa ni gtsug dgu nas gsungs so/ /dharma ra ṇi ni rnam snang sgyu dra nas bshad la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni shāka thub kyi skabs nas/ drang srong khyod la'ang skyabs su mchi/

/zhes dang / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs dag la/ /thos nas kyang ni skyabs su song / /zhes dang / tshe dpag med nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang / /zhes pas bstan/ srung 'khor rgyas pa ni rdo rje 'byung ba nas gsungs la/ bsdus pa ni/ rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang / /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag cag la sogs byas nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan to/ /lag pa byin rlabs ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba las/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs par bsams te hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka la a la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug gis kun nas kun tu bkang zhing 'phro bar byas te/ mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ gung mo gnyis la traṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la hri zhes bya ba bsam/ mthe'u chung gnyis la a zhes bya bar bsam par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / bdag dang rjes su mthun par byas te/ zhes pas bstan to/ /oṃ a n+yo n+ya nas/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ gyi bar ni rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad do/ /bdag bskyed dang / bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad ni/ bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du/ /zhes pas bstan cing khyad par du dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom par byas nas kyang / /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsam nas dam tshig phyag rgya dag /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/

/ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las ni/ tshangs pa chen po nas/ byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag gi bar gyis bstan to/ /mchod bstod snga ma ni sngon byung ston pa'i rnam 'phrul dang mthun par bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin sgom pa po'i 'od zer gyis spro bsdus 'gro ba ngan song las bton pa rnams kyis bdag la mchod bstod byas par bsam pa yin no/ /sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas/ snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge la zhugs so/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzla bya'i sngags ni rang rang gi cho ga'i skabs nas bstan cing / mchod bstod phyi ma rjes 'jug sgrub pa po'i nyams len dang mthun pa yin la/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /zhes pa 'di zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad cing / bstod pa ni me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / /bum bzlas ni/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu brtag /zhes pas bstan to/ /mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni bri bskyed thun mong gi dbang du byas pa'i dam tshig pa la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'am/ yang na lag len bzhin snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa'am/ sgo drug gi sgo nas bskyed pa la spyan 'dren pa gang yin yang rung ste/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya sngags dang bdag ldan pas/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba'i bcing bas bcings nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgrogs tshul du bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bcug nas kyang / /bskyed par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ de nas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgya dang /

rnam snang la sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam mo/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab pa la/ las kyi phyag rgya ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba las/ de nyid las gnyis su byas nas gar byas na las kyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ shākya thub pa dang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs nas bstan/ chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ dkyil 'khor rang rang gi lha'i bskyed sngags kyis bstan/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ de'i tshe lha so so'i sku la rtog cing / yid la byed pas bstan la/ de la dmigs te 'gro ba ngan 'gro las 'don pa sogs kyi las sbyor bstan pa yin no/ /mchod pa ni/ ar+ghaṃ mchog brtag gsang la sogs pa yi/ /dbyangs snyan pa yis bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces pas bstan te/ cha gsum dang rigs drug yi dwags kyi gtor ma ni/ de nas 'byung po kun la gtor ma bya/ /phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /de yi cho ga ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes dang / gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas bstan to/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod byas te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba las/ de nas sngags mkhan nyid kyis ni/ /spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid la ni dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid kyis slob ma 'jug pa'i skabs ltar/ bdag 'jug rdzogs par blangs shing / brtan byed kyi bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ gzhan don du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sta gon dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sta gon ni/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /'gro la phan phyir byang chub myur thob pa/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug /de nas byin rlabs byang chub smon lam gdab/

/zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ /bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ /zhes pas sems bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyun bshags dang / gnas gsum dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam/ bdun byin gyis rlabs pa dang / byang chub tu smon lam gdab pa dang / zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang / 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sngags rgyas gnas gsum bsrung ba bstan to/ /dngos gzhi la 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po 'jug pa'i chos bcu gnyis ni/ dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma dpal gyi lag gnyis pad+mar bya/ /me tog rin chen sogs pas de brgyan la/ /g.yon gyi lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ /zhes dang / rab zhi kha nas sngags zlos brjod du gzhug /ces pa'i gzhung 'dir drangs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod du gzhug pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi 'jug pa'i chos bcu gnyis po rgyud tshig gis gsal bar dngos su bstan to/ /gnyis pa sngags dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i bum dbang sogs bcu dgu ni/ mos pa brtan dang ldan par dam bcas nas/ /sarba bid kyis ci ltar dbang bskur ltar/ /bum pa la sogs ci snyed mang thogs te/ /bcu po rnams kyi dbang bcu ci dgar bskur/ /de nas lag tu dril dang rdo rje byin/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs te/ /mi yi dbang phyug go 'phang thob pa dang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /sngags grub phyir ni mos ldan slob ma la/ /sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /zhes pa nas/ bsgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi dbang bcu dgu po sdom tshig gis gsal bar bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur ba ni/ phyag rdor gyi skabs nas gsal bar gsungs la/ gshin don la dgos pa'i rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di/

/zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang / lhug pa rnams ni slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga na yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rjes chog ni me ltar 'bar ba nas/ de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par gzhag pas bsrung nas kyang / /mjug tu mngon par mchod nas ni/ /lha rnams thams cad gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan te/ lung khungs ma smos pa rnams ni brtag pa dang po'i lung tshig tu shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rgyud don phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i cho ga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa'i cho ga yid ches shing khungs btsun pa gcig la brten dgos pas/ de'i phyir 'khrul pa zad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi gsung rab kyi don phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i bdag gi yongs 'dzin chen po chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po bas mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas/ gtor ma cha gsum/ gzhan phan nyer mkho rnams ji lta ba bzhin/ cho ga'i khog phub gzhir bzhag pa la/ dkyil 'khor rang rang gi mngon rtogs dang / cho ga'i khyad chos rnams rgyud dang / rje btsun chen po'i mchan bu bzhin ma 'dres par yi ger bkod par 'gyur bas/ de bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa de la rtsod pa spang ba ni/ gal te kho na re/ lo chen rin bzang nas bzung ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dbang bka' dang / rgyud kyi bshad bka' yod kyang / dkyil 'khor phyi ma bcu gcig gi dbang bka'i brgyud pa med pas/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po tshang ba'i dbang bka' ni/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ snyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ de las brgyud pa'i rtsa snur 'dzim gsum gyi bla ma so so nas bzung ste/ rang rang gis gang las thob pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la bsnyeg dgos pas/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yang bla ma de dang des mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ji lta ba bzhin du bya dgos so snyam na/ de ltar mi dgos te/ gal te dgos na/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod ma byas par/ dkyil 'khor bris pa'i rjes de ma thag bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang rigs par thal/ snyal pa nyi ma shes rab dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa yin pa gang zhig des de ltar du bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dkyil 'khor ma bsgrub par 'jug cing dbang len pa de ni shin tu 'khrul te/ dkyil 'khor ma bsgrub par/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun byed pa don med pa'i phyir dang / 'dir rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas ni/ /zhes sogs 'jug pa smos pa de ni dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bdag bsnyen nas bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom pa tsam la dgongs pa yin gyi/ dbang blang ba'i skabs ma yin te/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams sras dang 'bangs su bcas shing / 'khor gyis bskor ba rigs pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs so/ /de nas bdag nyid la dbang bskur te zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /rtsa skya pa rnams kyi lugs 'di dang 'gal bar rig nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing / gsol ba gdab pa nas bzung ste/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no zhes sdom pa sbyin pa'i bar 'jug pa'i chos rnams rdzogs par byas te/ de'i rjes la rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sogs sgrub mchod gtor ma'i bar rdzogs par byas nas/ de nas dbang rnams rdzogs par len par 'dod do/ /de'ang mi 'thad de/ thog mar dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ de nas 'jug pa/ de rjes dbang len par bshad pa yin te/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas/ de nas sngags mkhan nyid kyis ni/

/spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par byas/ /bdag nyid la ni dbang bskur la/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rtsa skya pa 'di'i cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs pa rnams kyis 'di dag kyang khas len dgos par 'gyur zhing / 'di dag khas mi len na/ sa lugs kyi cho ga dang / ma yar bu yar bzhin du phan tshun ma bsre bar 'khrul pa zad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin nyams su len pa ni/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i gdams ngag yin pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis de bzhin du mdzad du gsol zhes bdag thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs so/ /de bzhin du 'dzim pa blo chen dang / brag nag pa la sogs pa'i cho ga'i rjes su 'brang pa rnams la'ang dgag bsgrub de bzhin rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /des na dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa rang rang gis gang la thob pa de dang de la 'dod kyang / dkyil chog de dang des mdzad pa bzhin byed pa'i nges pa med de/ dper na gsang 'dus dang / bde mchog gi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa/ bu ston rin po che lta bu la 'dod kyang / dkyil chog de dang de'i gzhung bzhin mi byed par/ de la dgag bsgrub dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ sa lugs la sogs pa'i gzhung rnam dag gi rjes su 'brang ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa skabs su babs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos bshad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po 'di rnams su dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon snying rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang don du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang pa'am/ gzhan don du slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sgrub par byed pa rnams kyis spyi dang / bye brag gi rnam gzhag 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ de'ang rgyud 'di nas gsungs pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/

tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug dang / phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la gza' chen brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la 'jigs byed chen po dgus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten pa'i rnam pa'i tshul 'dzin pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ste bcu gnyis yod pa las/ de re re la'ang bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor las rim gnyis gnyis yod do/ /dang po bsnyen pa la dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa/ ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang dkyil 'khor thams cad la khyab byed du 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang yin gyi bsnyen pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / bdag bskyed dngos gnyis/ dang po srung ba'i 'khor lo la dbye na srung 'khor rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyas pa/ bsdus pa'i bsdus pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mtshams kyi rdo rje sems dpa' gsal btab ste lce lag byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzung ste/ sems dpa' tha ma bzhis bsrung nas/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas pa'i bar gzhan phan mtha' yas su bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni khro bo spyan 'dren pa sogs las kha tshar ba rnams dor ba ma gtogs/ gzhan snga ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes su/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dha3haṃ/

gis chos bdag med par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhi ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha dang / rgyu ma dang / mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyangs kyi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam la/ de'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab kyi steng du g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab bzhag nas bsnol ba'i mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel nas mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa ni hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya ste/ de nyid spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du reg cing / oṃ badz+ra satwa krodha sogs lan gsum gyis bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba/ yang phyag rgya snying khar bcas nas lan gsum brjod la/ dang pos 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / gnyis pas phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i ra ba me ris dang bcas pa/ gsum pas de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur bsam la gnas bsrung / yang lan gsum brjod pas rnal 'byor te/ cho ga'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi bar chad bsrung bar bsam mo/ /de nas chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/

/nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhan snga ma ji lta ba bzhin las/ bstod pa byed mi dgos so/ /srung 'khor dang po gnyis ni/ yo ga rdo rje 'byung ba nas gsungs shing / las kha tshar ba ni bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis sbyar bar 'dod do/ /srung 'khor phyi ma gnyis ni sbyong rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin zhing / bstod pa ni bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis sbyar bar 'dod do/ /kun rig la srung 'khor rgyas bsdus bzhi po gang byas kyang rung zhing / dkyil 'khor phyi ma bcu gcig la sbyong rgyud kyi rgyas bsdus gnyis po gang rung byed pa phyag len yin no/ /gnyis pa bdag bskyed dngos la/ lha grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa bya ba dang gsum gyis dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad la khyab byed du 'jug pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi bdag bskyed rkyang pa'am/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel yang rung ste/ ya mtha' skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste/ mchod bstod kyi bar ngag 'don phal cher 'dra la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ sems bskyed kyi skabs su de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i tshab tu/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das shākya seṅge'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor lhag ma rnams la des rigs bsgres te shes par bya zhing / srung 'khor ni sngar bshad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba dkyil 'khor thams cad la 'dra la/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa'i skabs su/ dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi gtso bo'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gzugs rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par bzhengs par 'dra yang ngo bo dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo de dang de yin par bsgom pa gal che zhing /

gleng gzhi'i tshig 'don mi 'don gyi dmigs bsal rang rang gi skabs su 'chad la/ bstod pa snga phyi gnyis ka mtshan brgyas byed pa'am/ yang na snga ma la/ khyed ni glang po'i rna ba can/ /zhes sogs mtshan bcus bstod kyang rung ngo / /bzla bya'i sngags ni rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa rig gzhan rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang bcas pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu'i sgo nas/ dkyil 'khor dang po gnyis la sdig pa zhi ba dang / tshe dpag med gnyis la tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas pa dang / 'khor lo bsgyur ba la byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang / rnal 'byor gnyis la sogs pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan rgyas pa dang / me ltar 'bar ba la gdug pa can ma rung pa tshar gcod pa'i bsam pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi gtso bo'i sngags bzla ba'i tshe dmigs pa ni 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang 'dra zhing / 'khor rnams la de dang de dbang du 'dus shing / bsgo ba nyan par bsam mo/ /'dod don gsol gdab kyang des rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang yin gyi bsnyen pa ni/ rang rang gi cho ga gsum las/ de dang de'i gtso bo rkyang par bskyed la/ dbang skur ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor dang po gnyis la bud+dha dang phyi ma bcu la badz+ra sngon du 'gro ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya ba ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad snga ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sku gsum lam du byed pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa rgyas pa ni/ gzhan phan 'od zer dang / chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i cho ga sgrib pa rnam sel dang / rang lugs kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa ni/
