lha bcu gnyis kyi zhing bkod rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin du legs par bris la/ rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa de gyang ngos la sogs pa la bkod la/ mchod gtor rnams de'i mdun du phreng tshar du bsham la/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas mdun gyi dmigs rten gyi ras bris de nyid/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ sa bon nam/ snying po tshig tsam gyis lha de dang der bskyed la zhal phyag gsal gdab/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas la/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/ rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam la/ mchod bstod byas te rtsa rig sogs kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni gzhan kun rig dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha bcu gnyis kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer slar 'dus te/ bdag gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ /'dod don gsol gdab dang / rjes kyi cho ga bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus sngon du gang byas pa de dang mthun pa'i rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /de ltar cho ga'i byed tshul zhib tu shes par byas nas dkyil 'khor 'di rnams kyi gzhi bsnyen byed pa'i tshe/ mtshams dam du bcad la thun gsum mam bzhi'i sgo nas rtsa rig dang / dkyil 'khor phyi ma rnams kyi gtso bo'i sngags la 'bum phrag gsum mam drug bya'o/ /gal te thams cad ma grub na yang kun rig gi gzhi bsnyen nges par 'gro dgos shing / de la gzhi bsnyen song nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon byed du rung tsam yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las rim la/ rdul tshon la brten pa dang / ras bris la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po ni zur du rtogs par bya'i/

'dir yi ge mang bas 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas cho ga sgrub par byed pa la/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis yod pa'i dang po kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas dang / cha gsum gtor ma'i yig cha las shes par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan thams cad la yang spyi'i cho ga gzhung de dag las shes par bya bas 'dir rgyas par ma bris la/ 'on kyang cho ga gzhan dang ma 'dres par gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi cho ga la shin tu mkhas shing zhib par sbyangs nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma bcu gcig po dag la 'jug par bya yi/ gzhan cho ga'i lag len ma dag cing / mi mthun pa rnams dang 'di'i cho ga bsre bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis chos rje tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /'brel tshad don ldan skyes chen bzang rim par/ /legs par byon te bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /rgyun chad med par mdzad 'di e ma mtshar/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i blo yi me long la/ /rnam mang gsung rab legs bshad gzugs brnyan shar/ /rnam dag blo yis mthong na yid 'phrog pa'i/ /rnam bshad 'di la su zhig mtshar mi rtsi/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las/ mkhas pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyi gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bdun pa paṇa chen gung ru shes rab bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ shin tu yangs pa'i mkhyen rab kyis shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa thugs su chud cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i kun rig gi rnam bshad yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

'dir rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer dang / de'i lag len gyi cho ga phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ bdag gi bla ma chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris 'di la/ kun rig 'di rgyud gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba dang / spyir yo ga la rgya bod du srol ji ltar byung tshul dang / khyad par du sbyong rgyud 'di bod du ji tsam na 'gyur zhing srol ji ltar byung bstan pa dang / yo ga stod lugs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te rang lugs bshad pa dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po ni/ spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya sna tshogs la dgongs te/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba las/ 'di phyi ma yin/ de la yang rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rnams kyis rgyud sde so so'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyud sde gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu 'byed tshul sogs mtha' yas pa yod pa las/ 'dir slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes sngags don rnam gzigs las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes pa ltar bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum du yod pa las/ dang po ni/ rgyud sde gong ma'i rgyas bkab pa ma yin par/ bya rgyud rang rkang gi dbang du byas nas/ bdag nyid lhar mi bskyed cing / dka' thub dang gtsang sbra dang bcas te mdun du bris sku'am/ lugs ma gang rung lhar bskyed pa dang / spyan 'dren pa gang rung tsam byed cing / ye shes pa dgug gzhug mi byed par lha rje dpon lta bu la dngos grub len pas de ston pa'i gzhung yang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud/ sgrub thabs gtso bor ston pa legs grub/

phyag rgya gtso bor ston pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud sde bya ba spyi'i rgyud bzhi lta bu yin la/ gzhan mtha' yas kyang / bya rgyud spyi'i rnam gzhag tu shes/ gnyis pa spyod rgyud ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed kyang / de la ye shes pa dgug gzhug mi byed par/ lha grogs po lta bu la dngos grub len pa ste/ de ston pa'i gzhung yang rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud lta bu yin la/ rgyas par ni spyod rgyud spyi'i rnam gzhag tu shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed cing / ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs sogs byas nas dngos grub len yang / rim gnyis dang / dbang bzhi dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa la sogs pa med cing / mthar ye shes pa yang gshegs su gsol ba yin la/ de ston pa'i gzhung yang / pad+ma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud zab cing shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun rgyud kyis gsal bar byed/ /ces pa ltar rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po de nyid 'dus pa la yang dum bu bzhi yod pa'i dang pos sbyang gzhi sems can gyi lus dang gti mug gi gnyen por/ rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ston/ gnyis pas ngag dang / 'dod chags kyi gnyen por khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor ston/ gsum pas yid dang zhe sdang gi gnyan por 'gro 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor ston/ bzhi pas sgo gsum gyi byed las dang / ser sna dang phrag dog gi gnyen por don thams cad grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ston/ yang dum bu bzhi pa'i rjes su rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud don nye bar bsdus pa zhes kyang zer ba'i/

dang po gnyis ni rgyud kha skong lta bu yang yin te/ dang po ni/ dum bu bzhi pa'i skabs kyi kha skong bar byed pa yin la/ bar pas ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad cho ga rgyas pa kho na'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos na/ snyigs ma'i sems can la phan mi thogs snyam pa la/ sngon la sems dpa' gcig rdzogs sogs bsdus pa'i cho ga gsungs nas dgongs pa gsal ba yin zhing / gsum pas ni sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul ston pa sogs gsungs la/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun lon pa'i tshe/ 'og min du rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa gsungs/ de nas sum cu rtsa gsum du lha rnams la rgyud phyi ma gsungs/ lcang lo can du rgyud don nye bar bsdus pa gsungs pas na lha gnas gsum zhes kyang zer zhing / de nyid 'dus pa'i rjes su gsungs pa'i gsang 'dus sogs rgyud gzhan rnams kyang 'di'i bshad rgyud lta bur slob dpon kun snying sogs bzhed do/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud la/ so so'i bshad rgyud dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud gnyis/ dang po la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor ston pa thams cad gsang ba/ shar+dhas/ 'di nas bshad pa'i rdo rje dbyings sgo rkyang dpal ldan rgya che ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa 'grel mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtogs pa chen po'i khams gsum rnam rgyal yin la/ 'di la lo chen gyi bla ma dharmā pha la'i slob dpon mu ti ka go sha'i 'grel pa yod gsungs/ dum bu phyi ma gnyis kyi bshad rgyud bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi bshad rgyud ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'am/ badz+ra shrī ṣa ra'i rgyud/ rig lnga char gyi byed pa ston pas na/ gsang 'dus sogs su 'di'i lung drangs par rgya che rol pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa de yin no/

/'di'i rigs kyang bcu/ rigs bsdus gcig dang dkyil 'khor bcu gcig 'byung gsungs/ gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ dpal mchog dang po dpal mchog sher phyin gyi skor 'di gnyis la/ sher phyin dum dang / sngags dum gnyis kyang zer/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa ste/ 'di ni dpal mchog sher phyin gyi skor logs su bkol ba dang don gcig cing phar phyin tu sras yum bcu bdun gyi nang du bgrang pa de yin la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes dpal gyis yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa yang yod gsungs/ gzhan yang rnam snang sgyu dra/ rab gnas mdor bsdus/ slob dpon rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis 'grel pa byas pa'i rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu'i rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi rgyud/ mtshan brjod/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud dam/ spros pa chung zhing sgom pa gtso bor byed pas na sgom pa'i rgyud ces kyang zer ro/ /yang 'di'i rgyud brtag pa phyogs gcig pa gtsug dgu'i rgyud du grags pa ste/ rgyud 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ gong gi kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'og gi shāka thub dkyil 'khor go sa brjes shing cho ga'i yan lag rnams rdor dbyings kyi rgyas bkab pa ma gtogs/ rgyud gnyis la khyad mi 'dug cing / /bu ston gyis 'di la brten nas gtsug dgu'i cho ga mdzad cing / bka' min pa 'dra zhes kyang gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud min pa nyid 'thad de/ 'di'i gsham gyi tshigs bcad du/ kun snying dang / 'jigs med sbas pa'i man ngag la brten nas brtsams/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ yang snga rabs pa go mi sogs kha cig sbyong rgyud 'dir bdag bskyed dngos su ma bshad cing / bris sku lhar bskyed nas bsnyen pa dang / dngos grub len par gsungs pa'i phyir bya rgyud yin zhes pa dang / yang kha cig gtso bor bris ma'am/ lugs ma'ang rung / rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces gsungs pas spyod rgyud yin zer yang /

tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / srung 'khor gyi skabs su/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes sogs kyis bdag lhar bskyed par gsungs pas/ bya rgyud min la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /ces sogs kyis ye shes pa 'jug par bshad pas/ spyod rgyud ma yin zhing rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las 'os med de/ des phyogs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba bstan to// ༈ //gnyis pa spyir yo ga la rgya bod du srol byung tshul la gnyis las/ dang po rgya gar du byung tshul ni/ tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po/ snga rabs pa rnams tshig la mkhas pa kun snying / don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen zhes gsum du grags pa'i/ dang pos de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan mdzad/ 'dis dbu ma bden gnyis kyi lung mang po drangs 'dug pas/ klu sgrub kyi dngos slob de yin nam gsungs/ gnyis pa de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa tan tra a wa ta ra zhes pa/ bod skad du/ rgyud don 'jug pa zhes pa mdzad/ phyi mas de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bcu drug pa zhes pa po ti bzhi tsam yod pa dang / dpal mchog sher phyin dum bu dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag nyer lnga pa zhes pa/ bod du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos la 'di las che ba med cing / po ti drug tsam byas pa gcig dang / rigs rkyang bcu gcig rigs bsdus gcig ste dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis ston pa dang / yang rnam snang sgyu dra/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsang ba 'dus pa rnams yo gar bkral ba'i 'grel pa rnams mdzad/ 'o na gsang 'dus sogs yo gar 'chad na/

rgyud sde de rnams las/ bha gar ling ga bzhag nas ni/ /de la sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las dbang po gnyis sbyor bde ba ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /zhes sogs dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ de'i don snyoms 'jug la mi 'chad kyi/ lha dam tshig pa'i bha ga dang / ling ga la lha ye shes pa'i bha ga dang / ling ga gnyis dbyer med du byed pas nye bar mtshon pa/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad dbyer med du byed cing / des bde ba chen po yang skye ste/ tha mal pa'i pho mo'i dbang po nyi tshe ba sbyar bas kyang bde ba skye ba bzhin no/ /yang na bha ga'i skal ba ste ye shes pa 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i dam tshig pa'o/ /ling ga ni rtags te/ dam tshig pa la dbyer med du bcug nas rgyas 'debs pa'i lha ye shes pa la ngos 'dzin no/ /yang rig ma lo bcu drug dang / nyi shu lon pa bstan pa bshad pa dgos kyang / mchod pa bcu drug dang / nyi shu la sogs ston par bzhed do/ /yang slob dpon de nyid kyi rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba zhes pa dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog ste rgyas pa gnyis/ gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i dkyil chog ste bsdus pa gnyis dang bzhi mdzad/ yang rdor dbyings sgrub thabs sems dpa' 'byung ba che chung gnyis/ gzhan yang 'gro 'dul dang / don grub kyi nag 'byams sogs nas dkyil chog bstan pa dang / dpal mchog gi skabs sogs nas dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa gsungs/ mtshan brjod la yang spyir ni bshad lugs drug sogs yod pa las/ slob dpon dbu ma la dga' bas 'jam rdor dang mthun par bkral ba dang / a nu sa ya rak+ṣi tas dus 'khor dang mthun par bkral ba dang / gzhan yang lam 'bras dang mthun par bshad pa sogs yod kyang / yo gar bkral ba la 'grel pa gsum ste/ che ba 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad/

de'i rjes su 'brangs pa chos dbyings gsung dbang dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi slob dpon byang chub mchog ces kyang bya/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes kyang bya ba des mdzad pa'i/ sngags don rnam gzigs/ de'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'jam dpal seng ldan gyi dkyil chog yon tan kun 'byung zhes pa mdzad/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi nam mkha' dri med chung ba zhes par rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor drug rigs bsdus 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang / dkyil 'khor bri tshul 'dra ba ste dkyil 'khor bdun ston pa rnams mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bod du srol byung tshul ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la/ jo bo rin chen bzang pos zhus te/ pu hrang lo chung dang / gtsang smad kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis zhus nas/ smad du dar ba'i smad lugs dang / yang paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la la/ lo chen gyis zhus nas/ mnga' ris la sogs sa cha stod kyi dge bshes bgres po rnams la 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa rnams la yo ga stod lugs zhes grags pa rnams byung ngo / /gsum pa ni sbyong rgyud 'di bod du ji tsam na byung snyam na/ bstan pa snga dar la/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ dbus su mañju shrī la sogs pa sad mi mi bdun gyis bsgyur cing / rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi sku ring la lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā kirti dang / zhi ba snying po gnyis dbus su byon nas kun rig gi dbang bka' dang / cho ga tsam bshad cing dar bar mdzad kyang / rgyal po glang dar mas bsnubs nas rgyun chad pas/ gang gi srol yin mi shes par 'dug gsungs so/ /bstan pa phyi dar la srol chen gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ lo chen rin bzang gis paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la 'dus pa rnam gnyis zhes pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang / 'phags lugs gnyis/ yo ga de nyid 'dus pa rnams gsan cing /

paṇ+ḍi tas 'di'i dbang bka' sogs phyag len kun snying gi steng nas mdzad kyang / bshad pa rnams shākya bshes gnyen ltar mdzad pas lag len dang bshad pa ma mthun la spros pa che zhing / de'i tshe lo chen yang sku na gzhon spros pa la dges shing / pu hrang lo chung yang gre ngag bde zhing / de'i dus na mnga' ris stod du bon po rnams kyis/ gyer dbyangs sogs kyi spros pa la mi nag pa rnams mos pas/ de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du rdor dbyings kyi snying kha'i bdag 'jug la/ dbang rdzas dngos su len pa dang / dbyangs kyi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma dang / khyad par du rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa la tshigs bcad/ lhug pa dang sngags gsum gyi byed pa dang / kun rig la yang rdor dbyings kyi rgyas bkab pa sogs spros pa mang po mdzad pa'i slob ma la/ mnga' ris stod kyi lo chung sogs dang / smad kyi slob ma dang stod kyi lce zhar/ bo dong gi yang ka 'dar ston/ nyang stod kyi rkyang po chos blo/ rin spungs kyi gsum ston ye 'bar/ g.yag sde lung gi gnyan ston tshul 'bar sogs kyis zhus nas/ sa cha smad du gtso bor dar nas/ rma ban chos 'bar/ rong pa chos mchog sogs dang / bu lugs kyi bar gyi srol byung pa rnams ni/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod kyi bshad srol yin yang smad du dar bas na/ yo ga dang kun rig smad lugs zhes grags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la shrar+dha ka ra warma dang / kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la gnyis bod du byon pa la/ yo ga'i chos skor zhus shing / khyad par du dharmā pha la ni/ yo ga kun rig gi lag len dang bshad pa shin tu mkhas la/ khong dang brgyud thag kyang nye zhing / lag len spros pa chung bar mdzad/ de'i tshe lo chen yang sku na bgres/ bon po 'dul ba'i spros pa sogs kyang mi mdzad cing / kun rig la yang / sbyong rgyud nas bshad tshod tsam las/ rdor dbyings kyi cho ga mi bsre bar phyag len shin tu dag par mdzad pa'i slob ma yang /

mnga' ris stod kyi brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ kyi thang pa dz+nyā na shrī/ gu rib pa rin chen bsod nams/ gur shing pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan sogs kyis zhus pa/ sa cha stod du dar bar byas pa dang / gsum pa ni/ yang de'i rjes su jo bo rje bod du byon nas/ lo chen gyis kyang bde mchog sogs zhus shing / jo bo la/ go mi sgom chen gyis kun rig sogs zhus/ de la dz+nyā na shrīs zhus/ de la snyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis zhus/ de la snur pas zhus/ de la rtsa skya pas zhus/ de la 'dzim pas zhus pa'i srol ni/ kun rig sogs jo bo nas brgyud kyang / yo ga gzhan rnams lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad kyi srol ltar yin la/ 'di rnams thams cad kyang lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad du byung ba'i srol yin yang / sa cha stod du byung ba'i srol yin pas gtso bor stod du dar bas na stod lugs zhes grags so/ /de la rje btsun sa skya pa ni stod lugs la phyag len gtso bor mdzad kyang / brgyud pa gnyis ka bzhugs te/ stod lugs ni/ lo chen gyi slob ma brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ de la bla ma mal gyis gsan/ de la rje sa chen gyis gsan nas/ rje btsun sku mched la brgyud pa dang / smad lugs ni/ lo chen gyi slob ma lo chung la dbus pa dge ser gyis zhus/ de la bla ma gnam kha'ub pas zhus/ de la rje sa chen gyis gsan nas/ rje btsun sku mched la brgyud do/ /gzhan yang da na shi la'i slob ma g.yag sde ze dmar bas/ bi bhu ti tsaṇ+ḍa la zhus pa dang / chag lo tsā bas bal po re wan tra la zhus pa'i kun rig gi dbang bka' dang / cho ga tsam byung yang / dbang bka' bla ma de dang de la zhus pa srid kyang / lag len sogs sa lugs dang mtshungs shing / jo bo'i lugs dang cha 'dra gsungs/ 'o na sbyong rgyud las 'phros pa'i yig cha ci tsam yod ce na/ 'di la rgya gar na kun snying gis byas pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gcig bzhugs so zer yang bod du ma 'gyur ro/

/gzhan yang rgya 'grel du ming btags pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes pa/ kun snying la kha 'phangs kyang / khyin lo tsā ba khyung grags kyis nyang stod rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du byas pa dang / gzi brjid rgyal po zhes pa kun snying la kha 'phangs kyang / 'dis byas med pa gcig dang / de nyid snang rgyan zhes pa kun snying la kha 'phangs kyang / 'bring mtshams pa zhig gis byas pa dang / gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba gcig zangs dkar lo tsā bas byas pa kun snying la kha 'phangs pa rnams ni ma dag pa yin la/ gzhan zom rong chos bzang gis byas par khas blangs pa'i 'grel pa gcig dang rma rin chen mchog gis sbyong rgyud kyi gsal sbyangs zhes pa'am/ dris lan ni rgol ba mig tshar zhes pa bod kyis sbyar ba dang / chag lo'i 'grel pa dang / lo chen gyis shrar+dha ka ra warma dang / dharmā pha la la rgyud kyi bshad pa zhus dus/ rgyud la mchan btab pa'i bshad pa/ lo chen nas sa chen gyi bar du brgyud pa la mna' mchan gyi bshad pa zer ba dang / yang sangs rgyas gsang ba bod du gangs blta ba la byon pa'i tshe/ bod kyi slob ma rnams kyis zhus nas rgyud la mchan du btab pa/ phyis dkyus la shor ba'i 'bru 'grel rgad po zhes pa mdzad byang la bud+dha gu tis sbyar ces pa bris pa rnams sngar gyi zhi ba snying po dang / rma rin chen gnyis kyi gsung bgros slob mas bris pa yin nam zer ba rnams phal cher bod kyi bzos pa yin yang / de rnyed na bshad pa la shin tu phan gsungs/ yang kun snying la kha 'phangs kyang / jo bo smṛrti nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i ye shes 'od 'phros byas pa'i kun rig gi dkyil chog dang / chags med rgyal pos byas pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang / zhi ba snying pos byas pa'i mchod rten gdab pa'i cho ga ste 'di gsum la rigs gsum zhes kyang zer nas/ sngar gyi bla ma dag shin tu thugs brtsi zhing /

gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga tshang mar ston te/ dang pos ni gshin gson la dbang bskur ba ston/ gnyis pas shi ba'i ro de bsreg pa'i cho ga ston/ gsum pas de'i rus pa la mchod rten byed tshul ston no/ /yang gung ri lo tsā bas sbyong rgyud khog phub chen mo zhes kyang zer/ 'bru 'bum chen mo zhes pa'i stong thun chen mo mdzad do/ /de la brten nas rje btsun chen pos gzhan phan skor gsum mdzad/ de la brten nas sa skya pa phyi ma rnams kyis yig cha du mar bkral ba sogs byung ngo / /bzhi pa stod lugs la sa skya pa'i rje btsun yab sras kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rang lugs bzhag pa la/ spyir sbyong rgyud kyi bshad tshul dang / bye brag sa bcad 'di'i don rgyas par shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen gung rus mdzad pa'i kun rig gi rnam bshad yid kyi mun sel du blta bar gyis shig kho bos byas pa'i bstan bcos 'di ni rnam bshad de nyid kyi dbu na bzhugs pa'i lugs 'di'i dam pa'i chos byung tshul zhig logs su bkol ba yin no/ /tu kun rig gi bshad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'o na rgyud 'di ji ltar 'chad snyam na/ spyir dus 'khor gyi 'grel pa lta bu/ gzhan la mi ltos par/ rgyud 'grel pas 'chad pa'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs slob dpon gyi gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi gzhung phran rnams la brten nas 'dus pa'i rgyud 'chad pa lta bu/ rgyud gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa'i tshul dang rgyud rang nyid kyi dbu zhabs bsdebs pas bshad pa thon pa ni/ rgyud rgyud kyis 'chad pa'i tshul dang gsum yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ sngar smos pa'i yig cha rnams yod pa bshad pa la phan med/ 'on kyang bla ma'i man ngag yod na rgyud 'di nyid dbu zhabs bsdebs pas bshad pa dang lag len tshang bar thon pa yin gsungs/ de yang sbyong rgyud 'dir gtso bor/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug

'jig rten las 'das pa la 'jig rten pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor drug dang bcu gnyis gtso bor ston/ 'o na 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor la khyad par ci yod snyam na/ dbang bskur ba yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la gtso 'khor kun la len/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la gtso bo kho na la gtso bor len/ 'on kyang 'khor rnams la rjes gnang tsam len pa'i skabs ni yod/ dkyil 'khor yang 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la rta babs yod la/ 'jig rten pa rnams la rta babs med cing / rje btsun gyis klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor ni sgo khyud sogs dang bral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug po gru bzhi sgo bzhi yin yang / sgo khyud/ sgo logs rta babs gang yang med pa snga rabs pa phal mo che 'dod gsungs te/ yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud du/ de bzhin gru bzhir bris nas ni/ /sgo khyud la sogs rnam par spang / /zhes 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la sgo khyud sogs med par byas pa dang mthun no/ /des ni/ kha cig a pa ya'i pho rus byas nas/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yin na/ sgo logs kyi gdung gi 'og tu ka ba gnyis gnyis yod pas khyab zer ba'i nyin mtshan med par bsam mno btang nas zhib cha 'dod pa yang khegs pa yin no/ /gzhan mtha' yas kyang rje btsun gyi gzhan phan spyi chings sogs su shes so/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis paṇa chen gung ru shes rab bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin to// //'dir smras pa/ 'phags pa'i yul du thub dbang zas gtsang sras/ /gang de'i rgyal tshab gangs can ljongs 'di ru/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas pa rnams/ /yin zhes dpyod ldan kun kyang gtam du gleng / /de lta'i bstan pa'i me ro gso ba la/ /de bzhin gshegs dang dbyer med sngags 'chang rje/

/de yi rnam thar kun la snying nas dad/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba las chos rje gung ru shes rab bzang po'i gsung rab las byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o/ /de ltar zab pa dang rgya che ba'i yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos skor rnams kho bo cag gis ji ltar nos pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bdag cag rnams kyi bla ma rigs thams cad kyi bdag po khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i rje btsun dam pa mkhas pa dang grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi ded dpon/ lha dang drang srong dang dri za dang / mi'am ci la sogs pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis zhabs rten gyi pad+mo la phyag byas pa/ srid pa gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po/ gcig tu bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su mdzad cing / sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa lta bur dgongs pas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa du ma'i sgo nas rgyud yongs su smin pa dang grol ba'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i rnam par 'dren pa chen po/ rnam pa thams cad du sgrib pa med pa'i mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs dus kun tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzin pa mdzad pa'i skyes chen dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po de nyid kyi drung du/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag gis gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon pa'i chos ra zur gyi gnas mchog tu sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa smin rgyas su nos shing / de dag dang 'brel ba'i rje btsun rin po che nas rje sems dpa' chen po'i bar gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab sogs yig cha du ma'i bshad pa dang lung rnams dges bzhin du bka' drin chen pos stsal pa yin la/

gzhan yang rje bla ma de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma brgyud ldan yid ches can dag las gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi rnam bshad chen mo dpag bsam ljon pa'i bshad lung dang / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan 'od zer/ gzhan phan nyer mkho/ gzhan phan spyi chings te gsung rab dri ma med pa de dag gi lung dang bshad pa zhib tu thob cing / gzhan yang de kun gyi rgyab brten du dgos pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi lung dang / de'i rnam bshad kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa'i gzhan phan kun khyab dang / yang des mdzad pa'i gzhan phan 'od zer la rtsod pa spong ba gzhan phan gnod 'joms rnams kyi lung dang bshad pa rnams mtha' chod par legs par nos te/ de ni skal bzang dad ldan gyi slob ma rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su chos kyi khri bzang po'i steng du legs par bsdad de yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi char chen po 'bebs par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa mi dman tsam yod pa lags so/ /'dir smras pa/ tshul khrims rnam dag log spyod bral ba'i sku/ /zab yangs chos kyi chu rgyun 'bebs pa'i gsung / /mtho dman kun la mnyam nyid 'byongs pa'i thugs/ /skye 'gro'i skyabs gcig rje btsun mus par 'dud/ /gang gi zhal dkyil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /byams pa'i 'dzum zhal yid la yang yang gcags/ /de 'dra dran tshe lus kyi spu g.yo zhing / /mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tsha bas gdung tshe gangs chu 'dod pa bzhin/ /dus ngan skye bo'i spyod pas log sgrub kyis/ /shin tu mnar tshe mgon khyod lhag par dran/ /rmongs pa bdag la mi mngon dbyings nas skyobs/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ /sngon chad yid la bsam pa kun 'grub cing / /da dung bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /rje btsun khyed kyi gsung gi 'phrin las rnams/

/thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas 'phel ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam chos byung ba'i tshul/ /yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ /rdo rje gdan ltar mkhas grub 'du ba'i gzhi/ /dbus 'gyur tshal ltar chos sgra sgrog pa'i ljongs/ /rtse lnga'i ri ltar 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i gnas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas su legs par sbyar/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi zab don rin chen gyi/ /bang mdzod lta phyir sngon byon gong ma yi/ /gsung rab yo ga bstan pa'i khang bzang du/ /'jug 'dod rnams kyis bstan bcos 'di slobs dang / /ngo mtshar legs bshad sgo brgya phye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir mang thos dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams/ /skal ngan log lta'i phyogs su mi 'brang bar/ /sngags 'chang kho bo'i rjes su 'jug par rigs/ /'di sbyar dge bas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtsho rab mnyes te/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /rab tu rgyas shing yun du gnas gyur cig /ces rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho'i rnam par sprul pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon byon pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshul gyi gsung rab rnams mthong ba'i tshe/

dwang 'dod kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pas rkyen byas/ da dung bdag la brten nas yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa cung zad tsam 'phel na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ rgya gar lugs la kro dha naḥzhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la/ shing mo glang gi lo/ mā gha zhes pa mchu zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi sngon thub pa'i dbang pos cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus bzang khyad par can gyi tshes gsum gyi nyin bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung ga la ba der legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsam 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /'dis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig 'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /de la brten nas bstan pa rab rgyas te/ /kun kyang phyi ma bde ba can 'gro shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ /gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
